We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Project Manager, GWI Projects – NAM

Location — Austin, TX

Company

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale helps our customers — who make smartphones, supercomputers, virtual reality headsets, autonomous vehicles and more — transform their ideas into reality.

The technologies we create are the foundational building blocks of the future. Our systems make semiconductor devices called chips - "the brains" of the electronics used in almost every aspect of our lives. The promise of new and exciting applications, transforming industries such as consumer electronics, transportation, communications, healthcare, and supercomputing/AI, are enabled by advances in semiconductor and display technology.

We Deliver Material Innovation that Changes the World ®. If you're looking for the next step in your future, consider Applied Materials. With the data explosion and new investment in semiconductors, it's an exciting place to be.

Role

Applied Materials is growing at a pace that is driving significant increases in headcount and facilities. As a result, we expect over the next five years to have the most exciting and active R&D and manufacturing infrastructure pipeline in our history. The Global Workplace and Infrastructure (GWI) team is responsible for all facilities, from acquisition through operation to disposition, with a global capital budget of over $1.5B+ and operating budget of $500M+. As a member of the GWI North America Projects, Real Estate & Space Planning team, you will play an important role in delivering the capital and tenant improvement projects that make this growth possible.

The Project Manager, GWI Projects – NAM is responsible for delivering hi-tech equipment installation and tenant improvement construction projects across the NAM portfolio, including complex cleanroom and semiconductor manufacturing environments, using the project delivery and execution strategy best suited to each project. You will manage project scope, schedule, and budget through all phases of design, contracting, and construction, and will be knowledgeable of construction processes, startup, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of systems and buildings.

You will be accountable for a proven track record in managing a safety culture, using leading indicators and methods that promote a safe working environment, including incident investigation and corrective actions. You will partner closely with business unit stakeholders, architecture/engineering firms, Facilities Operations, and EH&S to develop, review, and approve design criteria, layouts, and detailed drawings, and to ensure compliance with applicable laws and codes.

You will be based in Austin, TX. The role requires travel to support projects across the NAM portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage project scope, schedule, and budget through all phases of design, contracting, and construction for hi-tech equipment installation and tenant improvement projects.
  • Participate in the planning of facilities changes for laboratories and equipment layouts, working toward economy of operation, maximum use of facilities and equipment, and compliance with laws and regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal business partners, architecture/engineering firms, Facilities Operations, and EH&S in developing, reviewing, and approving design criteria, layouts, and detail drawings.
  • Prioritize re-use of existing designs that have been previously permitted and inspected, and work with EH&S to maintain compliance with laws and local codes.
  • Resolve issues related to design criteria and performance specifications required to meet unique operating requirements and building and safety codes.
  • Review and estimate design costs, including equipment, installation, labor, materials, and other related costs, categorized by capital & expense and by construction category (similar to CSI categories).
  • Inspect construction and installation progress for conformance to established drawings, specifications, and schedules; participate in commissioning of the facility or improvement and hand-off to the lab owner and/or building operations.
  • Schedule building inspections and obtain inspection approvals.
  • Manage and direct construction project managers as needed for RFIs, project scope of work, bid comparisons, work plan generation, and conditional and full use approvals.
  • Manage project budgets, cost reporting, and closure.

To Succeed in this Role Requires:

  • Demonstrated depth and/or breadth of expertise in construction project management within a specialized technical environment.
  • Ability to interpret internal and external business and technical challenges and recommend best practices to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Ability to work independently, seeking guidance only in the most complex situations.
  • Sophisticated analytical judgment to solve complex problems and identify innovative solutions.
  • Ability to communicate difficult concepts and negotiate with others to adopt a different point of view.
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Comfortable operating both as an individual contributor and as part of a larger, multi-functional team.

Experience:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline.
  • 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in construction project management or facilities engineering.
  • Working experience as a construction project manager or facilities engineer in semiconductor manufacturing (wafer fab) facilities a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor facility systems including but not limited to acid waste and exhaust, solvent waste and exhaust, chilled/condenser water, hot water, process chilled water & DI water, process gases, controls, and monitoring systems.
  • Knowledge of Fire Life Safety and Gas Life Safety Systems and requirements.
  • Knowledge of City Permit requirements, National Electrical Code, International Building Code, and Fire Codes.
  • Knowledge of Environmental & Safety regulations and requirements.
  • Knowledge of building control systems and remote energy management systems.
  • Strong analytical skills and knowledge of SPC, 8D, DMAIC, FMEA, and other related tools.
  • Highly proficient in AutoCAD and Windows-based software including Excel, Word, Project, Visio & PowerPoint.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Yes, 25% of the Time

No

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Software Engineer Intern

We're hiring a Software Engineer Intern.

As an early engineering intern, you'll work alongside our founding team to build AI-powered software used by real organizations solving real problems. You'll contribute to production systems, gain exposure across the engineering stack, and help shape products that customers rely on every day.

You'll work on everything from AI applications and backend services to integrations, developer tooling, and product features. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with experienced engineers, learn how AI systems are built and deployed, and see your work make an immediate impact.

We're a small, fast-moving team. We learn quickly, ship quickly, and continuously adapt based on customer feedback. If you're excited to learn, enjoy solving challenging problems, and want hands-on experience building real software, you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

You'll work closely with our engineering team to build AI-powered products and production software for customers in regulated industries. You'll contribute to customer-facing projects, help prototype new ideas, improve internal tools, and gain experience working across the software development lifecycle.

Throughout your internship, you'll collaborate with engineers and customers, receive mentorship, and develop practical experience building reliable, production-quality systems.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve AI-powered applications and software systems.
  • Develop backend and full-stack features using modern technologies.
  • Integrate with APIs, databases, and third-party software.
  • Prototype new ideas, iterate based on feedback, and help ship production features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
  • Improve internal tooling and engineering workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers to solve challenging technical problems.
  • Learn modern software engineering practices while contributing to meaningful customer projects.

You Should Join If You

  • Are pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or have equivalent experience).
  • Have experience building software through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
  • Have an interest in AI, machine learning, or developer tools.
  • Enjoy solving difficult, open-ended technical problems.
  • Learn quickly and are eager to take on new challenges.
  • Communicate well and enjoy collaborating with others.
  • Care about building software that creates real value for users.
  • Want hands-on experience at a fast-moving early-stage startup where your work has immediate impact.

About Soren

Soren is the AI transformation partner for regulated industries.

We work with organizations that operate in highly regulated environments to deploy secure, production-grade AI systems.

Rather than forcing organizations to change how they work, we build AI around their existing workflows, institutional knowledge, and security requirements. We develop custom AI agents, intelligent automations, and enterprise AI infrastructure that integrate seamlessly into how teams already operate.

Our goal is simple: make AI genuinely useful by solving economically meaningful problems.

Why Join Us

We're entering a once-in-a-generation shift in how knowledge work gets done.

For years, organizations have invested heavily in AI with relatively modest returns. In many cases, the technology wasn't the problem—the implementation was. Existing AI tools often require people to change established workflows or adapt years of expertise to generic software.

We believe the opposite approach is the future.

Instead of asking people to work like AI, we build AI that works like people.

By deeply understanding how organizations operate, we create systems that augment existing expertise rather than replace it. The result is software that people actually adopt, trust, and rely on every day.

As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful engineering challenges, collaborate directly with experienced engineers, and contribute to products used by real customers. You'll gain exposure to modern AI technologies, production software development, and the pace of building at an early-stage startup.

If you're excited about building technology with immediate impact, learning quickly, and helping define how AI transforms critical industries, we'd love to work with you.

The successful candidate will combine the ability to lead multiple teams/workstreams with project management skills and prior experience delivering the benefits of transformational change.

We are seeking a highly skilled Director, HRIS with deep expertise in SAP SuccessFactors HCM to lead our HR technology initiatives and manage a global HRIS team. This role will be responsible for managing the configuration, optimization, and administration of SuccessFactors while ensuring alignment with business needs and HR strategies. The ideal candidate will combine technical proficiency, strategic thinking, and a strong understanding of HR processes to drive efficiency and enhance user experience across the system.

This role will be based preferably out of our Milford MA, HQ on a hybrid basis (3 days per week on site). It could also be based out of our New Castle, DE site, also on a hybrid basis.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the end-to-end administration, configuration, and optimization of SAP SuccessFactors HCM modules.

  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and regulatory requirements related to HRIS.
  • Manage third-party vendors and consultants to maximize system performance and innovation.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance employee experience, process automation, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Lead post-acquisition HRIS activities: Data mapping, ensuring system readiness for harmonization, and system integration execution

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5-8+ years of experience managing HR systems, with extensive expertise in SAP SuccessFactors HCM.
  • Prior leadership experience managing a global HRIS team.
  • Strong knowledge of HR processes, workforce planning, compensation, performance management, and talent acquisition.
  • Experience leading HRIS projects, system implementations, and upgrades.
  • Advanced proficiency in data reporting, dashboards, and analytics within SuccessFactors.
  • Ability to collaborate across functions, translating HR needs into technical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of HR compliance, security, and data privacy best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work onsite at Milford MA location Tue-Thur or New Castle DE

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP SuccessFactors certification is highly desirable.
  • Experience integrating SuccessFactors with ERP or payroll systems.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based HR technologies and emerging HR trends.
  • Merger & Acquisition experience

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Assistant Project Lead ( Quality manager)

Project and Development Services – (Kolkata /India)

Pillar of the team

Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both), you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of Civil, & Interior Construction , Bill verification , Quality Assurance, Planning & Control of a commercial / campus Project , and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore ways to bring out the best in your team by striving to ensure optimal outcomes for all stakeholders. Likewise, you’ll play a lead role in managing the organisational structure for each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.

Your attendance at project meetings is necessary, and you’ll be expected to create project-related reports, analyses and reviews. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail is crucial; this role needs someone who is good at forecasting project expenditure and ensuring effective management of project budgets.

Building strong client relationships

We live and breathe client satisfaction. We therefore need someone who shares the same passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.

Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll also see to it that project revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.

Upholding excellence in project delivery

For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong focus on health & safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front-of-mind at all times.

Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.

An expert in the field

Our project management teams are tech-savvy and digitally enabled. We are the digital leader in project management, so it’s important that you help drive the effective use of JLL technology platforms to deliver our projects.

An empowering colleague

In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the ideal candidate is expected to promote open and constructive relationships with superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. title: ETCH Customer Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Location:

Pyeongtaek-NF Summit,KOR

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment

  • Use digital analytics for troubleshooting

  • Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]

  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)

  • Coordinate and communicate directly with customers

  • Fulfill additional duties, as assigned


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification

  • 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges

  • Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics

  • Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.

  • Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field


Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Additional Information

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 20% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

No

대표와 함께 신규 프로젝트·사업을 기획·실행하고 대외 파트너십을 조율하여 멘토리의 전략적 의사결정과 실행을 가속화

Requirements

Benefits

title: Overnight In-Room Dining Server
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Write your own music city story. Let us show you the real Nashville, connecting you to the creative spirit of the city’s artisans. Four Seasons is the new social hub of downtown Nashville’s SoBro neighbourhood, just steps from music, sports and entertainment. Feel the rhythm of our vibrant restaurants and event spaces, and the harmony of our Spa and rooftop pool – celebrating nature with views of the Cumberland River and Riverfront Park. With unparalleled Four Seasons service and warm Southern hospitality, we’ll inspire a truly authentic experience of Music City.

About the role
At Four Seasons Nashville, our Overnight In-Room Dining Server plays a key role in delivering exceptional dining experiences directly to our guests’ rooms. This position is responsible for providing personalized, knowledgeable, and efficient food and beverage service while ensuring every guest interaction reflects the highest standards of luxury hospitality.

What you will do
• Deliver food and beverage orders to guest rooms promptly and accurately, ensuring food quality and presentation standards are maintained.
• Verify all orders against guest requests and ensure special instructions are completed correctly before delivery.
• Engage with guests in a professional and welcoming manner, providing detailed descriptions of menu items, ingredients, and preparation methods.
• Anticipate guest needs, respond promptly to requests, and create memorable dining experiences through personalized service.
• Coordinate tray and dishware removal in accordance with established service standards and guest preferences.
• Set up, maintain, and clean room service stations, tables, flatware, dishware, and condiment displays to ensure operational readiness.
• Utilize mobile technology and hotel operating systems to support service delivery and communication.
• Accurately process guest checks, obtain required signatures, and handle voids or complimentary items according to company procedures.
• Assist with taking guest orders and preparing simple food items when needed to support operational requirements.
• Collaborate effectively with team members and supervisors while maintaining compliance with Four Seasons policies, procedures, and service standards.

What you bring
• Previous food and beverage, restaurant, room service, or hospitality experience preferred.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a passion for delivering exceptional guest service.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and professionalism.
• Basic knowledge of food and beverage service standards, menu items, and dining etiquette preferred.
• Ability to stand, walk, lift, and transport food and beverage items throughout the shift.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
• Excellent training and development opportunities
• Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide
• Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
• Complimentary Employee Meals
• Additional property-specific benefits and wellness programs, where applicable

Schedule & Hours:
• Full-time opportunity available based on business needs
• Flexible schedule required, working only overnight shifts.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Lasten kotisairaalaan
description:
Sairaanhoitaja, tule meille töihin Lasten kotisairaalan akuuttipuolelle!

Hoidamme Lasten kotisairaalassa akuutisti sairastuneita tai lyhyitä hoitokontakteja tarvitsevia lapsia ja nuoria heidän kotonaan. Kotisairaalan hoitajana mahdollistat lapsen kotihoidon sairaalahoidon sijaan.

Työ on pääosin kotikäynneillä tehtävää kaksivuorotyötä viikon jokaisena päivänä. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä potilaan ja hänen perheensä kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta innostunutta työotetta ja halua olla mukana kehittämässä toimintaa yhdessä osaavan hoitotiimin kanssa. Arvostamme asiakaslähtöistä, kehitysmyönteisyyttä sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja.

Kokemus työskentelystä lasten erikoissairaanhoidossa katsotaan eduksi paikkaa täytettäessä. Tarjoamme yksilöllisen perehdytyksen, sekä monipuolista koulutusta jatkuvasti kehittyvässä ja monien mahdollisuuksien toimintaympäristössä. Tehtävä antaa myös mahdollisuuden kehittyä lasten palliatiivisen hoidon asiantuntijaksi.

Kotikäyntejä varten tarvitset ajokortin. Kotikäynneillä sinulla on sairaalan auto käytössäsi. IV-lääkeluvat tulee suorittaa nopeasti. Tutustu työskentelyyn lastenyksiköissä: https://www.hus.fi/tietoa-meista/ura-husissa/hoitajaksi-husiin/hoitajaksi-lastenyksikoihin

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3218,18 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mom. mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rekisteriote.

title: Research Analyst
description:
The Research Analyst plays a key role in managing property and market data, delivering insightful analysis to support both internal stakeholders and external clients. The position also contributes to enhancing the Colliers brand through the development of research reports, marketing collateral and PR activities.

Integral to the role is close collaboration with multiple Colliers teams, department heads and stakeholders across the business, ensuring the collection, integrity and ongoing improvement of high-quality data across relevant markets and sectors.

Some of the Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Collect and analyse property market indicators across multiple sectors and markets to produce quarterly market commentary for internal and external distribution.
  • Manage the ongoing aggregation and maintenance of comparable sales and leasing evidence, property market trends and general property information.
  • Contribute to thought leadership research, presentations, publications and PR opportunities.
  • Support the development and implementation of technology strategies that enhance the Research business.
  • Collaborate with the National Research team and industry experts to improve datasets, identify trends and drive new data initiatives.
  • Assist in maintaining the accuracy and integrity of property market data across relevant sectors and markets.

You will bring a genuine passion for the property industry, supported by relevant qualifications and/or early career experience in research, analytics or a property-related field.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A degree in Property Economics, Economics, Finance or a related discipline (completed or in your final year of study), and/or 1–2 years' experience in a Research Analyst, property, data analytics or similar role.
  • An interest in property markets, market research and data analysis.
  • Proven experience in data management and analytics, highly regarded.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office skills, with advanced Excel capability highly regarded.
  • Experience using Power BI, mapping tools or other data visualisation platforms preferred, though not essential.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • A collaborative and proactive approach, coupled with a genuine interest in building professional relationships.

What's in It for You?

  • A wide range of benefits designed to support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle.
  • Exposure to multiple sectors of the property industry, providing excellent career development opportunities.
  • Industry-leading leave benefits, including additional paid leave, volunteering leave and loyalty leave.
  • Structured career development, learning opportunities and recognition programs.
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
  • Access to innovative technology and tools that support productivity and growth.

If you're looking to build your career in property research and gain exposure to a broad range of asset classes while working with some of the industry's leading experts, we'd love to hear from you.

We foster an environment in which everyone at Colliers feels respected and comfortable bringing their authentic selves to do their best work. It’s our people who set us apart and we actively recruit people who represent the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We take great pride in doing what’s right and operating in ways that benefit the business, our people, our clients, our communities, and the environment.

Experts join experts, and we welcome you to join us as we lead the industry into the future.

title: Controls Engineer (Early - Mid Career)
description:

Employees must be willing to travel up to 40% to customer locations in the USA.

We offer:

  • Pay Transparency
  • Global Opportunities

Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer

Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $82,500.00 - $133,100.00 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:

What You Do In This Role:

  • Interact directly with the customer on site.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Current hands-on experience with Programmable Logic Controllers. Expertise with Allen Bradley, Schneider Unity, or Siemens TIA Portal preferred.
  • Must demonstrate a working understanding of design, layout and use of current networks such as Profibus, ASi, and Ethernet.
  • Experience in writing descriptions of operations and developments of controls based physical layouts is expected.
  • Proficient with AutoCAD Electrical preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage numerous opportunities and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Current experience with the rigors of on-site startup/commissioning.
  • Experience with material handling systems is preferred.
  • 2-8 years of successful experience in related field and successful demonstration of responsibilities as presented above.
  • Advanced degree MAY be substituted for experience, where applicable
  • Travel can range anywhere from 25% - 40% depending on the project and is typically on weekends and possibly over some holidays.

About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

A secluded oasis at the edge of an idyllic lagoon! On the east coast of Mauritius, lapped by turquoise waters perfect for water sports, our relaxing Resort is filled with lush greenery and dramatic views everywhere you turn. Each stylish villa and residence feature its own private garden and pool – just like the home for the Resort’s resident giant tortoises. The east coast of Mauritius is one of the most beautiful and peaceful parts of the island. It’s known for its long stretches of white sandy beaches, clear turquoise lagoons, and calm atmosphere.

title: Animal Care Specialist
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Companion Animal Specialist, you are the primary expert and advocate for the health, welfare, and proper care of companion animals and aquatic life within the Pet Care Center (PCC).

You ensure exceptional animal care and habitat maintenance while supporting sales, merchandising, and inventory execution. In close partnership with the sales team, you help deliver outstanding customer experience by combining deep animal-care knowledge with strong operational discipline. This role is ideal for someone passionate about animal welfare who enjoys teaching others and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Ensure the health, safety, and proper care of all companion animals and aquatic life in accordance with Petco standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Complete and verify required animal care tasks, including hourly animal health checks, wellness documentation, maintenance logs, and incident reports.
  • Ensure proper handling, documentation, and care of relinquished and adoption animals.
  • Serve as the primary resource for animal care education for customers and PCC partners.
  • Adhere to and promote all safety, animal welfare, and loss prevention procedures.

Foster the Fun

  • Deliver knowledgeable, compassionate, and solution-focused service to customers.
  • Actively support customer interactions using Petco’s selling model.
  • Promote a culture of teamwork, inclusion, and collaboration across the PCC.
  • Mentor and educate partners on animal care standards, maintenance routines, and best practices.
  • Maintain professional, clean, and well-presented animal habitats and aquatic areas.

Let’s Go!

  • Support the achievement of department sales, margin, and shrink goals.
  • Ensure merchandise is stocked, priced, and displayed to Petco standards, with a primary focus on companion animals and aquatics.
  • Efficiently order live animals, supplies, and related merchandise in partnership with the sales team to support inventory integrity and business goals.
  • Analyze inventory data and identify opportunities to improve in-stock levels, shrink, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in animal and aquatic-related physical inventory counts.
  • Assist with opening and closing procedures as assigned.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as needed to support Pet Care Center operations.

Key Responsibilities

Animal Care & Maintenance

  • Verify all animal care and maintenance tasks are completed according to established schedules.
  • Perform routine housekeeping duties, including cleaning habitats and tanks, sweeping and mopping floors, dusting, and facing merchandise.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, operational, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Sales Support

  • Process register transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Evaluate customer needs and escalate concerns to the Leader on Duty when appropriate.
  • Support Omni-channel and in-store initiatives through consistent execution and customer engagement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Animals are healthy, safe, and cared for to Petco’s highest standards.
  • Customers trust the team’s expertise and return for guidance and solutions.
  • Animal habitats and aquatic areas are clean, compliant, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory and merchandising support sales while minimizing shrink.
  • Partners feel supported and informed through shared animal-care knowledge.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with or caring for companion animals and aquatic life.
  • Strong knowledge of animal care, husbandry, and maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to educate others and communicate effectively.
  • Strong customer service mindset with an aptitude for selling behaviors.
  • Basic business, math, and inventory management skills.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Completion and ongoing maintenance of the Petco Animal Care Certification Program required.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment and requires active engagement on the sales floor.

  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • A welcoming, inclusive team environment.
  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and explore career paths.
  • A fun, fast-paced role where no two days are the same.

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

title: Sr Prod Dev Engineer
description:
The Product Development Department is responsible for turning creative concepts into tangible, high-quality products that delight consumers and drive brand growth. We manage the end-to-end development process, collaborating closely with design, engineering, sourcing, and marketing teams to ensure every product meets aesthetic, functional, cost, and safety standards. The position focuses on new product introductions, improving yields and maintaining quality for all assigned products to ensure customer expectations are exceeded.

The Opportunity:

Mattel Brick Shop is seeking a Senior Product Development Engineer to support the development of innovative construction toy products from concept through production. Working closely with Product Development, Design, Quality, Packaging, and Manufacturing teams, you will help ensure products meet requirements for quality, performance, manufacturability, and cost while supporting successful launches to market.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Support the engineering development of construction toy products from concept through production launch.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners throughout the development process.
  • Manage Engineering Pilot (EP) and Final Engineering Pilot (FEP) builds, helping to identify and resolve complex technical issues before production.
  • Manage prototype and production sample builds, incorporating design, engineering, and quality feedback.
  • Review engineering documentation, drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs) for accuracy and completeness.
  • Support tooling development, mold qualification, and production readiness activities.
  • Track project milestones and follow up on action items to support on-time delivery.
  • Partner with Quality and Manufacturing teams to support product approvals and production sign-off.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to product quality, cost, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Coach and guide junior engineers, if needed.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience in product engineering, product development, building set development, or a related industry.
  • Understanding of product development and manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of plastic part design, tooling, and injection molding is preferred.

description:
AECOM is seeking an Environmental Engineer to support a large ongoing project at our client site in Ashland, Wisconsin, with opportunities to support additional projects. The successful candidate must be local or willing to relocate to the Ashland, WI area. In this role, you will assist and learn directly from the current site lead, gaining hands-on experience in environmental project delivery. You will support environmental field work and contribute to environmental technical reports under the guidance of experienced staff.

Responsibilities will include, but may not be limited to the following:

  • Support AECOM projects in the areas of contaminated sediments, soil and groundwater remediation, environmental compliance, and Environmental Social and Governance (ESG)/Sustainability initiatives.
  • Work with and learn from the current site lead and senior staff to provide technical analysis and deliverables for remedial investigations, feasibility studies, remedial design, remedial action, fate and transport modeling, innovative sampling approaches, etc.
  • Assist with planning and directing field activities for data collection and data management, under the mentorship of the site lead.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with client contacts, suppliers, contractors, engineering consultants, academia, and external agencies.
  • Engage in internal Technical Practice Groups, coordinate with company’s regional and national experts, and pursue professional development.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Operate equipment such as skid steers and excavators (training provided as needed).
  • Assist in directing subcontractors and perform basic supervisory work.
  • Screen soil and debris for contaminants.
  • Perform manual digging.
  • Collect soil, sediment, groundwater, surface water, and air samples.
  • Manually process residual solid products (e.g., size and wet).
  • Document work completed.
  • Conduct general operation and maintenance tasks.

    Minimum Requirements

    • A Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field.
    • Valid U.S. driver's license. Subject to a Motor vehicle records check
    • Successful candidate will have to pass a background check and a drug screen.
    • Due to the nature of the role, we will not be able to provide any sponsorship at this time or in the future.
    • US citizen or permanent resident.
    • Successful candidate will be enrolled in a medical surveillance program.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • HAZWOPER 40 Hr Training
    • Prior experience in environmental field data collection including drilling, soil logging, well installation and soil, groundwater, vapor sample collection, and/or remediation system operations, maintenance, and monitoring.
    • Master’s Degree is a plus.
    • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Coursework or experience providing knowledge relevant to waste management, environmental site assessments, environmental site investigation and characterization, and environmental remediation is preferred
    • Knowledge of environmental sampling practices

  • Participate in the structural design of transportation infrastructure facilities, including airports, railway systems, metro and BRT stations, maintenance workshops, operational buildings, electrical substations, and related infrastructure through the development of structural analysis models, engineering calculations, technical reports, and design documentation.
  • Perform structural design of reinforced concrete and structural steel systems of buildings and civil works, considering operational loads, dynamic effects where applicable, serviceability, durability, constructability, and lifecycle performance. Ensures that project technical goals/milestones/ budgets are met
  • Works independently with latitude to determine work priorities and receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Performs technical quality reviews including documentation in project record in accordance with policies and procedures
  • Serves as Lead Verifier on projects confirming that the technical approach satisfies the client scope of services and expectations
  • Engages with project technical teams within field of expertise to confirm project approach and review deliverables
  • Use client credibility gained from delivering high-quality technical services to expand work assignments
  • Communicates with clients to discuss work scope, request information to support project execution, and receive client comments on draft work products
  • Develops solutions to complex and challenging issues using standard methodologies as a basis and defining new procedures as needed
  • Collaborate constructively with multidisciplinary teams construction disciplines, to ensure successful project delivery.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering with +6 years of relevant experience (YORE) or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Minimum of 6 years of proven technical experience in structural engineering, with a focus on the design of concrete and steel structures, in accordance with international standards and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Solid knowledge of structural analysis and design principles for reinforced concrete and steel structures used in buildings and civil work projects.
  • Familiarity with international structural design codes and standards such as ACI, AISC, ASCE, IBC, AREMA, AASHTO, Eurocodes, CSA, or equivalent,
  • Proficiency in structural analysis software such as SAP2000, ETABS, SAFE, MIDAS Civil, CSiBridge, STAAD.Pro, IdeaStatica, RAM Connection, or similar software. Experience with AutoCAD and BIM platforms is desirable
  • Advanced technical English.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in the structural analysis and design of transportation infrastructure facilities, including airport terminals, railway stations, metro stations, BRT stations, maintenance workshops, operational buildings, electrical substations, parking structures, and similar facilities.
  • Experience performing technical reviews and quality assurance (QA/QC) of structural calculations, drawings, and specifications.
  • Experience evaluating alternative structural systems and providing recommendations based on constructability, cost, schedule, and risk.
  • Experience supporting proposals, client meetings, and technical presentations.
  • Experience identifying and mitigating technical risks throughout project execution.
  • Experience delivering projects under Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build delivery methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • English Level: B2• Senior technical resource may serve as technical advisor for team
    • Provides specialized technical input to studies and design for staff's specific area of expertise.
    • Develops study and design procedures to facilitate high quality cost effective work by others.
    • Participates in interdisciplinary review of project deliverables.
    • Develops construction cost estimates and estimates of technical efforts for projects.
    • Uses expertise in all steps of completing discipline component of PS&E package.
    • Performs quality control review of design calculations or drawings.
    • Prepares technical specification sections.
    • Provides input to the development of engineering budget and schedule to meet requirements.

title: VP Operations, Mechanicals
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Vice President, Operations (Mechanicals) is responsible for leading operations for Jabil’s Injection Molding products, Sterilization capabilities, and Healthcare customers with over $1B in revenue and headcount of approximately 4,000 workers across multiple locations. The successful candidate is a proven leader with experience overseeing manufacturing facilities across the U.S., bringing a strategic, agile mindset and a strong track record as a change agent in operations. They will help create and execute key strategies that move the site forward with great effectiveness in a complex and dynamic external landscape. The individual must be resilient and collaborative, who works well as part of a team and has the executive courage to challenge status quo, make difficult recommendations and decisions. They possess superior operations stewardship navigating the complexities of a dynamic global market, an operational excellence mindset, authentic leadership, and impactful communication and influence skills.

The VP, Operations (Mechanicals) is a strategic business partner to the SVPs and VPs of Global Business Units and Finance and plays a key role managing a strategic roadmap for operations at the site to meet customer demands and regulatory requirements, as applicable. They drive a shared vision with Global Business Units to achieve strategic objectives within the location. They cultivate strong partnerships with key stakeholders across Jabil to ensure that customer needs / demand is well executed at the highest level of quality while achieving optimal margin. They bring credibility, insight, and industry fluency to interactions with internal and external constituents including customers, industry partners, finance, and business units. The VP, Operations (Mechanicals) will be interpersonally adept and will inspire, motivate, and develop a team of top tier operational professionals. They lead as a consistent role model for others and message the importance of integrity and behaving in accordance with Jabil’s values, compliance, and ethical standards.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to:

EVP, Global Operations

Direct reports: 4

Other key relationships:

Plant Controller, Regional Controller

Regional Operations COE

Global Business Units

Functions (IT, HR, Supply Chain, etc.)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operations Strategy and Direction. Provide leadership and direction to the site Operations team, including profit targets, defining short- and long-term vision, setting strategy, and holding accountability to execute upon operational goals. Ensure company-wide policies are implemented within the operations.
  • Operations Management. Oversee all aspects of operations including manufacturing, supply chain, inventory, planning, and engineering. Execute demand at the highest level of quality while achieving optimal margin and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, as applicable. Ensure effective workforce & capacity planning to meet the dynamic customer demands; optimize resource allocation to maximize productivity and profitability.
  • Operational Excellence. Utilize deep industry knowledge for operational processes, foster efficiency, and innovation. Identify opportunities for process improvement; manage a portfolio of strategic initiatives across the locations and/or region driving automation, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  • Profit and Loss (P&L) Ownership. Responsible for overall profit and loss of the in-scope operations and ensure the attainment of financial and strategic operational goals. Monitor and react based on financial performance against long-term strategic plans.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work cohesively with cross-functional teams to achieve collective goals, emphasizing a partnership mindset. Align with other senior leaders (Global Business Units, Supply Chain, IT, HR, etc.) on overall business objectives. Collaborate with Global Business Units, Sales, and Marketing teams to execute product innovation, capabilities and market expansion.
  • Strategic Partner. Serve as a key partner in strategic planning; ensure the linkage of those plans to annual budgets and forecasts. Bring your own perspectives and insights, and engage in constructive, challenging conversations that help move the business forward alongside the EVP, Global Operations, Global Business Unit Leaders, peer Operations Leadership Team, and customers.
  • Team Leadership. Provide strong leadership in recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent, ensuring Operations serve as an influential strategic partner to the organization. Mentor and develop talent, ensuring execution of succession and development plans. Instill a culture of respect, accountability, and innovation. Lead as a consistent role model for others by reinforcing the importance of integrity and behaving in accordance with Jabil’s values, compliance, and ethical standards.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE


Seasoned Leader

20+ years of progressive experience in operations and business unit leadership, with increasing scope and responsibility, including oversight of multi-site and large‑scale operations. Demonstrated ability to lead and direct multi‑disciplinary operations management teams to deliver financial performance, operational excellence, and the highest standards of quality.

Industry Focus

Executive leadership of operations with deep expertise in contract manufacturing, particularly within healthcare and other highly regulated industries, such as FDA-governed customers.

Operational Excellence Experience

Experience in a complex, global manufacturing business; demonstrated ability to lead manufacturing operations with over $1B in revenue across multiple locations. Hands-on experience managing a team, working closely with the business units, finance and other functions of a complex, low-margin global manufacturing business. Proven record of manufacturing optimization including automation, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.

In-Country Workforce Management

Seasoned executive with a strong track record of leading large, geographically dispersed operations across North America, combining regional market insight with cultural sophistication to build credibility, alignment, and performance across diverse teams.

Education and Credentials

A bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in operations, engineering, finance/accounting, or business management. An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus.

CRITICAL LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES

Driving Results

As the company continues to drive strategic transformation and better position the business for key growth opportunities, the successful candidate must possess passion and a strong sense of urgency about driving operations, results, and change. They will demonstrate a commercial and proactive mindset and will deploy a combination of strong execution and collaborative behavior to reach and exceed target goals, directing the company’s overall financial operations to maximize profits. They will do this by:

  • Acting to surpass goals for financial metrics and seizing opportunities to push the envelope when appropriate.
  • Setting continually higher goals for self and others, while reviewing performance and progress on a regular basis to ensure the team is achieving results and leveraging optimal systems and processes.
  • Demonstrating a passion for the company by focusing on the success of the organization and consistently acting out of a sense of shared responsibility, a sense of urgency, and ownership for the success of the entire enterprise.

Acting Strategically

The ideal candidate will be adept at highlighting and focusing on larger, longer-term issues in a rapidly changing environment. They will possess agile intellect and excellent business acumen and will partner with EVP, Global Operations and other organizational leaders on large scale strategic initiatives. They will do this by:

  • Explaining how changes in the regulatory environment, competitors, clients, and market segments affect the Company’s strategic objectives.
  • Establishing a long-term vision and executing against it; thinking globally and addressing issues locally while motivating a team to act with speed, commitment, and consistency.
  • Creating strategic plans that address specific market segments and opportunities.

Leading People

In an environment and company culture that emphasizes world class talent, the VP of Operations (Mechanicals) will bring an exceptional ability to attract, mentor, inspire and develop a diverse team. They will build strong relationships and rapport, empower teams, and hold individuals accountable for their work, while recognizing and rewarding achievements by:

  • Collaborating and openly debating with the team to manage projects, solve problems, discuss challenging issues, or learn more about critical issues as a group.
  • Bringing a critical and strategic view of talent management, aligned with the organization’s priorities. This includes an understanding of the needs and diversity of the organization’s current and future talent.
  • Building strong, diverse teams and robust succession plans.
  • Delegating roles thoughtfully to free self to work at a more strategic level.
  • Forge collaboration with each employee to establish clear, challenging performance goals and metrics that are linked with broader strategic imperatives.

title: Work Release Officer
description:
HENDRICKS COUNTY JOB DESCRIPTION


Title: Work Release Officer

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Department: Work Release

Supervisor: Work Release Sgt.


PURPOSE OF POSITION:

Incumbent is responsible for supervision of residents in a work release environment utilizing prescribed policies and procedures, ensures a secure, safe and humane environment for incarcerated persons.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Supervises residents.
  • Receives and processes all new residents.
  • Completes release processes.
  • Maintains control log of all activities during duty hours.
  • Provides personal supervision/observation of each resident.
  • Security checks of facility and grounds.
  • Reports any damage of work release property to supervisor.
  • Makes requests for supplies needed to maintain facility in a safe, clean and humane manner.
  • Completion of all resident records.
  • Review of control log daily.
  • Understand the incorporation of the Indiana Risk Assessment System (IRAS) with resident treatment.
  • Participate in Conduct Adjustment Board hearings as well as level system reviews.
  • Completion of all facility trainings as well as required annual training hours.
  • Trained in Cognitive Behavioral Change techniques.
  • Conducts searches and shakedowns.
  • Conducts body scans of all residents upon entering of facility.
  • Supervises all resident movement within the facility.
  • Controls all access to facility and maintain records of persons entering and leaving.
  • Provides surveillance via direct supervision, video and audio systems.
  • Controls and monitors emergency alert system.
  • Controls all work release access doors, lighting and water systems.
  • Create and maintain clear, definite boundaries with residents.
  • Monitors resident telephone and television use.
  • Writes resident disciplinary conduct reports.
  • Completes all warrant processes.
  • Utilize cognitive behavioral change techniques during interactions.
  • Perform urinalysis testing for Community Corrections/ Drug Court/Probation/Home Detention and Parole as needed.
  • Supervision of prescription medication storage and consumption.
  • Knowledge of policies, standard operating procedures, post orders
  • Use of Handle with Care when necessary.
  • Application of restraints: handcuffs, belly chains, leg/ankle restraints and black box.
  • Follow policies and procedures as set by the agency; and,
  • Follow dress code uniform standards.
  • Essential Employee during pandemic/epidemic
  • Provide modified care for residents affected by pandemic/epidemic
  • Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • High School Graduate or equivalent
  • Valid Driver’s License
  • At least 21 years old
  • US Citizen
  • No Felony Convictions
  • Must pass urinalysis test
  • Must have moderate computer skills
  • Must be technologically savvy
  • No previous substantiated PREA investigations; civil or criminal
  • Must be in alignment of skills assessment expectations

RESPONSIBILITY:

Incumbent must have a clear understanding of the expectations associated with County and Facility Policies and Procedures. Numerous safeguards and precautions exist to help maintain control of resident’s; however the probability of injury or death is faced daily. Controls exist to minimize errors, however, in this position; errors in judgment dealing with residents or in performance of duties could result in a liability to the Work Release Officer, the Agency and the County. Additionally, the inability to interact effectively with the public, courts or other agencies may have an adverse effect of the efficiency of this position. Incumbent supervises residents and reports directly to the Work Release Sergeant. Incumbent may be required to work evening/night hours, overtime, holidays and changing shifts/hours.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS:

Work relationships are with residents, immediate supervisor, co-workers, staff from other agencies, employers, family members, officers of the courts and the public in general.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Incumbent will be required to stand and/or walk for extended periods of time in order to provide staff and resident supervision or sit for an extended period of time. A variety of physical abilities will be required in order to supervise and participate in custody functions. Keen observation and hearing skills are necessary in order to ensure the safety and security of the facility. The incumbent will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and/or crawl. In addition, the incumbent may be required to climb stairs and/or ladders and walk on uneven ground. Physical effort may include restraining residents, driving, running and lifting and carrying up to 100lbs. The incumbent must be able to work up to sixteen (16) hours. Workplace environmental conditions may include: continuous noise conditions; heat—high temperatures that may result in body discomfort; cold—low temperatures that may result in body discomfort. Infectious disease exposure may be possible. Incumbent may be required to use restraint techniques as per agency policy and procedure.



Exposure to persons who may fall under one or all of the following conditions requiring the use of physical force:

  • Alcohol
  • Narcotics
  • Mental illness
  • Violence
  • Emotionally disturbed

title: Product Design Engineer
description:
About Us:

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhances people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

Overview:

TP-Link Systems Inc. is seeking a talented and driven Product Design Engineer (Mechanical) to join our team. In this role, you will own the mechanical system architecture (internal layout, construction strategy, and assembly approach) and detailed mechanical design of next-generation consumer networking or smart home products.

You will take products from early concept through high-volume manufacturing, working closely with Industrial Design (ID), Electrical/Hardware Engineering, NPI/Operations, and external suppliers/contract manufacturers to deliver production-ready designs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product-level mechanical system architecture, including internal layout, part breakdown strategy, construction strategy, fastening/joining strategy, datum scheme, tolerance strategy, and serviceability.
  • Partner with Industrial Design (ID) to translate design intent into manufacturable mechanical solutions while balancing aesthetics, usability, reliability, schedule, and cost.
  • Collaborate with Electrical/Hardware Engineering to define mechanical interfaces and constraints, including PCB outline and mounting, connector/I-O access, assembly datums, fastener strategy, and key keep-outs (as applicable).
  • Support thermal and EMI-related mechanical integration, including thermal conduction/heat-spreading paths, shielding strategy implications (contact/compression features, gasket interfaces, conductive coatings), and grounding/contact reliability across tolerance and assembly variation.
  • Create and release deliverables using PTC Creo (Creo Parametric): 3D CAD, 2D drawings, specifications, and (preliminary and released) BOMs; apply GD&T and tolerance stack-up on critical interfaces.
  • Plan and support prototype builds and validation (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent): define build objectives and acceptance criteria; evaluate fit/function, cosmetic, key dimensions, and assembly robustness; drive issue closure through subsequent builds.
  • Lead supplier/toolmaker engagement including tooling kick-off and T0/T1/Tn iterations; coordinate mold tuning and dimensional/assembly issue closure with suppliers/CMs.
  • Drive DFM/DFA decision-making across manufacturing processes (injection molding, CNC machining, sheet metal, die casting, secondary ops/finishes), including cost/schedule trade-offs.
  • Own documentation quality and change discipline: release and maintain drawings/BOMs and drive Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) with clear revision control and supplier communication.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective actions for mechanical issues found during builds, in production, or from field returns.
  • Mentor early career engineers through design reviews, best practices, and hands-on coaching (scope/expectations vary by leveling).

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or related field; M.S. preferred.
  • 3+ years of mechanical and/or product design experience in consumer electronics or electro-mechanical products.
  • Strong proficiency with PTC Creo; able to independently produce release-ready part/assembly CAD, drawings, and BOMs.
  • Strong fundamentals in plastics/metals, injection molding, tooling iteration, tolerance/GD&T, and high-volume manufacturing considerations.
  • Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Willingness to travel up to support suppliers/CMs as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with compact, high-volume consumer electronics (routers/mesh nodes/gateways or similar products).
  • Experience working directly with CMs/toolmakers and closing issues through tooling iterations (T0/T1/Tn).
  • Familiarity with rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC prototypes, soft tooling) and hands-on build/debug support.
  • Familiarity with structural simulation/FEA and vibration/shock fundamentals.
  • Exposure to PLM/PDM tools and controlled release workflows.

For second and third-round interviews (but not for the initial recruiter screen), please be prepared to provide a portfolio (PDF) or be ready to present work samples via screen-share. Confidential details should be redacted.

  • Work collaboratively and professionally with colleagues, supervisors, and managers

What you bring:

  • High School Diploma, preferably from a Tourism or Hospitality Vocational School

  • Basic Food & Beverage knowledge

  • Positive attitude and strong communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Ability to safely lift and carry trays and room service equipment

  • Basic English skills are preferred

  • Commitment to maintaining Five-Star hospitality standards

What To Expect:

  • Excellent Learning and Development opportunities

  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Business Attire

  • Complimentary Indoor Parking Privileges

…and so much more!

description:

Job Summary

In consultation with their Principal Investigator (PI), undertake and execute a program of scientific study culminating in publication. Drives research projects scientifically and determines the course of research as evidenced by leadership, obtaining funding, writing, or other recognition. May not necessarily receive independent resources; however, their contribution is essential to the conceptual/scientific success of the project. They assist their PI in the training and supervision of other laboratory personnel and in a wide variety of administrative tasks, as necessary.

Does this position require Patient Care? No

Essential Functions
-Makes proficient intellectual contributions to scientific strategies of the group/lab and plays a leadership role by acting as subject matter authority in the field.

-Contributes to the design and execution of experiments and/or research projects.

-Exercises judgment in selecting methods and technologies to obtain results.

-May collaborate with external researchers and/or receive external project funding support.

-Presents results and prepares publications.

-May assist PI in the training and supervision of other staff.


Qualifications

Job Description

Education Doctorate Related Field of Study required

Experience
Previous Research experience (inclusive of graduate and postdoctoral experience) 5-7 years required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Excellent research skills.
- Demonstrated evidence of specific scientific competence in field.
- Demonstrated broad knowledge of field.
- Evidence of potential for scientific creativity and original though.
- Able to exercise independent judgment and leadership.
- Ability to contribute to publications.


Additional Job Details (if applicable)

The Massachusetts General Hospital Cancer Center’s Process Development Laboratory seeks a full-time Process Development Scientist I to support and advance its translational cell and gene therapy research platform. The Process Development Laboratory is a highly integrated, innovation-driven facility dedicated to translating next-generation cellular immunotherapy and gene engineering technologies into clinically deployable manufacturing solutions. This position offers an exceptional opportunity for an independent and motivated scientist to serve as a scientific lead within a multidisciplinary translational team, working at the interface of biology, engineering, manufacturing science, and regulatory strategy.

The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, optimization, and clinical translation of novel manufacturing workflows poised for IND-enabling studies and early-phase clinical trials, while operating in a collaborative academic medical center environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Demonstrated experience in cell and/or gene therapy research and process development.

· Hands-on experience working with primary human cells, preferably immune effector cells.

· Strong foundation in cell culture, molecular biology, and translational experimental design.

· Experience with CAR T-cell or immune effector cell manufacturing.

· Familiarity with CRISPR/Cas-based genome editing technologies.

· Experience with viral vector production or gene delivery platforms.

· Exposure to cGMP environments, IND-enabling studies, or regulated manufacturing settings.

· Experience with closed-system or automated manufacturing platforms.

· Prior experience contributing to regulatory documentation, technology transfer, or validation activities.
