title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Visual Suite Platform (AU remote)
description:
About the Group/Team

We're the Productivity group within the Design Experience supergroup. We build the surfaces people use to organise and act on information in Canva: Sheets, Tables, Docs, Whiteboards, Presentations, Websites, and Email. Right now, we're focused on using AI to automate whole user flows, not just bolt on smart features. We want to invent what productivity looks like next, and rethink how the work actually gets done. We move fast and ship often, and we care about the details that make AI feel effortless. Our work touches millions of people every day, so getting it right matters.

About the Role/Specialty

This role drives AI strategy from a product perspective: identifying where ML and AI create the most value across Productivity's user journeys, and shaping how those AI-enabled experiences get built. A core current focus is toolifying existing Productivity functionality, wrapping it so LLMs and agents can use it to complete real user tasks. You will manage your time between scoping unstructured product and technical problems, setting patterns other engineers build on, partnering with product to shape where ML has impact, and mentoring engineers to raise the technical bar.

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

  • Identify and drive where ML/AI creates the most value across Productivity's user journeys
  • Toolify existing Productivity functionality so LLMs and agents can act on it
  • Partner with product, design and other engineering teams to shape AI strategy for Productivity
  • Set technical patterns and standards for how ML/AI gets applied and shipped across the team
  • Unblock organisational-level technical challenges that a single team can't solve alone
  • Mentor engineers and help raise the craft of applied ML engineering across the group
  • Balance speed and rigour, shipping AI features that hold up at Canva's scale
  • Translate shifts in user needs and the product roadmap into ML/AI priorities
  • Set the AI direction for the Productivity group and empower engineers across teams to own delivery against it

What we're looking for:

You've got hands-on experience applying ML/AI to real product problems in production, and you're comfortable owning technical direction without needing everything handed to you. You're genuinely method-agnostic: as happy building a well-tuned classical model as adopting the latest technique, whatever gets the job done. You work well across teams, and you're just as happy influencing a roadmap as you are writing code. You're pragmatic: you'd rather ship something useful and iterate than chase a perfect model nobody uses. You want to find and drive where AI actually helps people get things done.


What the candidate will learn & how will they develop at Canva:

  • Apply ML at the scale of Canva's global user base, where a small improvement can change how millions of people work

  • Shape ML architecture and technical standards that get reused across the Design Experience supergroup

  • Own increasingly ambiguous, cross-team problems and build the judgement to set technical direction, not just execute against a brief

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring, growing your ability to shape a team's technical bar

  • Sharpen your product instincts by measuring ML work against real usage and impact, not just model performance

Don't tick all the boxes? Don't worry about that - nobody does!

We’d still love to hear from you! At Canva, we know that great engineers come from a variety of backgrounds, and we value passion, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as specific experience. If you're excited about this role but don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply, you might a great fit in ways you didn’t expect!

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

All interviews are conducted virtually

title: Lähihoitaja Diagnostiikkakeskus Radiologia
description:
Tervetuloa lähihoitajaksi Meilahden röntgenpäivystykseen!

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3300 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 140 toimipisteessä.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen tehtäväkuvan radiologian vastuualueella. Lähihoitajana työ sijoittuu ensisijaisesti Meilahden röntgenpäivystyksen ultraääneen. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa sekä viikonloppuisin. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä myös muualla Meilahden ja Siltasairaalan röntgenin alueella. Työtehtäviisi saat perehdytyksen.

Näillä ominaisuuksilla sinulla on parhaat edellytykset onnistumiseen tehtävässä:
* hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaidot
* joustavuus ja paineensietokyky
* nopea ja tehokas työtehtävien haltuunotto
* hyvä kotimaisen kielen kirjallinen ja suullinen taito, sekä toisen kotimaisen kielen tyydyttävä kirjallinen ja suullinen taito

Tarjoamme sinulle:
* kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi
* mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatillisesti ja luoda urapolkuasi eteenpäin
* työnantajan tukeman lounaan
* liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun ePassin muodossa
* vuokrattavia työsuhdeasuntoja
* mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi yhteisöllisen ja toimintalähtöisen työvuorosuunnittelun kautta
* mukavat ja ammattitaitoiset työkaverit.

Lähihoitajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2716,25 euroa kuukaudessa ja mahdollinen työkokemuslisä. Käytössämme Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa on myös suoritepalkkaus, jolla on mahdollista korottaa kuukausiansioita.

Työn aloitus on 1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Haethan tehtävää siis mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 12.8.2026.

Tervetuloa työkaveriksemme!

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai perushoitajan tutkinto.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: Test Management, Analyst
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone.

If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About the Role

Responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure system enhancements and digital solutions meet business requirements and quality standards. Works closely with stakeholders to identify defects, mitigate risks, and support successful implementation.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop clear and comprehensive User Acceptance Test (UAT) plans, test cases, and test scenarios for digital projects and system enhancements.
  • Review business requirements and functional specifications to ensure test coverage and completeness.
  • Liaise with stakeholders to ensure test environments, test data, and prerequisites are prepared prior to test execution.
  • Execute UAT activities and validate system functionality against business requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify defects, gaps, and areas of risk.
  • Log, track, and monitor defects through to resolution, working closely with project teams and developers.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure defect fixes and enhancements do not impact existing functionalities.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, test outcomes, risks, and issues to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate and coordinate UAT sign-off by ensuring all critical functionalities have been tested and agreed acceptance criteria are met.
  • Review and obtain stakeholder approval for UAT plans, test results, and deployment readiness.
  • Prepare user guides, testing documentation, and training materials where required.
  • Conduct end-user training and support users during implementation and post-deployment activities.
  • Support continuous improvement of testing processes, methodologies, and documentation standards.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), or related roles.
  • Proven experience in executing end-to-end UAT activities for system enhancements and digital projects.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test planning, test execution, and defect management processes.
  • Experience creating UAT test plans, test cases, test scripts, and testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project delivery methodologies.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of defect tracking and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple testing activities and deliver within tight timelines.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience in the insurance, financial services, or banking industry will be an added advantage.
  • Professional certifications in software testing (e.g., ISTQB) will be an added advantage.

Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

You must provide all requested information, including Personal Data, to be considered for this career opportunity. Failure to provide such information may influence the processing and outcome of your application. You are responsible for ensuring that the information you submit is accurate and up-to-date.

description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

  • CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Schreyer Honors College is seeking applications for a graduate level counseling internship with a focus on career counseling. The individual in this role will provide primarily in-person career counseling services to students. Students seek assistance developing internship and job search strategies, building strategic resumes, cover letters, LinkedIn profiles, and application statements. Students also seek assistance preparing for interviews, researching and applying for graduate and professional programs, and making choices from among multiple career options.
Students benefit from a counselor who can be a thought-partner in developing strategies, identifying resources, and designing an action plan that students can use to achieve their career goals. Further, students are well served by a counselor who can address some of the personal stressors that accompany career decisions and the pursuit of career goals. Supervision for this internship is provided by the Director of Career Development within Schreyer Honors College, and the person in this role is a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) and has more than 20 years of career counseling experience at Penn State. It is hoped that the intern will be able to provide up to 20 hours of employment per week, with most of that time dedicated to 1:1 student career counseling appointments.
There are opportunities for forming career counseling groups and also leading and mentoring students through providing workshops that facilitate personal reflection and career growth. Additional components of the internship include career counseling preparation, investigating resources, writing career counseling notes, contributing to career presentations and other Schreyer Honors College events and meetings, and engaging in weekly individual supervision. This internship will meet the requirements for a CACREP internship experience.
About Schreyer Honors College:
Schreyer is comprised of more than 1,800 undergraduate students who represent a wide range of Penn State’s academic colleges and majors. Schreyer Honors College represents approximately 2% of all Penn State students, and these students are admitted based on a range of factors that include strong academic performance and a commitment to completing an undergraduate research thesis project. Schreyer Honors College holds values of Empowered Growth, Global Intention, Courageous Discovery, and Inclusive Community. It is expected that applicants will be familiar with and supportive of working in an environment that encourages these values. More information about Schreyer Honors College can be found here: https://www.shc.psu.edu/about/mission-vision/
Required Qualifications:
  • Must be presently enrolled in either a Masters or Doctoral Degree Program in Counseling Education or a related field
  • Must be available to begin this internship on approximately August 18, 2026 and work through the conclusion of the Spring 2027 semester (May 7, 2027).
  • Must hold strong communication skills, both verbally and in writing
  • Must possess and apply strong interpersonal skills and show the capacity to build and maintain professional relationships with a range of students
  • Must possess a strong service orientation with a desire to be proactive in supporting students in their career development
  • Must be attentive to calendars, proactive regarding time management and maintain counseling notes on services provided
  • Must possess a strong team spirit and be willing to participate in Schreyer Honors College events such as orientation, graduation, and a range of student events that occur throughout the academic year.
  • Ideally will be eligible to drive a vehicle for occasions when transporting students to career networking events is necessary
All applicants are expected to submit a Cover Letter with their resume and also submit the names and contact information of 2 (two) professional references.

title: Principal Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

We are growing our cybersecurity response program to continue to deliver world class capabilities. Our team is building the Security Center of the future to further our customer’s confidence in our platform. This means we are continually innovating our investigative capabilities in the areas of incident response, digital forensics (DFIR), threat hunting, security automation, and data loss prevention. We respond quickly, efficiently and regain control by minimizing the threat of damage caused by malicious activities. We are a highly visible global security function that collaborates closely with multiple Workday teams. We work hard and push each other to constantly improve, but in an environment that is fun and considered the best company to work for.

About the Role

Workday is seeking a dedicated and proficient security professional possessing extensive security engineering and response expertise with knowledge on how to apply AI to security response processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to a highly visible team involved in all major cybersecurity events, where your skills and experience will be used to inspire confidence and trust in Workday.

This is a highly technical principal role with the understanding that you are already conversant in incident response, security automation, system security, network security, threat hunting, forensics, data loss prevention and artificial intelligence. Furthermore, this role leads the development and lifecycle support of the organization's response tooling infrastructure and associated environments. This role will push you to understand the inner workings of our SaaS platform and couple that with traditional security practices on premise. We have resources in every cloud, including our own. We offer a hybrid/flexible schedule for employees.

What you will do:

  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to set direction, motivate teams, and drive the security mindset across every aspect of the company.

  • Spearhead the architecture, daily operations, and continuous development of all security response tooling and environments (i.e. SOAR, SIEM, Incident Response, Forensics, Agentic AI).

  • Contribute to the program vision and implementation of a world class Response program at Workday.

  • Evolve the response platforms that enable Cyber Defense to operate with precision, automation and innovation.

  • Lead and support security incident response across the organization.

  • Help drive team development by mentoring new and existing staff.

About You

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity or information security roles, including 2+ years with hands-on technical leadership experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree.

Other Qualifications

  • Other relevant certification/s and training are beneficial (e.g. Offensive Security, SANS, CISSP, Specific Security Tooling, etc.).

  • Extensive expertise in architecting and deploying scalable cloud-native security solutions, complemented by a background in software development to facilitate implementation, with a particular focus on rapid prototyping and iterative methodologies.

  • Experience with security monitoring and incident response is important, as this knowledge will inform decisions on how to implement the solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of scripting languages, artificial intelligence (conversational AI, Generative AI and AI Agents) are essential.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects with various stakeholders outside of their organization, competing priorities, and core operations effectively.

  • High ownership and accountability, with comfort leading high-severity incidents.

  • A strong intellectual curiosity to rapidly acquire proficiency in emerging technologies and platforms.

  • Experience in some or all of the following:

    • Security alert triage, investigation, incident response, and incident management

    • Threat hunting and digital forensics

    • SIEM and SOAR security technologies and solutions

    • Leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance security processes

    • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)


Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.VA.Reston


Primary Location Base Pay Range: $184,800 USD - $277,200 USD


Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $167,200 USD - $300,000 USD

Additional Considerations:

If performed in Colorado, the pay range for this job is $176,000 - $264,000 USD based on min and max pay range for that role if performed in CO.

The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below:

08/16/2026



Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). title: Project Manager- Construction
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

As an on-site Project Manager supporting the Toyota Motor Manufacturing West Virginia facility in Buffalo, WV, you'll serve as JLL's representative embedded within one of the automotive industry's most advanced manufacturing environments. This role places you at the center of capital construction and renovation projects that keep the plant operating at peak performance. You'll manage projects from concept through completion, balancing scope, schedule, and budget while maintaining unwavering compliance with Toyota's rigorous Construction Safety Requirements. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and in this role, you'll do exactly that by building trusted relationships with plant leadership, contractors, and design teams. Your success will depend on your ability to proactively identify risks, communicate clearly across stakeholder groups, and deliver results that meet Toyota's exacting standards. This position offers the autonomy to manage your projects independently while being supported by JLL's broader Project & Development Services team and Toyota account leadership.

Location: Buffalo, WV

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage assigned capital projects and facility studies from initiation through closeout, maintaining control of scope, schedule, budget, and quality deliverables throughout the project lifecycle

  • Act as the primary on-site contact for general contractors, architects, engineers, and Toyota plant stakeholders, building collaborative relationships that keep projects moving forward efficiently

  • Develop and maintain detailed project schedules and budgets, monitoring progress against targets and escalating risks or delay drivers proactively to account leadership

  • Ensure strict compliance with Toyota Construction Safety Requirements (TCSR), including D-form approvals, contractor personnel certifications, and required on-site presence during high-risk activities

  • Lead or support bid leveling exercises, contractor selection processes, and change order review and negotiation to protect project budgets and timelines

  • Prepare and deliver clear, client-ready status materials including executive summaries, budget and schedule updates, and progress photography for weekly and monthly account reporting

  • Coordinate with the broader Toyota account team to manage cross-project scheduling conflicts and concurrent high-risk construction activities across the facility

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation in JLL's project management platforms (currently Adaptive Work, with ongoing transition planning and Toyota's separate adoption of Procore)

  • Travel periodically to other Toyota account locations and JLL team meetings to support knowledge sharing and account-wide coordination

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in construction project management

  • Minimum 5 years of experience managing commercial, industrial, or manufacturing construction projects with demonstrated success delivering on-time, on-budget results

  • Strong understanding of construction safety programs and protocols, with ability to enforce compliance requirements in an active manufacturing environment

  • OSHA 10-hour certification

  • Proficiency with project scheduling and budgeting tools; working knowledge of platforms such as Adaptive Work, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar project management systems

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise, professional status reports and presentations for senior client stakeholders

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities independently while maintaining attention to detail and quality

  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel periodically (10% to 15% of the time) to other project sites and team meetings as needed.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Direct experience working within manufacturing or automotive plant environments, ideally with exposure to lean manufacturing principles and operational protocols

  • Familiarity with Toyota Construction Safety Requirements (TCSR) or similar contractor safety management frameworks used in automotive manufacturing

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or other recognized project management credential

  • Experience managing projects in facilities that maintain 24/7 production schedules, including coordination of construction activities around operational constraints

  • Background working with design-build, design-assist, or IPD (Integrated Project Delivery) project delivery methods

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

title: Private Client Banker - East Towne Branch - Madison, WI
description:
You have a passion for taking care of our customers and employees and making them feel welcomed and valued by building lasting relationships, doing the right thing, exceeding expectations and having a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. Here at Chase, you will have the opportunity to help people experience our Customer Promise -- helping people make the most of their money so they can make the most of their lives by providing education and advice tailored to suit their financial needs.

As a Private Client Banker in Branch Banking, you are the main point of contact for a select group of Chase’s affluent clients as well as other customers in the Branch. You will manage their complete banking relationship across the company, utilizing a proactive and disciplined approach to generate growth in their balances. You will help acquire new clients by actively soliciting referrals and developing internal and external sources.

Job responsibilities

  • Shares the value of Chase Private Client with clients that may be eligible
  • Actively manages their banking relationship through an advice-based approach, ensuring each client receives the best products and services for their needs
  • Partners with Specialists (Private Client Advisors, Mortgage Bankers and Business Relationship Managers) to connect customers to experts who can help them with specialized financial needs
  • Makes lives of clients more convenient by sharing and setting up self-service options to access their accounts 24 hours a day/ 7 days a week
  • Adheres to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Demonstrated success using a value-added, relationship-oriented approach to acquire and deepen client relationships
  • 1+ year Branch Banking Banker or equivalent experience in financial services, with verifiable success in new client acquisition, cultivating, and maintaining customer relationships and revenue generation
  • Beginning Oct. 1, 2018, if you are not currently registered, the Securities Industry Essential (SIE) exam, FINRA Series 6/7, state registration (including 63 or 66 if required) and Life licenses are required - or must be successfully completed within 180 days of starting the role
  • Compliance with Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act*
  • High school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent
  • Adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements
  • Ability to work branch hours, including weekends and some evenings

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Excellent communication skills
  • College degree or military equivalent
  • Experience cultivating relationships with affluent clients
  • Strong team orientation with a commitment of long-term career with the firm

Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.

In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. Job Summary

Under the direction of the Director of Human Resources—Employee Relations, the Sr. Employee Relations Partner is responsible for advising managers and HR Business Partners (HRBPs) regarding complex employee relations situations and the interpretation of Human Resources policies, State/Federal employment laws and labor contracts. The incumbent will provide comprehensive internal employee consultation throughout BWH, conduct investigations, write reports, and present findings and recommendations. The incumbent will develop and evaluate overall employee relations trends/themes and proactively make recommendations to address root causes. The incumbent will work collaboratively with the Mass General Brigham Employee and Labor Relations Center of Excellence (COE) to discuss training needs and to assist in delivery training as appropriate on employee relations and labor issues. This guidance from MGB ER as needed, this position will partner with the HRBPs to implement recommendations to address employee relations issues. The incumbent will work closely with Partners Centers of Excellent (COEs) including the Employee Relations/ Labor Relations team as well as the Office of General Counsel.


Qualifications

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Manages HR Policies (terms and conditions of employment) development, revisions, counsel, interpretation, implementation and enforcement. · Provides leadership training and guidance around policy application where necessary.

· Conducts sensitive, confidential, objective and thorough investigations. Prepares reports of the findings, presents findings to specific audiences, and makes recommendations to address root cause issues. Reviews cases with Director of Human Resources, Employee Relations, as appropriate for investigation.
· Addresses concerns involving employees and POIs which impact the management of work. Works with HRBP team on strategic prevention plans around gaps or patterns following resolution of concerns.
· Provides counsel to operational leaders, managers, employees and POIs on: o policies, terms and conditions of employment o whether a policy has been violated o performance management concerns o performance improvement plans and efforts.
· Aid in appropriate corrective action, including assistance on drafting related feedback and conducting conversations with employees.
· Manage the exit process for voluntary and involuntary terminations, including the job elimination process. May participate in termination meetings with affected employees.
· Brings in COE expertise as needed regarding LOAs, etc.

Accommodations
· Manages ADA and Federal/State Pregnant Workers Fairness Acts accommodation requests.
· Conducts Interactive Dialogue process for standard accommodation requests including requests for religious, medical, or pregnancy related accommodations.

Complex Cases
· Partners with MGB ER/LR and OGC for consultation as needed on (non-leadership) complex ER cases, demand letters, and other proceedings as necessary.
· Supports ER/LR Center of Excellence and the Office of General Counsel with the preparation of a response to complaints filed with the MCAD, EEOC or other relevant agencies and attends and/or testifies at hearings and arbitrations as appropriate. Types of cases include:
· violence in the workplace · substance abuse
· abusive conduct
· asset or drug diversion
· compliance and privacy breach
· harassment
· discrimination based on protected classes
· conflict resolution.

Harassment & Discrimination Cases
· Investigates harassment and discrimination concerns submitted through all avenues including, but not limited to:
· Know the Line and United Against Racism Portal
· Compliance Line
· Safety Reporting System
· AskMyHR Portal
· Direct HR Contact
· Prepares reports of findings where warranted, presents findings, makes recommendations to address conduct and to review for root cause.
· Consults with managers on conflict resolution. Involves OMCOSS, EAP and/or DEI when appropriate.
· Consults with managers regarding implementation of investigation resolution.

Corrective Action Appeals & Labor Vulnerability
· Consults with managers on Corrective Action Appeal cases, gathers documentation, administers appeals and/or grievance process, reviews actions, schedules meetings, works with managers to evaluate merits of the appeal, works to closure including communicating with grievant.

Data & Analytics
· Using data including all workforce dashboards – identifies gaps, themes, trends and root causes impacting effective performance or delivery of services. · Using data and analytics, provides guidance and direction to managers to support a positive employee experience environment.
· Under the guidance of ER Leadership, conducts climate surveys to assess the general environmental tone within a department or between departments to determine areas of employee concern. Partners with HRBP and Manager to develop action plans to address issues.

Improvement Design
· Develops action plans working with the HRBPs and Learning & Organizational Development to address root causes.
· Educates employees, managers, and leaders at all levels about effective management practices and leadership styles.

Subject Matter Expertise/Other
· Maintains current body of knowledge of employment and labor laws.
· Maintains awareness of upcoming changes to employment law and ensures policy compliance.
· Collaborates with Strategic HRBP updated on all cases within their portfolios – maintains communication.

Performs all responsibilities of ER Partner plus:
· Provides mentoring and training to ER Partners.
· Assumes lead on various projects.
· Acts as subject matter expert.
· Possesses high level of experience in ER field.
· Harassment and discrimination cases

  • At least 3-5 years in Employee Relations/Labor Relations, or Human Resources Business Partner role demonstrating progressive experience and independence - Must have experience with employee relations issues and/or investigations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and HRIS web-based tools such as PeopleSoft

title: Genetic Counseling Specialist
description:
Join a dynamic team at the forefront of reproductive genetics, where your expertise will help gamete donors, intended parents, fertility providers, donor-conceived individuals, and their families navigate important reproductive and healthcare decisions throughout every stage of the family-building journey.

This is a clinical role responsible for determining initial and ongoing suitability for a gamete donor program by eliciting, evaluating, and documenting somewhat complex donor applicant family medical histories, reviewing and interpreting genetic testing results, performing document reviews, and collecting medical updates. Additional clinical responsibilities include eliciting and managing donor and offspring medical updates and coordinating additional routine donor testing. The Reproductive Genetics Specialist will participate in team meetings, performance/quality improvement projects, and complete other duties and/or projects that support the Reproductive Genetics team, as needed, and as assigned by the Manager. Communication is primarily internal and with donors; some communication with recipients and external providers is expected for somewhat complex and difficult cases.

Clinical Responsibilities (80%)


Donor Screening and Ongoing Donor Management:

  • Reviews and elicits preliminary personal and family medical histories of donor applicants to determine suitability for continuation in donor screening process.
  • Conducts genetic interviews (family medical history evaluations) of conditionally qualified donors. Completes all related paperwork, including pedigrees, medical profiles, and additional chart documents as needed.
  • Reviews and interprets somewhat complex and difficult donor medical histories to provide risk assessments and evaluate suitability for the donor program.
  • Provides information to donors about the genetic testing that is performed as part of the donor program. Obtains informed consent for routine and special testing and provides education regarding somewhat complex or difficult results.
  • Coordinates genetic testing and informs donors of test results. Provides education regarding positive and negative results. Refers donor to personal healthcare providers for more detailed counseling services and follow-up based on genetic test results or family medical history, as appropriate.
  • Enters and verifies genetic assssments, genetic test summaries, and other genetics-related information items.
  • Assists with performing final reviews of donor charts to ensure accuracy and completeness of a donor’s family medical history.
  • Adheres to departmental SOPs.
  • Collaborates with other departments effectively to allow for good donor and client experience.

Client Communications:

  • Communicates directly with recipients and/or healthcare providers in response to somewhat complex genetics-related inquiries. Assists in a phone queue during business hours to ensure timely responses to provider/client inquiries.
  • Documents communications with clients per standard operating procedures to ensure good record keeping.
  • Facilitates client special test requests and coordinates additional genetic testing of donors. Determines appropriateness of testing and provides follow-up to clients and donors regarding test results.
  • Collects and manages somewhat complex or difficult adverse outcome reports by receiving health updates on donor-conceived individuals, collecting relevant details, assessing risk and assisting in appropriate donor management, coordinating additional testing when indicated on donors, closing cases timely and efficiently, and documenting cases as required.
  • Collaborates with Senior and Lead GCs for review of complex donor histories and screening results

Secondary Responsibilities (10%)

  • Participates in department meetings by presenting or contributing to discussions regarding donor histories, results, and/or cases.
  • Contributes to genetic counseling projects as directed by Lead GC or manager with short term objective (<1 yr) that improve function of genetic counseling team.

  • Completes own continued education; logging and submitted CEUs required by organization granting board accreditation(s).

Additional Projects/Preparation for Advancement Opportunities (10%)

  • Participates in all areas of restriction/notification process with oversight from Senior or Lead GC.
  • Creates and collects informed consent from clients prior to receiving vials from donors with significant medical history information.
  • Completes departmental and product improvement initiatives under direction of the Senior or Lead GC.
  • Ability to appropriately and reliably handle complex clinical needs independently.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of and proficiency in MS Word and Excel. Aptitude for learning and becoming proficient in Navision or other computer software, as needed.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • High level of interpersonal skills to interact with clients, donor, peers and management.
  • Strong attention to detail in composing and proofing materials.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to work independently on daily tasks as well as in a group/collaborative environment.

Experience:

  • Proficient and practical knowledge in area of expertise, including tasks and processes.

  • 3 years prior experience which include 2 years professional education and 1 year, or more, of relevant genetic counseling work experience.

Education:

  • Master's degree from an accredited genetic counseling program
  • Board-certified with the American Board of Genetic Counseling (ABGC).

title: Facilities Executive Soft Services
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Facility Soft Services Executive

Position Overview

The Facility Soft Services Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing the delivery of soft services within assigned facilities. This role ensures high-quality service delivery, vendor management, compliance with service level agreements, and client satisfaction across all soft services operations.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery Management

Oversee day-to-day delivery of soft services including housekeeping, pest control, landscaping, waste management, security, reception services, and other non-technical facility services. Monitor service quality through regular inspections and audits to ensure adherence to established standards and client expectations. Coordinate with service providers to address service gaps and implement corrective actions promptly.

Vendor and Contract Management

Manage relationships with soft services vendors and contractors, ensuring contractual obligations are met. Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and maintain scorecards to track service delivery metrics. Negotiate service level agreements and support contract renewal processes. Ensure vendors comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations.

Client Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding soft services matters. Conduct regular client meetings to review service performance and gather feedback. Address client concerns and escalations in a timely and professional manner. Develop and maintain strong relationships to ensure client satisfaction and retention.

Budget and Cost Management

Assist in preparing and managing soft services budgets for assigned facilities. Monitor expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality. Review and approve invoices, ensuring accuracy and compliance with contracted rates. Prepare regular financial reports on soft services expenditures.

Compliance and Quality Assurance

Ensure all soft services operations comply with relevant regulations, policies, and industry standards. Maintain documentation including service schedules, inspection reports, incident logs, and compliance certificates. Implement quality assurance programs and continuous improvement initiatives. Coordinate health and safety audits related to soft services activities.

Team Coordination and Development

Supervise and coordinate soft services staff and contract personnel. Provide guidance, training, and support to ensure team members understand their responsibilities. Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, and continuous learning.

Reporting and Documentation

Prepare regular reports on service delivery performance, incidents, and key metrics for management review. Maintain accurate records of all soft services activities, contracts, and communications. Utilize facility management systems to track work orders, schedules, and service history.

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.

Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in facility management with focus on soft services operations. Experience managing multiple vendors and service contracts. Proven track record in client-facing roles within the facility management or property services industry.

Technical Skills: Strong understanding of soft services including housekeeping, security, landscaping, and waste management operations. Proficiency in facility management software and Microsoft Office Suite. Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to facility operations.

Competencies: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to build relationships at all levels. Strong organizational and time management abilities. Problem-solving mindset with ability to handle multiple priorities. Attention to detail and commitment to quality service delivery. Budget management and cost control capabilities. Client service orientation with focus on satisfaction and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional certification in Facility Management (IFMA, RICS, or equivalent). Experience in commercial real estate or corporate facility management environments. Knowledge of sustainability practices and green building operations. Familiarity with ISO standards relevant to facility management.

title: [모루라이브] DevOps Engineer
description:
About

모루라이브는 D2C 기반의 독립형 라이브커머스 SaaS를 제공하는 IT 기업입니다.

우리는 브랜드가 특정 플랫폼에 종속되지 않고 고객 데이터를 직접 소유하며, 자사몰 환경에서 라이브 방송, 상품 판매, 주문 및 결제, 고객 상호작용을 하나의 시스템으로 운영할 수 있도록 지원하고 있습니다.

여러 셀러가 동시에 서비스를 이용하고 라이브 방송 시간대에 트래픽이 집중되는 환경에서, 안정적이고 확장 가능한 인프라를 설계하고 개발·배포·운영 과정을 자동화할 DevOps 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다.

단순한 인프라 운영을 넘어 개발팀이 더 빠르고 안정적으로 서비스를 배포할 수 있는 환경을 만들고, AI 기반 도구를 활용해 반복적인 운영 업무와 장애 대응 과정을 개선하는 역할을 담당합니다.

모루라이브에서 사용하는 주요 기술 스택은 다음과 같습니다.

• Frontend: React, TypeScript
• Backend: Java 21, Kotlin, Spring Boot
• Infrastructure: OCI, AWS, CloudFront, Kubernetes, Docker
• Database & Cache: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
• CI/CD: GitHub Actions
• Tools: Git, GitHub

Responsibilities

1. 인프라 및 배포 자동화
• OCI 기반 클라우드 인프라와 Kubernetes 운영 환경을 설계하고 개선합니다.
• Terraform 등 IaC를 활용해 인프라 구성과 변경 과정을 코드로 관리하고 표준화합니다.
• GitHub Actions 기반 CI/CD 파이프라인을 구축하고 배포 및 롤백 과정을 자동화합니다.
• AWS S3와 CloudFront 기반 프론트엔드 배포 환경을 운영하고 최적화합니다.
• 개발자가 다양한 환경에 쉽고 안전하게 배포할 수 있도록 내부 개발자 플랫폼과 셀프서비스 도구를 구축합니다.

2. 서비스 안정성 및 보안
• 라이브 방송 시간대의 트래픽 증가에 대응할 수 있도록 확장 가능한 인프라 구조를 설계합니다.
• 로그, 메트릭, APM 및 알림 체계를 구축하고 장애를 탐지·분석·대응합니다.
• 장애 사후 분석을 통해 재발 방지 대책을 수립하고 운영 프로세스를 개선합니다.
• 접근 권한, 시크릿, 백업, 복구 및 감사 로그 등 인프라 보안 체계를 관리합니다.
• 클라우드 리소스의 성능과 비용을 분석하고 비효율적인 구성을 개선합니다.

3. AI 기반 운영 자동화
• Claude Code, Codex 등 AI 기반 개발 도구를 활용해 IaC와 운영 스크립트 작성 과정을 자동화합니다.
• 장애 원인 분석, 로그 분석, 런북 실행 및 반복적인 운영 업무에 AI를 적용합니다.
• 개발팀과 협업하여 AI 기반 인프라 운영 및 개발 생산성 개선 방안을 발굴하고 도입합니다.

Requirements

• DevOps, SRE 또는 클라우드 인프라 관련 경력 4년 이상이거나 이에 준하는 역량을 보유하신 분
• 퍼블릭 클라우드 환경에서 서비스 인프라를 구축하고 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• 프로덕션 환경에서 Kubernetes와 Docker를 운영하고 트러블슈팅한 경험이 있으신 분
• Terraform 등 IaC 도구를 활용한 인프라 자동화 경험이 있으신 분
• GitHub Actions 등 CI/CD 도구를 활용한 빌드 및 배포 자동화 경험이 있으신 분
• Linux, 운영체제, 네트워크 및 데이터베이스에 대한 기본적인 이해를 보유하신 분
• 하나 이상의 프로그래밍 또는 스크립트 언어를 활용해 운영 도구를 개발할 수 있으신 분
• 장애 상황에서 문제의 원인을 구조적으로 분석하고 신속하게 대응할 수 있으신 분

Preferred

• OCI 기반 서비스 인프라를 구축하거나 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• AWS S3와 CloudFront를 활용한 프론트엔드 배포 및 CDN 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 대규모 트래픽 또는 순간적으로 사용량이 증가하는 서비스를 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• SaaS, 멀티테넌트, 라이브커머스 또는 이커머스 서비스 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• Argo CD 등 GitOps 기반 배포 환경을 구축하거나 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Sentry 등 관찰성 도구를 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• 블루·그린, 카나리 또는 롤링 배포 환경을 구축한 경험이 있으신 분
• 클라우드 비용을 분석하고 실질적인 비용 절감 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분
• ISMS 또는 개인정보보호 관련 보안 점검과 인증에 대응한 경험이 있으신 분
• Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor 등 AI 도구를 실무에 적용해 개발 또는 운영 생산성을 개선한 경험이 있으신 분
• AI Agent, MCP 또는 사내 자동화 도구를 구성해 인프라 생성, 코드 리뷰, 로그 분석, 장애 대응 등의 업무를 자동화한 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

■ 자율 출퇴근제
• 오전 8시 ~ 11시 사이 자율 출근 후, 업무 책임을 기반으로 유연한 근무가 가능해요.

■ 자율 휴가제
• 필요에 따라 개인 일정 및 휴식을 위해 유연하게 휴가를 사용할 수 있어요.

■ 고급 장비 지원
• 일에만 집중할 수 있도록 M5 맥북, 4K 모니터 등 필요한 장비는 전부 지원해요.

■ 간식 무제한 제공
• 출출할 때 먹을 간식은 항상 준비돼 있어요.
• 먹고 싶은 간식이 있다면 언제든지 요청하세요!

■ 자기개발 강의 지원
• 클래스101, 인프런, 유데미등 다양한 강의를 지원해요.
• 꼭 직무 관련 강의가 아니어도 괜찮아요.

■ 세미나·컨퍼런스 참가비 지원
• 가보고 싶은 국내 세미나나 컨퍼런스가 있다면 참가비 전액 지원해드려요.

■ 사내 도서 구입 지원

• 사내에도 성장에 도움이 되는 책들이 많이 있어요.

■ 장기근속 휴가 제도
• 3 / 5 / 7 / 10년 근속 시 유급 휴가 5 / 10 / 15 / 20일을 추가로 드려요.

■ 생일 반차
• 생일엔 반차 쓰고 일찍 퇴근하세요!

■ 도전·성장 휴가
• 공부, 도전 등 나를 성장시키는 일에 쓸 수 있는 휴가를 지원해요.

title: Network Planning PM II, Amazon Fulfillment Experience
description:
Join us in designing and optimizing Amazon's end-to-end fulfillment network topology to deliver faster speed, lower cost, and higher capacity across the region. In this role, you will apply supply chain engineering and network modeling expertise to shape the physical and operational architecture of our transportation network, including node placement, lane structure, middle-mile routing, and capacity allocation decisions. Working within the Transportation and Network Planning team, you will have the opportunity to make significant impact by developing network design frameworks and infrastructure recommendations that define the future footprint and flow of our regional fulfillment operations.

As a Program Manager II, you will collaborate across multiple teams to evaluate and design network configurations that balance delivery speed commitments, cost-to-serve targets, and volume growth across geographies. Your ability to translate operational constraints and demand patterns into concrete network design proposals — from lane activation and deprecation to node coverage expansion and topology simplification will drive strategic planning across our fulfillment network. This position offers the chance to directly shape Amazon's transportation infrastructure and network evolution, working with talented professionals dedicated to building the most efficient, speed-optimized fulfillment network of the future.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and deliver complex, cross-functional programs focused on network design logistics and fulfillment operations, working autonomously while seeking guidance as needed.
- Develop and execute strategic business plans to improve delivery speed metrics month-over-month, making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources.
- Analyze supply chain data to identify optimization opportunities and develop solutions that enhance the end-to-end fulfillment network performance.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and partner teams to implement network improvements that balance operational efficiency with customer experience.
- Apply process improvement methodologies to enhance system quality and operational excellence across the fulfillment network.

A day in the life
Your typical day involves developing multiple business plans focused on speed metric improvements and tracking month-over-month performance. You'll analyze data from across the fulfillment network, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions. You'll participate in regular business reviews to share insights and progress updates, while also managing stakeholder relationships to ensure alignment on key initiatives designed to enhance our fulfillment capabilities.

About the team
We are the Fulfillment Experience team! Fulfillment Experience (FX) performs a centralized function supporting the MX Operations with data, plans, and required systems set up, taking care of the full flow of a customer order. FX team's responsibilities scope covers: Network Strategic Design, Network Transportation Planning, Program Management and External Fulfillment/Reverse Logistics Operations. Our goal is to develop a supply chain network that delivers customer orders in time, at the fastest, lowest cost, and most reliable way.

Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
Established in 2010, the Energy Research Institute @ NTU (ERI@N) is a pan-university research institute that focuses on systems-level research for tropical megacities. It performs translational research that covers the energy value chain from generation to innovative end-use solutions, motivated by industrialisation and deployment. ERI@N has multiple Interdisciplinary Research Programmes which focus on translational Research, Development & Deployment which focus on specific area of the energy value chain, and a number of Living labs and Testbeds which facilitate large scale technology deployment enabling validation and demonstration of real-world applications.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/erian

We are looking for a Engineer for supporting the development, testing, and validation of battery stacks and associated test rigs. The role focuses on developing test rig, electrical design, instrumentation, and performance testing to enable reliable stack characterization and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support development and electrical integration of battery stacks for laboratory and pilot-scale systems

  • Design, assemble, and maintain electrical test rigs for stack performance, durability, and safety testing

  • Conduct stack testing including OCV measurement, charge–discharge cycling, and performance analysis

  • Prepare and execute test procedures, record data, and generate detailed test and validation reports

  • Design and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts for stack test setups

  • Select, install, and calibrate sensors for voltage, current, temperature, pressure, and flow monitoring

  • Support FAT activities related to stack test rigs and subsystem validation

  • Troubleshoot electrical, instrumentation, and integration issues during stack testing

  • Support quality processes including QC, IPQC, and NCMR related to stack components and test setups

  • Collaborate with R&D, mechanical, and controls teams to improve stack design and test methodologies

  • Support commissioning and operation of stack test rigs in lab and pilot environments

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field

  • 1–3 years of experience in battery stack testing, R&D labs, or electrical test systems

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Hands-on experience with electrical test rigs, instrumentation, and power supplies

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD for test rig design and electrical for schematics and wiring diagrams

  • Knowledge of flow battery systems, power electronics, and control systems

  • Familiarity with PLCs, automation, and industrial sensors is an advantage

  • Strong documentation, testing discipline, and problem-solving skills

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Controller
description:
About Simbe

Simbe Robotics is a leading retail robotics company providing in-store intelligence solutions that help retailers optimize operations, improve shelf execution, and deliver valuable data insights. Our autonomous robots and multi-modal data collection systems are transforming how retailers manage inventory and make data-driven decisions.

The Role

Simbe is hiring its first Controller to build out the accounting function as the company scales. This is a hands-on role from day one — you'll get up to speed quickly on the business and how accounting operates today, including our existing outside accounting relationships, and start finding quick wins and areas to help right away. From there, you'll build the systems, processes, and controls that carry Simbe through its next phase of growth — enterprise scale-up, recurring annual audits, and early international expansion.

This is a builder's role: you'll design and stand up processes rather than inherit a mature function. You will work closely with the finance team to shape how Simbe's accounting operations scale from here, rolling up your sleeves early and taking on increasing ownership as the function matures.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the Close — Take oversight of the monthly close, starting hands-on with today's process and evolving it toward a 5–7 day close as ownership and systems mature.

  • Oversee Reconciliations & Technical Accounting — Provide oversight of reconciliations and technical accounting, and serve as the primary point of contact for the external audit — PBC list, workpapers, and the auditor relationship.

  • Build proper controls — for a company of Simbe's size and maturity.

  • Partner with FP&A — Work with the Finance Director and FP&A tooling (Planful) to support the forecasting build and keep it moving.

  • Oversee AR/Collections — Provide oversight of AR/collections performance, partnering with the finance data analyst to keep invoicing, cash application, and the collections cycle pacing with enterprise rollout volume.

  • Manage Outside Tax & Audit Relationships — Own the ongoing relationship with tax and audit service providers, including managing any transitions as the company scales.

  • Support Lender Reporting — Own reporting and covenant compliance on the company's existing debt facility.

    • Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, advancing through accounting leadership (Accounting Manager → Senior Manager → Director → Controller/Assistant Controller).

  • Prior experience operating as a Controller or Assistant Controller, ideally including having built or run the function at a smaller or earlier-stage company at some point in that track.

  • Prior experience in hardware, SaaS/subscription and/or hardware-as-a-service

  • Time at a company with a mature, at-scale accounting function — you know what "great" looks like from having seen it, not just built from first principles.

  • Comfort building process from scratch — this is a chance to build the function from the ground up, not inherit and maintain an existing one.

  • Audit experience, ideally including audits at an early-stage or high-growth company.

  • Systems fluency: QuickBooks Online (or comparable GL), an FP&A platform (Planful or similar), Bill.com, Avalara, and payroll/PEO systems.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tooling in close, reconciliation, and/or reporting workflows — not just awareness, but hands-on application.

  • Strong, direct communicator, comfortable presenting to the leadership team and, over time, the Board.

  • Venture-backed or other high-growth company experience

  • Exposure to multi-entity or international accounting

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA

  • Big 4 or public accounting background

    • At Simbe, you will be at the forefront of retail innovation, working with cutting-edge AI and robotics technologies to transform retail operations. Our culture is dynamic, inclusive, and driven by a passion for improving the way retailers operate and serve their customers. Join us to be a part of a team that is not only reshaping the future of retail but also offering immense value to our clients worldwide.

    Simbe Values: R.E.T.A.I.L.

    Result Driven - We are customer-centric and results-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors.

    Empathetic - We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally.

    Transparent - We highly value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.

    Agile - We are agile and always eager to learn. We quickly adapt to changes and customer needs.

    Innovative - We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design and user experience.

    Leaders - We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

title: Manufacturing Unit Controller
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Operations Finance Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead financial processes and transactions to optimize financial performance within the factory/site. Each day, you will support effective business decisions by monitoring, analyzing, and interpreting financial data to evaluate various business alternatives. You will also showcase your expertise by recommending the most appropriate business solutions.

This role is contributing to the EL smart power business in Xiamen China.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Serves as the key partner to MU managers in determining strategy for their area of responsibility and developing a global business model, aligning with wider strategy, implementing them, and adjusting, as needed.
  • Translates the finance strategy into business plans and establishes measurable targets.
  • Drive operation excellence and continuous improvement together with business.
  • Oversees the business planning and forecasting process for their area of responsibility.
  • Monitors progress achieved and provides insight and analysis to support operational decision-making.
  • Evaluates financial implications of business decisions, builds scenarios, and recommends actions to mitigate risks.
  • Drives appropriate cost structure, productivity optimization, and capital efficiency, with special focus on product/business line profitability, product costing, production variances, over/under-absorption analysis/inventory analysis, etc.
  • Ensures the quality of financial data and business information in line with defined standards and financial closing schedules.
  • Establishes and oversees processes and tools necessary to obtain transparent and reliable financial data and business information.
  • Define and implement internal controls on financial and non-financial operations
  • Ensures timely and efficient communication with relevant internal and external customers to identify areas of improvement, work quality and efficiency for their area of responsibility.
  • Defines and implements internal controls regarding financial and non-financial operations.
  • Liaise with external and internal auditors.
  • Ensure risk management processes are consistently implemented in their area of responsibility.
  • Manage, motivate and develop team. Build a strong and sustainable finance team.

Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor’s degree or above, majoring in Accounting, Auditing, Economics, Business Administration etc.
  • Business acumen to be strong business partner.
  • Above 8 years’ experience in relevant finance controlling experience, at least 2 years in management position.
  • Excellent communication skills, optimistic, patient, persevering, good inter-personal skills, with result orientation and customer orientation mindset.
  • Proven problem-solving capability.
  • Project management skills.
  • Knowledge of diverse financial functions and business processes is a plus.
  • Good command of English



More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and
manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Critical Facilities Technician
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Exciting opportunity: Critical Maintenance Technician!


Are you ready for an exciting challenge in a high-stakes environment? Join our team as a Critical Environment Maintenance Technician and become the guardian of vital business operations. You'll maintain and optimize crucial HVAC, electrical, and mechanical systems in facilities where failure is not an option. Your expertise will ensure seamless operations, energy efficiency, and minimal downtime. Showcase your primary technical skill while expanding your knowledge across multiple disciplines. If you thrive under pressure and love solving complex problems, this role is your chance to make a significant impact!


Here is some of what you will do:

Maintenance

  • Execute critical environment protocols and MOP processes
  • Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on facility systems
  • Operate and maintain HVAC, CRAC, electrical, and plumbing systems
  • Master building automation, fire/life safety, and related equipment
  • Conduct facility inspections and report on conditions daily

Safety

  • Complete hazard assessments and comply with safety procedures
  • Identify and address potential safety hazards
  • Maintain compliance with local ordinances, codes, and laws
  • Complete all required safety training

Administrative

  • Utilize CMMS systems for work documentation
  • Escalate issues to customers and management as needed
  • Attend work and safety meetings
  • Execute additional tasks as assigned

Here is who we are looking for:

Required

  • 4+ years of technical experience in all aspects of building engineering with a strong background in the technical aspects of packaged HVAC, plumbing, electrical, production equipment repair, and maintenance. Knowledge of overall system design and applications.
  • Working knowledge of computer applications including Word and Excel
  • Strong Customer Service and Interpersonal skills

Preferred

  • Experience working in Data Centers/ Critical environments
  • Two years of trades school or documented apprenticeship in electrical systems, refrigeration and HVAC, plumbing, or other craft skills.
  • Universal EPA Certification (or within 90 days of employment)

Physical work requirements and work conditions

  • Lift up to 80 lbs
  • Work at heights up to 30 feet
  • Climb, bend, kneel, stoop, and work overhead
  • Operate in extreme temperatures
  • Climb ladders with a 300 lb limit while carrying a 20 lb tool bag

On-site –Wilson, NC

title: Tree Care Crew Leader
description:
The Best Teams are Created and Maintained Here.

Job Summary

  • The Crew Leader Tree Care oversees daily tree care operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality service. This role provides hands-on leadership in pruning, cabling, bracing, lightning protection, and tree removals, while guiding crew members, maintaining equipment, and upholding company safety standards.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the tree care service activities of the crew
  • Ensure crew members have the required safety materials, training, and are operating safely at all times
  • Ensure that the work areas beneath and around the trees are clear and properly marked to protect the public from falling debris
  • Inspect and maintain climbing gear and tree care equipment to ensure all equipment and tools are safe and in proper working condition
  • Review and manage crew schedules
  • Complete daily pre-trip inspection reports before dispatch for all Class B equipment
  • Coordinate with branch management, customers, and employees
  • Safely operate tree & landscaping tools, as well as heavy equipment, as needed
  • Utilize proper pruning techniques; assist with trimming trees, clearing, and chipping tree debris, ensuring proper disposal

  • Familiarity with the techniques and equipment used in landscaping
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) class B
  • Experience managing a crew consisting of climbers and grounds men or related services
  • Supervisory experience
  • Ability to become certified in EHAP, First-Aid, and CPR
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong work ethic
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Bilingual (Spanish)

  • Ability to load/unload burlaps with plant cuttings onto trailer (up to 50 lbs.)

title: Kitchen Operations Associate, DashMart
description:
About the Team

DashMart Kitchens (DMK) is a dedicated culinary team operating within a shared DashMart facility. While we work inside a DashMart building, we are a specialized team focused on preparing high-quality meals for customers ordering through the DoorDash app.

We work side-by-side with our DashMart partners to deliver a seamless customer experience — supporting both kitchen execution and shared facility standards. We operate as one team within four walls, collaborating to ensure operational excellence, food quality, and a clean, organized environment.

Shifts: Morning, Day, Evening, Weekend, Part-Time

About the Role

As a Kitchen Operations Associate, you are responsible for preparing meals to standard, maintaining kitchen and warehouse organization, and supporting order fulfillment within a shared facility environment.

What You’ll Do

Meal Preparation & Quality

  • Prepare and assemble menu items according to brand and food safety standards
  • Ensure every meal meets quality, accuracy, and presentation standards before handoff
  • Follow all food safety, cleanliness, and dress code compliance guidelines

Warehouse & Kitchen Organization

  • Maintain organized dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage areas
  • Follow cleanliness and sanitation standards across shared workspaces
  • Support inventory organization and proper product rotation (FIFO)

Facility Support

  • Collaborate with DashMart Operations Associates to maintain a cohesive and efficient site
  • Assist with light operational tasks as needed to support overall facility success
  • Uphold a “One Team” mindset to create a positive experience for all team members and customers

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because…

  • You enjoy working with food and have a passion for culinary execution and quality while maintaining food safety
  • You want to be part of a dedicated kitchen team operating within a fast-paced fulfillment environment
  • Market competitive pay (10pm–6am will receive a $2 increase in pay)
  • AM/PM/Overnight shifts available
  • Opportunity for pay increases twice a year based upon performance
  • Paid time off (PTO) and sick leave
  • Gym membership reimbursement (up to $75/month)
  • Monthly DashPass subscription (including access to Lyft discounts for full-time employees)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Career advancement opportunities

We’re Excited About You Because…

  • You’re reliable, positive, and team-oriented
  • You have experience in food service (fast food and quick-service restaurants), grocery, or beverage operations, or a willingness to learn
  • You’re detail-oriented and passionate about fresh food quality and safety
  • You can lift up to 50 lbs and work in refrigerated areas (with or without accommodation)
  • You have a high school diploma or GED
  • You’re willing to complete a Food Handler’s Certification upon hire

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
