Job Description: Facilities Specialist

Job Title: Facilities Specialist
Department: Facilities Management / Environmental Health & Safety
Reports To: Facilities Lead/ EHS Manager/ Facilities Supervisor
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Añasco, J&J

Position Summary

This multifaceted role combines environmental health and safety management, pest control program coordination, and facilities planning functions to ensure safe, compliant, and operationally efficient workplace environments. The position requires a strategic mindset balanced with hands-on execution across safety compliance, vendor management, and capital planning initiatives. The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise in regulatory compliance, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage diverse stakeholder relationships while maintaining multiple concurrent workstreams.

Primary Responsibilities

Support in EHS

Serves as the primary environmental health and safety support for assigned facilities, developing and implementing comprehensive programs that protect employees, visitors, and contractors while ensuring full regulatory compliance.

Safety Program Management
  • Implements, and maintains site-specific safety programs including lockout/tagout, confined space entry, fall protection, respiratory protection, hazard communication, and bloodborne pathogens
  • Establishes and monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) for safety metrics including incident rates, near-miss reporting, training completion, and inspection findings
  • Conducts comprehensive facility safety audits and inspections on scheduled and unscheduled bases, documenting findings and tracking corrective action completion
  • Performs job hazard analyses (JHAs) and develops safe work procedures for high-risk activities
  • Maintains emergency action plans (EAPs).
  • Oversee safety committee activities, facilitating regular meetings and driving continuous improvement initiatives

Compliance & Regulatory
  • Ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations (29 CFR), EPA requirements, state and local codes, and industry-specific standards
  • Maintains all required safety documentation including OSHA 300 logs, Form 300A annual summaries, and injury/illness records
  • Manages Safety Data Sheet (SDS) library and ensures accessibility in accordance with OSHA Hazard Communication Standard
  • Coordinates regulatory inspections and serves as primary liaison with OSHA, EPA, fire marshals, and other regulatory agencies
  • Monitors changes in applicable regulations and updates programs accordingly
  • Manages environmental compliance programs including waste management, air quality, storm water, and spill prevention
Incident Management & Investigation
  • Responds to workplace incidents, injuries, illnesses, and near-misses, conducting thorough root cause investigations
  • Completes detailed incident reports with corrective and preventive action recommendations
  • Coordinates worker's compensation claims process and maintains communication with injured employees, claims administrators, and medical providers
  • Tracks post-incident follow-up including return-to-work accommodations and preventive measure implementation
  • Analyzes incident trends to identify systemic issues and develop targeted interventions
  • Conducts post-incident reviews with affected teams and management
Training & Education
  • Delivers comprehensive safety training programs for new hires, contractors, and existing employees
  • Creates training materials including presentations, handouts, videos, and online modules
  • Maintains training records and ensures employees receive required annual refresher training
  • Evaluates training effectiveness through assessments, observation, and incident data analysis

Support Pest Control

Support integrated pest management programs across assigned facilities to maintain healthy, sanitary environments while minimizing environmental impact and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Program Implementation & Monitoring

  • Documents findings using standardized inspection forms and photographic evidence

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensures proper posting and notification procedures for pesticide applications in accordance with regulations
Tenant & Occupant Relations

  • Provides education on preventive measures and individual responsibilities for pest management
  • Coordinates access for inspections and treatments while minimizing disruption
  • Escalates persistent or complex pest issues to management with recommended solutions
Continuous Improvement
  • Analyzes pest activity data to identify patterns and develop preventive strategies
  • Research emerging pest management technologies and best practices
  • Recommend facility improvements to eliminate conducive conditions (structural repairs, sanitation enhancements, landscaping modifications)
  • Develop standard operating procedures for pest management across the portfolio

Support in Planner

Supports strategic facilities planning initiatives including space optimization, capital project coordination, preventive maintenance scheduling, and long-term facility needs assessment.

Capital Planning & Project Coordination
  • Supports business case development for capital projects including cost-benefit analysis and return on investment calculations
  • Coordinates with project managers, engineers, and contractors during planning and execution phases of capital projects
  • Tracks capital project budgets, timelines, and deliverables, providing status updates to stakeholders
  • Participates in post-project evaluations to capture lessons learned and best practices
Space Planning & Optimization
  • Analyzes space utilization data to identify opportunities for optimization and cost reduction
  • Supports workplace strategy initiatives including flexible workspace design
  • Supports office moves.
Preventive Maintenance Planning
  • Develops and maintains comprehensive preventive maintenance schedules for building systems, equipment, and grounds
  • Coordinates preventive maintenance activities with vendors, contractors, and internal maintenance teams
  • Supports transition from reactive to predictive maintenance strategies using condition monitoring and analytics
Strategic Planning Support
  • Collects and analyzes facilities data to support strategic decision-making and portfolio planning
  • Develops and maintains facility performance dashboards tracking key operational metrics
  • Participates in long-range facilities master planning initiatives
  • Research trends, benchmarks, and emerging technologies relevant to facilities management
  • Prepares reports and presentations for senior leadership on facilities planning topics, if necessary

Facilities support
  • Control and manage the work of specialized consultants, contractors and internal staff in construction service projects and specialized operational maintenance issues.
  • Be responsible for planned and reactive tasks in accordance with the requirements of the Service Level Specification.
  • Provide analysis and technical feedback on maintenance feedback from both the internal group and contractors.
  • Maintain good relationships with everyone: customers, and visitors and respond to any complaints/situations promptly. Any problems should be reported to your supervisor immediately.
  • Support with the documentation of the tasks carried out in maintenance.
  • Performs general handyman tasks to keep the facilities in good condition
  • Complies with policies for the safe storage, use, and disposal of hazardous materials
  • Maintains a clean and safe working environment

title: Electro-Mechanical Technician 3
description:
The Electro-Mechanical Technician Level 3 is responsible for the day-to-day troubleshooting and preventative/predictive maintenance on conveyors, sorters, palatalizing machines, stand-alone stretch wrappers, and basic building maintenance. Acts as a material handling technician on all equipment that is installed at the Mobile, Alabama site. This is a first shift role working Monday-Friday, 6 am - 2 pm. Additional Overtime and occasional weekend work may be required. Shared on call will be required.

We offer:

  • Pay Transparency

  • Global Opportunities

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $ 28.00 to $ 33.50 an hour at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:

What You Will Do In This Role

  • Repair and maintenance of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) including belt tracking, component adjustment/replacement, component lubrication, etc.

  • Complete preventative maintenance routines, documentation, and procedures.

  • Use electrical test equipment to troubleshoot electrical circuitry.

  • Create and close work orders into an asset management system with appropriate data to include labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used.

  • Troubleshoot semi-complex problems and understand resources needed to resolve them.

  • Locate and track spare parts from inventory.

  • Performs routine maintenance and equipment testing to ensure they meet specifications.

  • Respond to service calls and correct equipment failures and faults.

  • Identify problems as they occur and take appropriate steps to solve them.

  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.

What We Are Looking For

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. Typically, an associate degree or vocational technical training is preferred. Specialized skill training/certification preferred.

  • 2-3 years of troubleshooting electro-mechanical equipment preferred.

  • Proven experience in the area of responsibility and successful demonstration of position and key responsibilities as presented above.

  • Able to lift and move material up to 50 pounds each.

  • Regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head.

  • Occasionally push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds.

  • Able to climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation.

  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces.

  • Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10–12 hours.

  • Flexibility in covering multiple shifts and holiday hours as required.

The position ensures Rooms Operations meet the brand’s standards and targets customer needs. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department. Ensures that standards and procedures are being followed. Assists in leading specific team while meeting or exceeding property goals.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Supporting the Leading of Rooms Team

• Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery.

• Monitors and promotes room rates, specials, and promotions at the residence.

• Runs and reviews critical information contained in room operations reports.

• Understands the functions of the Front Office, Engineering/Maintenance and Housekeeping operations.

• Operates all department equipment as necessary and reporting malfunctions.

• Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.

• Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

Contributing Information to Support Managing to Budget

• Verifies accuracy of room rates to maximize revenue opportunities.

• Uses budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the management of the Room Operations.

• Participates in the management of departmental controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Understands the impact of Room Operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Participates as needed in the investigation of employee and guest accidents.

• Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels; effectively responds to and handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.

• Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals; continuously strives to improve service performance.

• Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.

– Able to cooperate and work well with others to meet targets

– Proven ability to commit to flawless execution while complying with firm’s procedures and standards

title: Junior Groomer
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



Your Petco Grooming Career:

Begin your Petco journey as a Junior Pet Stylist in Grooming!

During this ten-week training period as a Junior Pet Stylist, you will learn fundamental grooming tasks such as brushing, bathing, drying, cutting nails, and more! Gaining hands-on experience with guidance from seasoned groomers, our industry leading program is designed to develop essential grooming skills and set the foundation for your future career with Petco Grooming.

In addition to our commitment to continuous training, development, and career growth, we also offer:

  • Competitive base pay
  • Medical, dental, vision and more
  • 401k and more
  • Paid Time Off
  • Petco Discounts
  • All the supplies & equipment you need, including, brushes, nail trimmers, clippers, blades, shampoo, sprays, tools, etc.
  • State of the art equipment, including bathing system, kennels, tables, and dryers

Purpose:

The Junior Pet Stylist's primary purpose is to learn how to perform the following services: bathing, drying, brushing, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning, alongside seasoned groomers. In addition to bathing and drying services, the Junior Pet Stylist will assist in the grooming process, prioritizing the comfort, safety, and well-being of the pets in our care and delivering optimal customer services to pet parents. This is an excellent opportunity for those passionate about animals and grooming to start their career in the pet care industry.

Essential Job Functions:

The incumbent must be able to consistently perform all the following duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Under close supervision of experienced groomers, perform limited grooming services including bathing, drying, nail trimming, brushing, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning according to the pet parents’ instructions and in adherence to company policies and procedures
  • Ensure the well-being and safety of every animal in the salon at all times
  • Interact professionally and effectively with pet parents, provide optimal customer service, address grooming related inquiries and provide timely resolution
  • Maintain a clean and safe grooming area and salon, disinfect and sanitize grooming tools and equipment, perform daily and weekly cleaning duties in the salon and in adherence to Petco hygiene and sanitation policies, other cleaning and maintenance tasks as assigned, including but not limited to cleaning air filters, vents, and drains
  • Schedule grooming appointments, manage paperwork, and maintain accurate grooming records
  • Learn and adhere to Petco's grooming policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure safety, quality, and consistency in all activities and areas of the grooming business

Training Program Outline:

  • Weeks 1-3: Learning and On-the-Job Training
    • Learn dog behavior, pet and self-safety, proper check-in/out procedures, customer service, grooming policies, and begin on-the-job training in bathing and drying techniques
  • Weeks 3-10: Performing and Achieving Productivity
    • Perform bathing and walk-in services while achieving weekly productivity goals

Education/Experience:

  • 0-1 year of animal related experience, including shelter volunteering or pet sitting, prior grooming salon assistance is preferred
  • High-school diploma or GED is preferred, though not required
  • Genuine passion for animals and a desire to pursue a career in pet grooming
  • Basic understanding of dog breeds, behavior, and common grooming practices
  • Capable of handling pets of all sizes and temperaments with care and empathy
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with pet parents and grooming team members
  • Availability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays, as required by the Pet Care Center’s grooming schedule

Work Environment:

The majority of job duties are conducted indoors in the grooming salon. Position requires bending, kneeling, lifting (up to 30 pounds, as necessary) and standing for long periods of time. Position may require exposure to heights using a two-step ladder or other support tools, such as vacuums, to perform assigned cleaning and maintenance duties. A large amount of this partner’s time will be spent in direct contact with our pet parents and their dogs, and the remaining time will be with the other salon partners. The work environment can be noisy and wet.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification.

title: Development Director
description:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

We are currently hiring a Development Director in Baton Rouge. The Director will generate revenue for our Heart Walk fundraising campaign. This campaign includes our signature Capital Area Heart Walk event.

This position is hybrid, with a strong daily in-person presence expected. We have a fast-paced sales type of environment with the main responsibility of driving revenue in support of our mission. We offer a base salary with the potential to earn an incentive up to 25% of your base pay. The potential incentive is based on achieving certain revenue targets and triggers.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

  • Generate revenue by prospecting and securing local corporate sponsorship and individual donations. Achieve revenue goals by building and maintaining relationships with corporate partners and donors.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective corporate sponsors and donors by conducting research that matches to the campaign goals and the Association's mission.
  • Develop and present proposals and accompanying materials to secure revenue and volunteer engagement.
  • Recruit and be responsible for executive volunteer leadership, volunteer committees, and day-of-the-event volunteers.Recruit corporate team participation in Heart Walk and motivate team members to fundraise.
  • Lead and engage new individual membership for our Cor Vitae giving society, in partnership with other appropriate fundraising staff. Includes planning and implementing regular engagement events for members.
  • Plan and implement events in collaboration with internal and external partners.
  • Work with a Communications Director to support and promote campaign communication plans.

Qualifications

  • 3 years of relevant experience in fundraising, sales, or other related experience
  • University/College degree or equivalent experience
  • Ability to do daily local travel up to 75% and some overnight trips as needed; requires access to reliable transportation at all times on an immediate basis
  • Ability to lift and/or move large objects (such as boxes) with the expectation that heavier items would be broken down into smaller components or requesting additional assistance may be required before lifting and/or moving
  • Must have at least basic knowledge and skill/proficiency with Microsoft Office

Here are some of the preferred experience and skills we are seeking:

  • Experience managing and cultivating high-level leaders at the C-Suite level
  • Knowledge of corporate and community networks

Compensation & Benefits

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; this position is incentive eligible based on achieving certain targets.
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

Yes, 10% of the Time

description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Located on the southeastern coast of the pristine island of Lāna’i, lies the secluded retreat of Four Seasons Resort Lāna’i, an oceanfront destination offering travelers a curated, personalized island escape. The five-star, five-diamond Resort offers outdoor restaurants, including Nobu Lāna’i, a kid’s club, Tennis Garden, cultural programming, beach and pool with spacious seating areas nestled among tropical gardens, Hawanawana spa and luxury retail boutiques. Built on lava outcroppings, the award-winning Jack Nicklaus-signature golf course features ocean views on every hole. Island activities, many managed by Four Seasons include sunset sails and whale watch tours, horseback riding, sporting clays and archery, biking, hiking, and aerial adventures at Lanai Adventure Park or learn about Hawaiian wayfinding at the on-site observatory.

STEWARD

The Four Seasons Resort Lāna’i is looking for a Steward who shares a passion for excellence and who infuses enthusiasm into everything they do. Our teams have the opportunity to shape our guest experience by providing exceptional knowledge of the Resort and exemplifying the Golden Rule in each interaction. Work authorization required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Stewards maintain cleanliness and sanitation of kitchen areas, equipment, and service ware, ensuring all items meet quality and safety standards while supporting efficient kitchen operations. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Job Details:

Performs complex functional, operational, and environmental tests to evaluate performance of military electronic components, assemblies, chassis and systems in accordance with engineering and customer requirements. This position typically works under general supervision and direction.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Reads and interprets schematics, logic diagrams and test procedures.
  • Coordinates test failure reporting and corrective actions with Quality Assurance, Reliability Engineering, and immediate supervision.
  • Interfaces with engineering personnel to resolve design and test procedure change issues.
  • Develops and corrects test procedures related to engineering requirements and drawings.
  • Maintains an electronic database related to testing.
  • Assists and trains lower-level technicians.
  • Diagnoses, locates, and troubleshoots malfunctions and repairs on prototype and production equipment.
  • Evaluates and analyzes test data and troubleshoots down to the component level.
  • Works directly with engineers in support of a growing cross functional, multi-disciplined engineering group, working with complex systems at the unit and system level.
  • Performs testing and troubleshooting in lab and field environments following test documentation and engineering instructions.
  • Revises assembly instructions, test instructions and other documentation using MS Office and MS Visio.
  • Works with Engineering, Quality Control, vendors and customers regarding testing and performance issues.
  • Designs, manufactures, tests, documents specialized test jigs and test circuits for use in production and engineering test.
  • Creates test set-ups and runs system-testing, sub-assembly testing and board level troubleshooting while at temperature.
  • Assists Engineering in design, assembly, test and development of prototype electronic assemblies.
  • Prepares and revises test procedures or specifications.
  • Reports status of ongoing test activities to immediate supervisor.
  • Calibrates test equipment.
  • Assembles and disassembles test systems or deliverable equipment using basic hand tools.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent education required
  • Two-year degree in electronics or equivalent military/civilian classes, plus a minimum of six years of related experience.
  • Requires thorough familiarity with test equipment.
  • Must understand the operation of and have experience setting up and using multi-meters, oscilloscopes, signal sources, spectrum and network analyzers and other types of test equipment.
  • Must have a good working knowledge of digital and analog circuits.
  • Must be familiar with ISO 9001.
  • Good written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal directions prioritize work, complete multiple tasks, work under deadlines, concentrate and apply craft skills.
  • US Citizenship.

title: Senior Scientist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This role is a vital part of our R&ED Molecular Lab team, which is dedicated to advancing cutting-edge diagnostic technologies and molecular biology solutions to improve patient outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Scientist, you will design, execute, and troubleshoot complex molecular biology experiments to propel our diagnostic product pipeline forward. In this role, you will apply deep scientific expertise to translate novel concepts into robust, high-performing assay solutions and facilitate seamless technology transfers across departments.

  • Design & Execute Research: Plan, execute, and optimize innovative R&D experiments utilizing established and novel procedures to achieve critical project goals.
  • Data Analysis & Documentation: Accurately record methods and results in electronic laboratory notebooks, analyze data, draw conclusions, and implement actionable process improvements.
  • Creative Problem-Solving: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex scientific issues by taking new perspectives on existing solutions and implementing innovative concepts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a scientific resource for Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Studies to ensure the expeditious transfer of products and technologies.
  • Technical Communication: Present findings at group and departmental meetings and leverage advanced technical writing skills to produce comprehensive reports, summaries, and memos.
  • Leadership & Guidance: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, lead cross-functional project activities, and cultivate strong professional relationships.

Who You Are

  • You are a Bachelor’s in Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience); Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience preferred.
  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience applying broad knowledge in molecular biology or clinical studies, alongside a practical understanding of medical device and IVD assay development.
  • Demonstrated experience working safely in a BSL-2 laboratory environment while maintaining rigorous aseptic technique.

Preferred behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

  • Experience with diagnostic assay development, including a high level understanding of the regulatory framework for RUO, LDT, or IVD assays.
  • Experience working with high-throughput molecular biology platforms and automated laboratory systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in assay development and optimization.
  • Demonstrated the ability to critically examine assay workflows and troubleshoot unknown and unfamiliar issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to identify areas of misalignment and collaborate effectively within and across teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to efficiently evaluate, prioritize and handle multiple changing projects and priorities; complete work in a timely, accurate and thorough manner.

Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed in this link.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. description:
About

생성 AI(Gen AI)로 기업의 혁신을 켜는(On) 제논

국내 최초의 AI 전문 컨설팅펌으로 출발한 제논은 비즈니스와 AI, IT에 대한 전문 지식과 다양한 산업 적용 경험을 바탕으로 AI 전략 수립부터 모델 개발, 시스템 구축까지 전 과정을 아우르는 통합 서비스를 제공합니다.

제논은 생성형 AI 기술의 연구·개발 역량과 AI 전략 컨설팅 전문성을 바탕으로, 다양한 기업 고객의 니즈에 최적화된 솔루션을 개발하는 데 집중하고 있습니다. 특히 AI 모델 개발부터 데이터 분석, 업무 자동화, 에이전트 설계에 이르기까지 AI 서비스 구현과 적용에 필요한 모든 단계에 걸친 통합형 서비스를 제공하며, 실제 사용자 환경에서 바로 적용 가능한 형태로 높은 완성도의 결과물을 창출합니다.

Responsibilities

• CMP 아키텍처 설계 및 핵심 백엔드 기능 개발
• OpenStack 및 Cloud Native 기술 기반의 솔루션 개발
• AI/GPU 워크로드 지원을 위한 클라우드 인프라 최적화 및 API 개발
• 클라우드 보안 솔루션 기획 및 오픈스택 연동 신규 개발
• 자체 데이터센터 제어 솔루션 개발

Requirements

• 오픈소스 기반 클라우드 인프라 솔루션 및 백엔드 개발 경력 7년 이상 이신 분
• Helm 차트 기반 패키징 및 배포 파이프라인 구축 경험이 있으신 분
• Python, C++, Go 등 하나 이상의 언어를 활용한 수준 높은 개발 역량이 있으신 분
• Kubernetes 환경에 대한 이해와 Helm을 활용한 애플리케이션 패키징, 배포 및 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• Technical Architect(TA) 또는 리드 개발자로서 프로젝트의 기술 방향성을 제시할 수 있는 분

Preferred

• Linux OS 커널, 하이퍼바이저, 혹은 펌웨어 레벨의 개발 및 성능 튜닝 경험
• 다중 클러스터 및 하이브리드 클라우드 환경을 통합 관리하는 CMP 개발 경험
• OpenStack-Helm 기반의 대규모 클라우드 배포 및 라이프사이클 관리 고도화 경험

title: In Room Dining Coordinator
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An iconic hideaway on the glamorous Athens riviera, reborn. On the sophisticated Athens Riviera, at the tip of a pine-clad peninsula, Four Seasons offers the best of both worlds: a laid-back seaside escape just 30 minutes from the historical city centre. Discover the wonders of ancient civilization at the Acropolis, then return to Four Seasons to unwind and relax. Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens opened in March 2019 and provides a preferred address for both business and leisure travelers, and the highly personalized, anticipatory service that Four Seasons guests expect and value around the world. The Arion Hotel was built in 1967 and has 106 keys and 61 Bungalows, and the Nafsika opened in 1980 and has 136 keys. Under the same ownership is a large private beach club and marina. Nafsika is open through the year, while Arion and the bungalows operate eight months of the year. Adding to the complement of on-site F&B operations (8 Restaurants and Bars), there are also two third party restaurants on site.

About the Outlet – In-Room Dining

Deliver personalized and discreet service to guests in the comfort of their rooms and suites. Offer seamless 24-hour dining experiences that combine convenience, privacy, and luxury while maintaining Four Seasons' legendary standards of hospitality.

About the Role

At Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens (ranked No. 17 in the World's 50 Best Hotels), we are seeking a highly organized and guest-focused In-Room Dining Coordinator to join our Food & Beverage team on a full-time, permanent basis.

As an In-Room Dining Coordinator, you will be the first point of contact for our guests, ensuring every order is handled with accuracy, efficiency, and personalized care. You will coordinate daily In-Room Dining operations, communicate closely with the Kitchen and service teams, and contribute to delivering exceptional luxury dining experiences.

What You Will Do

  • Take guest In-Room Dining orders and communicate special requests accurately to the Kitchen.
  • Answer telephone calls professionally, provide menu recommendations, and confidently describe food and beverage offerings.
  • Upsell menu items and promote additional products and services.
  • Coordinate food, beverage, and amenity deliveries to ensure timely and accurate service.
  • Process guest charges, gratuities, and maintain billing accuracy.
  • Maintain records of amenities, special requests, and guest preferences.
  • Update guest profiles in Opera and manage VIP requests and reports.
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping, Banquets, and other departments for special deliveries and guest requests.
  • Use HotSOS to dispatch service requests efficiently.
  • Prepare operational reports using Avero and assist with payroll reporting when required.
  • Liaise with the Culinary team regarding special dietary requirements and off-menu requests.
  • Manage Food & Beverage outlet reservations through OpenTable.
  • Support administrative tasks and provide general operational assistance to the department.
  • Ensure compliance with Four Seasons standards, health & safety procedures, and hygiene regulations.
  • Respond appropriately during emergency situations while maintaining professionalism at all times.

What You Bring

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Applicants must hold a European Passport or have the legal right to work in Greece.
  • Previous experience in In-Room Dining, Food & Beverage, Front Office, or luxury hospitality is considered an advantage.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and multitasking skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced luxury environment.
  • Fluency in English is essential; Greek is considered an advantage.
  • Food handling and sanitation certification is an asset.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary and comprehensive Benefits Package.
  • Complimentary Employee Meals, Bus Transportation, Uniform & Laundry Services.
  • Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance of €100.
  • Complimentary Nights at Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts worldwide.
  • Employee Recognition Program.
  • Global career opportunities through Task Forces and international transfers.
  • Access to Four Seasons' award-winning Learning & Development programs.

Schedule & Hours

This is a full-time, permanent position.

The schedule is based on operational needs and includes 5 working days per week with 2 days off. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and holidays is required.

If you are passionate about creating memorable guest experiences and would like to build your career with one of the world's leading luxury hospitality brands, we would love to hear from you!

description:

Cubic Defense

Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details:

Job Summary

Cubic Digital Intelligence is seeking a Software Engineer I to join the Unified Video (UV) engineering team supporting the sustainment and modernization of our Full Motion Video (FMV) platform. This role will contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of the Unified Video ecosystem, including Feed Management Portal (FMP) and NetOps, while developing software solutions that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Working alongside experienced engineers, the Software Engineer I will assist with feature development, automation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization within a Linux-based software environment.   • Develop, test, and maintain software supporting the Unified Video (UV) platform and associated applications, including Feed Management Portal (FMP) and NetOps.
  • Assist in developing backend services and automation using Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL.
  • Support software deployment, configuration management, and CI/CD automation efforts.
  • Troubleshoot software defects, investigate issues, and participate in root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to security updates, vulnerability remediation, and software maintenance activities.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and Agile development activities.
  • Work with senior engineers to implement new features and modernize existing applications.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation.
  • Continuously learn new technologies and engineering best practices while contributing to team objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience.
  • Experience with one or more modern programming languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++.
  • Familiarity with Git version control and software development fundamentals.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship, co-op, research, or personal project experience developing software applications.
  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line tools.
  • Exposure to Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, or Kubernetes.

title: Sr Director, Product Design
description:
The Opportunity:

As Mattel continues to evolve as an IP-driven company, the Product Design organization plays a critical role in transforming brand strategy, consumer insights, and emerging trends into innovative products and play experiences that inspire consumers around the world.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Product Design to lead a high-performing team of designers responsible for the creation and execution of breakthrough product lines across a portfolio of brands. This leader will establish the creative vision for the business, drive innovation, and partner closely with Marketing, Product Development, Consumer Insights, Engineering, Packaging, and Commercial teams to deliver compelling products that strengthen brand equity and achieve business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional product design expertise with strong people leadership and strategic thinking. They have a proven track record of developing successful product lines, building and coaching high-performing teams, identifying future consumer opportunities, and translating insights into meaningful product innovation.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Product Design Leadership – 40%

  • Establish and drive the creative vision and design strategy across a portfolio of brands, product lines, or categories.
  • Lead development of innovative product concepts and consumer experiences that differentiate Mattel brands in an increasingly competitive marketplace.
  • Champion consumer-centered design by translating trends, insights, and cultural movements into compelling product opportunities.
  • Drive excellence throughout the design process, from concept development through commercialization.
  • Partner with global development teams to ensure design intent is maintained through manufacturing and production.
  • Present product strategies, concepts, and line plans to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Talent Development – 25%

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of product designers while fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development opportunities to strengthen organizational capability and talent pipelines.
  • Establish clear expectations and create an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, and creative excellence.
  • Drive effective workload planning and resource allocation across a diverse portfolio of initiatives.
  • Innovation & Consumer Insights – 20%
  • Partner closely with Consumer Insights and Marketing teams to identify emerging consumer needs, white-space opportunities, and future growth platforms.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of trends, competitors, technologies, materials, and evolving play patterns.
  • Lead innovation initiatives that expand Mattel's product offerings and unlock new opportunities for growth.
  • Encourage a culture of curiosity and continuous exploration to ensure Mattel remains at the forefront of play innovation.

Cross-Functional Leadership – 15%

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product Development, Engineering, Packaging, Licensing, Finance, and Commercial teams to ensure successful product execution.
  • Influence business decisions through effective communication, storytelling, and strategic thinking.
  • Build strong partnerships with global teams and Asia-based development partners to deliver products on time, on cost, and at the highest quality standards.
  • Balance consumer needs, business objectives, manufacturing considerations, and brand strategies to achieve successful business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 12+ years of progressive product design experience with a demonstrated history of bringing successful consumer products to market.
  • Significant experience leading teams through the full product development lifecycle, from concept generation through commercialization.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, talent development, and succession planning.
  • Strong understanding of product design, manufacturing, costing, engineering, and development processes.
  • Demonstrated success building strong cross-functional partnerships and influencing diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify marketplace trends and translate insights into innovative product solutions.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Experience managing multiple brands, categories, or product portfolios simultaneously.
  • Global experience working with Asia-based design, development, and manufacturing teams preferred.
  • Passion for innovation, creativity, consumer insights, and developing products that inspire play.

*The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience. Mattel offers competitive total pay programs, comprehensive benefits, and resources to help empower a culture where every employee can reach their full potential.

title: IEA Employment Consultant
description:
Create opportunities. Change lives. Build a career with purpose.

If you’re passionate about helping people with barriers secure meaningful employment — and you have a talent for matching individuals with the right job — this role is your chance to make a genuine difference.

We’re looking for our next Employment Consultant to join our Elizabeth SA team within the Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who We Are

APM is a global human services organisation transforming lives since 1994. With a team of over 16,000 across 11 countries, we empower people of all abilities to live independent, fulfilling lives. When you join APM, you join a network of opportunity, growth, and purpose.

About the Role

This is a dynamic role blending people support, sales, relationship building, and administration. Every day, you’ll help participants overcome barriers, build confidence, and secure long‑term employment.

You will:

  • Support participants (including those with disability, injury, or long‑term unemployment) to become job‑ready

  • Market candidates to employers and generate new job opportunities

  • Build strong relationships with local businesses to create sustainable employment pathways

  • Drive employment outcomes through proactive engagement and advocacy

Success comes from balancing genuine people support with confident employer engagement and outcome delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their goals

  • Coach participants to be job‑ready and interview confident

  • Assist with resumes, job search strategies, and training pathways

  • Advocate for participants and secure job placements

  • Generate new opportunities through cold calls, employer visits, and business development

  • Maintain a strong employer pipeline and convert opportunities into placements

  • Promote the value of inclusive recruitment

  • Negotiate job trials, work experience, and wage subsidies

  • Achieve KPI targets across placements and engagement

  • Manage compliance, documentation, and participant progress

  • Celebrate milestones and successful outcomes

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong employment outcomes

  • A growing network of engaged employers

  • Consistent achievement of KPIs

  • Long‑term placements that genuinely change lives

About You

You are:

  • A confident communicator and relationship builder

  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer‑facing roles

  • Passionate about helping people overcome barriers

  • Resilient, target‑driven, and motivated by outcomes

  • Organised and able to manage competing priorities

Why You’ll Love Working at Blair Athol

This isn’t a typical desk job — it’s about breaking barriers, creating opportunities, and supporting people with disability to thrive.

  • Base salary + performance incentives

  • Ongoing training and career development

  • Supportive, inclusive team culture

  • Celebrations and recognition for milestones

  • Service recognitions

  • APM Family Hub

  • Maxxia salary packaging

  • On‑site parking at Elizabeth for easy daily access

To Be Considered

You will have:

  • Eligibility to work in Australia

  • A current driver’s licence and comprehensively insured vehicle

  • A MyGovID (Standard level)

  • Willingness to complete a National Police Check

  • Ability to pass a Working with Children Check

  • Availability to work full‑time, Monday to Friday, 8:30am–5:00pm

title: Critical Environments Operating Engineer
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

1st & 3rd Shift

What this job involves:

As a Critical Environments Operating Engineer at JLL, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining mission-critical data center infrastructure that powers the digital world. This role is essential to ensuring 100% uptime for our clients' most vital operations. You'll be responsible for the operation, monitoring, and maintenance of sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems including UPS, generators, cooling systems, and medium-voltage electrical infrastructure. Working in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, you'll apply best practice systems and problem-solving skills to keep critical facilities running seamlessly 24/7. This position offers exceptional opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology while building a rewarding career in one of the industry's most dynamic and growing sectors.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Work with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing industry
  • Clear career advancement opportunities in critical infrastructure
  • Be part of a team that literally keeps the digital world running

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Operate and maintain all critical building systems to ensure 100% uptime, including fire/life safety, HVAC, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, plumbing, controls, UPS systems, generators, switchgear, power distribution, and transformers
  • Monitor, adjust, and maintain refrigeration, chilled water, air conditioning equipment, boilers, pumps, valves, piping, and electrical systems to ensure optimal performance
  • Record equipment readings, analyze system operations, identify problems or malfunctions, and take immediate corrective action as required
  • Manage work orders through CMMS, coordinate with vendors, and respond to customer-facing tickets in a timely and professional manner
  • Learn and understand the data center infrastructure thoroughly to effectively manage incidents and events that could impact critical systems
  • Comply with emergency escalation procedures and respond to site emergencies to protect critical operations
  • Maintain safe storage, usage, and disposal of hazardous materials while keeping the workplace clean, organized, and compliant with all safety standards

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working in a data center or critical facility environment
  • Demonstrated experience with mission-critical building systems including UPS systems, emergency generators, switchgear, and power distribution equipment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to document activities and communicate technical information clearly
  • Working knowledge of computer applications including MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Google Suite, and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
  • Physical ability to lift a minimum of 50 lbs, climb ladders up to 30 feet (300-lb weight limit), work at heights, and navigate rooftops
  • Flexibility to work different schedules, including holidays, and respond to site emergencies as needed
  • Ability to frequently walk, climb, bend, kneel, stoop, and work overhead in large campus-like settings

Preferred

  • Experience using Corrigo work order management system
  • Universal EPA 608 certification for refrigerant handling
  • NFPA 70E training for electrical safety in the workplace
  • Experience with critical infrastructure in mission-critical or 24/7 operational environments
  • Background in industrial controls, building automation systems (BAS), or energy management systems
  • Previous experience in vendor management and contractor coordination
  • Relevant trade certifications or technical training in electrical, mechanical, or HVAC systems

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Location:

On-site –Salt Lake City, UT

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

title: Guest Experience Officer (Lobby Ambassador)
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotel and Residences is part of a 65-storey mixed-use tower that will include 242 Four Seasons Private Residences, 27 serviced apartments, a 209-key Four Seasons Hotel and a six- floor of 250,000 square foot luxury retail podium, collectively known as Four Seasons Place Kuala Lumpur. The Hotel introduces several unique dining outlets to the city, including a Cantonese restaurant, lobby and rooftop pool bars, and an all-day dining restaurant with sweeping views of the Petronas Twin Towers. The Hotel will also offer an executive lounge for business travelers, a serene spa, wellness-focused fitness centre and rooftop infinity pool offering panoramic views of Kuala Lumpur’s endless skyline. Lush landscaping around the rooftop pool and terrace will create an urban oasis, echoing the greenery of the KLCC Park below.

Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur is looking for top talent to join the team.

About Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Four Seasons Hotel and Residences is located in the Golden Triangle neighborhood, Kuala Lumpur’s thriving business and financial district. The Hotel is part of a 65-storey mixed-use tower that will include 242 Four Seasons Private Residences, 27 serviced apartments, a 209-key Four Seasons Hotel and a six- floor of 250,000 square foot luxury retail podium, collectively known as Four Seasons Place Kuala Lumpur.

The latest addition to the city’s dramatic skyline and a vibrant hub for both business and leisure travelers, Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur will be conveniently located in close proximity to the city’s major attractions, including the Petronas Twin Towers and the Kuala Lumpur City Centre (KLCC). Often referred to as a “city within a city,” the KLCC will offer designer shopping, fine dining, and the best of the city’s electric nightlife. The Hotel will also overlook the KLCC Park and be directly connected to the esplanade, allowing guests to take full advantage of the Park’s 50 acres of green space, including lush gardens, fountains, waterfalls, a wading pool, and jogging track.

An exciting addition to Kuala Lumpur’s culinary scene, the Hotel will introduce several unique dining outlets to the city, including a Cantonese restaurant, lobby and rooftop pool bars, and an all-day dining restaurant with sweeping views of the Petronas Twin Towers.

The Hotel will also offer an executive lounge for business travelers, a serene spa, wellness-focused fitness centre and rooftop infinity pool offering panoramic views of Kuala Lumpur’s endless skyline. Lush landscaping around the rooftop pool and terrace will create an urban oasis, echoing the greenery of the KLCC Park below.

Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur will offer both international and regional travelers an urban complement to the existing Four Seasons Resort in Malaysia, the award-winning Four Seasons Resort Langkawi.

About Four Seasons

Founded in 1960, Four Seasons continues to define the future of luxury hospitality with extraordinary imagination, unwavering commitment to the highest standards of quality, and the most genuine and customized service. Currently operating 135 hotels and 59 private residences in major city centers and resort destination in the world, Four Seasons consistently ranks among the world’s best hotels and most prestigious brands in reader polls, traveler reviews and industry awards.

Guest Experience Officer (Lobby Ambassador)

The Guest Experience Officer (Lobby Ambassador) creates a strong sense of arrival for hotel, restaurant and banquet guests in the lobby area.

We are looking for candidates who have excellent personal presentation and interpersonal skills. Attention to detail and the ability to multitask are required. Excellent communication skills are essential. Physical by nature this position requires standing for 8 hours per shift. The ideal candidate will also have a warm welcoming smile, a positive attitude and be knowledgeable about the local area.

What You Will Do:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for guests, offering a warm welcome and creating a positive first impression upon arrival.

  • Engage with guests in the lobby and public areas, providing personalized assistance and anticipating their needs.

  • Escort guests to appropriate hotel outlets, meeting venues, guest rooms, or other facilities as required.

  • Provide accurate information regarding hotel services, dining options, facilities, events, local attractions, and transportation arrangements.

  • Assist guests with reservations, directions, and general inquiries in a professional and courteous manner.

  • Collaborate closely with Front Office, Concierge, Guest Services, Housekeeping, and Food & Beverage teams to ensure a seamless guest experience.

  • Monitor lobby activity and maintain a visible presence to proactively assist guests and address concerns.

  • Recognize VIPs, returning guests, and special occasions, ensuring personalized service and appropriate follow-up.

  • Support guest recovery efforts by responding promptly to service issues and escalating concerns when necessary.

  • Maintain the cleanliness, presentation, and overall ambiance of the lobby and public areas by coordinating with relevant departments.

  • Assist with guest arrivals, departures, group movements, and special events as required.

  • Promote hotel facilities, services, dining outlets, and experiences to enhance guest satisfaction and engagement.

  • Handle guest feedback professionally and communicate relevant information to management and operational teams.

  • Uphold Four Seasons service standards, brand values, and luxury hospitality expectations at all times.

What You Bring:

  • Poses an affinity for guest service.

  • Excellent personal presentation and interpersonal skills.

  • Certificate in related discipline.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule with the ability to work all shifts, weekends and holidays as per business demands and needs.

  • Excellent reading, writing, and oral proficiency in English language.

  • Must be able to speak, read, and write Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Must have the right to work in Malaysia.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package

  • Excellent training and development opportunities

  • Complimentary accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts

  • Complimentary dry cleaning for employee uniforms

  • Complimentary employee meals

Work Type: Full Time

Join Our Team

Join a team that is built on mutual respect, collaboration, creativity and a commitment to the highest quality of service. Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur provides guests with a haven of serenity and luxury in a bustling city. Four Seasons provides employees with the same level of care that we expect to be shared with our guests. We have been ranked in FORTUNE Magazine’s 100 Best Companies to work for since 1998.

What to expect: You will……

Be a champion of the Golden Rule: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you

Be part of a cohesive team with opportunities to learn, grow and develop

Have the opportunity to engage in diverse and challenging work

Derive a sense of pride in work well done

Be recognized for excellence

Visa sponsorship is not available for the role. Due to strict work permit regulations, position is applicable to local candidates or candidates with Malaysian Permanent Resident status holder only. Only successful candidates will be contacted.

title: Professional, Project / Programme Execution
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

    • Role Summary

  • undefined

    The Commissioning Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a senior technical authority responsible for providing commissioning leadership across the delivery of data center and mission‑critical projects

    The role represents the client’s operational and reliability interests, ensuring that all building systems are installed, tested, integrated, and validated to meet performance, resilience, redundancy, safety, and compliance requirements. The Commissioning SME supports projects from early design and commissioning strategy development through construction, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), operational readiness, and handover, with a strong focus on technical governance, systems integration, risk management, and performance assurance in fast‑track environments.

    Key Responsibilities

    undefined

    Commissioning Leadership & Project Delivery

    Provide end‑to‑end commissioning technical oversight across data center projects from early design through handover and operational readiness. Act as the commissioning technical authority , advising the client on commissioning strategies, sequencing, risks, and technical options. Develop, review, and manage the project commissioning plan in alignment with Employer’s Requirements (ERs), operational objectives, and resilience criteria. Support development and implementation of commissioning strategies aligned with program, phasing, live environment constraints, and reliability targets.

    undefined

    Review design documentation to ensure systems are commissionable, testable, and operable, including: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems ELV, BMS, EPMS, DCIM, and control systems Fire detection, suppression, and life safety systems CSA interfaces impacting commissioning and access Ensure commissioning requirements are embedded in design specifications, sequences of operation, and control narratives. Verify compliance with: Local codes and authority requirements International standards and guidelines (e.g., ASHRAE, CIBSE, NFPA, IEC, ISO) Client data center commissioning and reliability standards (e.g., Uptime Institute, client-specific protocols) Participate in design reviews, technical workshops, constructability, and value engineering sessions with a commissioning focus.

    undefined

    Provide commissioning oversight during construction to ensure systems are installed in accordance with approved designs and commissioning requirements. Review and approve commissioning-related submittals, including: Pre-functional checklists (PFCs) Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) Site Acceptance Tests (SATs) Commissioning procedures and scripts Conduct site inspections and readiness reviews to verify installation completeness prior to testing. Support resolution of commissioning-related RFIs, non‑conformances, and field changes. Monitor commissioning execution quality, documentation, and adherence to approved test protocols. Support punch list management and commissioning close‑out activities.

    undefined

    Coordinate closely with: MEP, ELV, IT, and CSA teams to ensure end‑to‑end system integration Contractors, vendors, and OEMs for testing, sequencing, and validation Commissioning authorities, third‑party testers, and client operations teams Ensure effective coordination of commissioning activities within construction and project schedules. Lead or support Integrated Systems Testing (IST), end‑to‑end testing, and failure scenario validation. Ensure smooth transition from construction completion to operational readiness.

    undefined

    Identify commissioning risks related to system integration, sequencing, redundancy, controls, and operational continuity. Support phased commissioning strategies, including brownfield and live environment projects where applicable. Contribute to value engineering initiatives while safeguarding performance, reliability, and maintainability. Provide technical input to change management, variations, and claims related to commissioning scope. Support schedule and cost impact assessments in coordination with project controls teams.

    undefined

    Commissioning of mission‑critical systems including: Electrical power systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs) Mechanical cooling systems (chillers, CRAH/CRAC, containment) Control systems (BMS, EPMS, DCIM) Fire protection and life safety systems Execution of Level 1–5 commissioning and Integrated Systems Testing (IST). Validation of redundancy, failover, and resilience under simulated fault conditions. Support operational readiness, training, SOP development, and handover documentation.

    undefined

    Act as the primary commissioning technical advisor to the client. Support senior leadership in managing client expectations related to performance, reliability, and readiness. Clearly present commissioning risks, test results, and readiness status to stakeholders. Coordinate with designers, contractors, vendors, and operations teams. Maintain accurate commissioning records, test results, and acceptance documentation.

    Qualifications & Experience

    undefined

    Education

    Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.

    Professional Certifications (Preferred)

    Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP), BCxP, or equivalent. Data center commissioning certifications (e.g., Uptime Institute ATD, CDCP) are advantageous.

    Experience

    15–20 years of experience in commissioning, testing, or technical advisory roles. Proven experience commissioning data center or mission‑critical infrastructure projects.

    undefined

    Advanced understanding of commissioning processes, test methodologies, and acceptance criteria. Strong knowledge of MEP, ELV, controls, and system integration. Familiarity with commissioning management tools, test scripts, and reporting platforms. BIM and digital coordination tools for commissioning readiness reviews. Strong technical reporting, documentation, and governance skills.

    High level of technical authority and professional judgment. Strong leadership in multidisciplinary testing and commissioning environments. Clear communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Detail-oriented with a structured, risk-based approach. Collaborative mindset with strong coordination and facilitation skills.

48
