title: Director, Clinical Services
description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

As the largest provider of PHP/IOP programs and psychiatric services in Illinois, Compass Health Center is one of the fastest-growing behavioral health organizations in the country. We are thrilled to expand our exceptionally innovative and highly distinguished programs that redefine our industry and raise the standard for comprehensive care.

Launching in early 2027, our newest location in Falls Church, VA, will be home to top local talent in behavioral health care. This interdisciplinary team of trailblazers will build our adolescent and adult programs from the ground up alongside the leadership of well-established clinicians and doctors working in PHP/IOP behavioral health care for the past decade.

As we prepare to open our Falls Church facility, we are seeking an experienced Clinical Director to lead our Adult and Adolescent Programs. In partnership with the rest of the Falls Church Leadership Team, this role will play a key role in building and shaping a strong culture at the location, while offering direct coaching and development to our team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Providing direct managerial oversight to Associate Directors, Primary Therapists, Family Therapists, Group Therapists, and other staff within programs. Lead and assist with other programs as needed
  • Identifying hiring/staffing needs and participating in interviewing and hiring process
  • Executing new hire onboarding and staff development
  • Initiating employee performance appraisal and staff performance improvement program compliance with accrediting bodies
  • Leading the day-to-day execution of policies and procedures as well as the mission and objectives of Compass
  • Managing program paid time off to ensure adequate staffing patterns
  • Managing Program Intake schedule with assistance from VP and Site Leader
  • Responding to clinical crises as needed and coordinating response of others
  • Oversees the implementation of program material and curriculum
  • As indicated, participating in community outreach
  • Overseeing calls about program eligibility and appropriateness. Ensures referrals are provided as needed
  • Conducting clinical intakes to identify clinical diagnoses, functional impairment, personal strengths and make treatment recommendations; charting progress of patients appropriately; providing group, individual, and family therapy, as needed
  • Communicating with patient’s family members or support system, as needed; coordinating care with patient’s outside providers to ensure continuity of care
  • Assessing patient’s progress and need for higher level of care or discharge
  • Engaging in frequent communication and collaboration with team members via rounds, EMR notes, emails, and face-to-face communication
  • Participating in professional development activities
  • Providing individual, family or group therapy as needed
  • Providing clinical supervision

Who You Are:

  • Masters prepared independently licensed clinician or licensed Doctorate level clinician
  • Experience developing and managing programs and clinical teams
  • Experience supervising therapists, both licensed and seeing licensure
  • Knowledge and experience of group dynamics utilizing CBT, ACT, DBT, and Motivational Interviewing, among other effective and efficacious treatments
  • Experience with patients in crisis
  • Excellent time management skills, ability to juggle multiple demands simultaneously in a fast paced and changing environment
  • Experience with program target population in group and individual therapy settings

We are committed to a fair and equitable work environment. The expected compensation range for this role is below. This range includes multiple career path levels across the organization; where you fall in the range is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, your years of experience, type of experience, location, and education/certifications. Compass reserves the right to update these ranges.

This role may also be eligible for an annual bonus which is dependent upon individual and company performance.

Compensation
$100,000—$140,000 USD

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

For eligible positions, our other benefits include: comprehensive medical/dental/vision plans, 401k program with company matching, generous PTO (including competitive parental leave after 1 year of employment), and continuous training through CEU seminars and volunteering opportunities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

DIRECTOR OF FRONT OFFICE

The Four Seasons Resort Lāna’i is looking for a Director of Front Office who shares a passion for excellence and who infuses enthusiasm into everything they do. Our teams’ have the opportunity to shape our guest experience by providing exceptional knowledge of the Resort and exemplifying the Golden Rule in each interaction. Work authorization required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Director of Front Office leads Front Office operations, ensuring seamless arrival, stay, and departure experiences while delivering exceptional, personalized service consistent with luxury hospitality standards. This role drives operational excellence, team development, and cross-functional collaboration to enhance guest satisfaction, foster employee engagement, and uphold the resort’s commitment to service excellence. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Partner closely with Resort Operations, Transportation, Lana‘i Air, Sales, Catering, and Pre-Arrival teams to coordinate arrivals, departures, room assignments, billing requirements, and special guest arrangements, ensuring a seamless end-to-end guest experience

  • Resolve guest concerns and service challenges with professionalism and urgency, providing thoughtful solutions, personalized follow-up, and exceptional hospitality while serving as a key escalation point for complex issues

  • Monitor daily arrivals, VIP guests, return guests, and group business to ensure special requests, preferences, and accommodations are executed accurately and consistently to the highest standards of service

  • And More!

title: Registered Dietitian
description:
The Registered Dietitian will provide telephonic education and support to members with chronic illness. The Registered Dietitian will be responsible for improving health outcomes of and promoting appropriate preventive care for members with certain scenarios such as Diabetes, Asthma, COPD, CAD, GI, Oncology and other medical conditions needing nutrition education and support. This role will also include communication with health care professionals to ensure goals of a member's treatment plan are met, as well as ensuring that members are linked with the appropriate resources and are adopting healthy lifestyle practices to reduce risk factors. The Registered Dietitian will identify participant's behaviors and provide customized health coaching to individuals based on their health and nutritional needs.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provides nutrition education and wellness coaching to help promote the member's ability to self-manage.
  • Conducts assessments, surveys and develops a education plan and delivers health education to members.
  • Create a personalized action plan that will will include short and long term goals prioritized by the member, specific activities/interventions to achieve goals.
  • Assists the member and caregiver to understand their illness, make life style changes, adhere to medication regimen and work with their provider to develop a symptom response plan. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Identify and address barriers that are preventing the member from meeting their goals.
  • Counsel individuals on daily nutrition and medical nutrition therapy, including reinforcement of physician/nutritionist developed custom diet plans
  • Provide guidance and direction on accessing community based services for home modifications, transportation, meal preparation etc
  • Focus on prevention, health promotion, maintenance, restoration and education.
  • Develops strong relationships based upon trust with individual participants.
  • Assists clients in identifying, prioritizing, and implementing choices. Empowers clients to reach their goals, through direction, encouragement, accountability and counseling.
  • Provides advice and instruction for fitness, good nutrition, and management of weight, stress, and health into a participant’s lifestyle
  • Commits to continued learning in all areas relevant to the position. Maintain and develop knowledge about various health topics and behavior change strategies.
  • Utilizes established workflows and collaborates with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Complies with all policies and procedures to ensure that the program’s outcomes measurements meet HEDIS and NCQA standards.


What We Require

  • 5+ years related work experience in working with acute and chronic populations to provide nutritional/health education, self-management, wellness and support in related topics

  • Related Bachelor's degree required Food and Nutrition, Dietetics or Health Education is preferred.

  • Required Registered Dietitian Certification Upon Hire

  • Experience working in out-patient clinical setting or doing predominantly telephonic nutrition health education and coaching is highly preferred

  • Experience in health behavior change/health coaching/health education a plus

  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to effectively interact with persons from a variety of backgrounds and experiences in a professional, diplomatic, and courteous manner.

  • Excellent analytical/critical thinking skills, including the ability to identify problems, research and analyze issues from different perspectives, organize information, reach sound conclusions, and make appropriate decisions

  • Able to work with protected health information and maintain absolute confidentiality and privacy in accordance with HIPAA regulations

  • Excellent computer skills including working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word and Excel and the internet.

  • Highly organized and proficient individual that can work quickly and with little direction A "team" player able to work well in an energetic, dynamic and deadline oriented environment

What We Prefer

  • State (Florida) Registered Dietitian

General Physical Demands


Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.
Must be able to travel occasionally to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences).

What We Offer
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Salary Range: $65,400 - $106,200

title: Associate Director, Finance, Product Development & Supply - Network Strategy
description:
Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

The Associate Director, Network Strategy role will be an integral member of the PDS Strategic Finance team, responsible for analyzing and supporting strategic planning and business development activities. They will provide leadership to business partners and deliver decision support and financial projections for network strategy projects, including go-team activities. They will drive simplification and standardization across analytics by leveraging technology and automation to optimize processes, enhance data management, and enable more efficient, high-quality decision support.

Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

  • Partner across modalities and matrix teams (BI&A, procurement, Corporate Finance, PDS business) to support ad-hoc financial analysis and insights to inform manufacturing network strategic decisions.

  • Partner with Corporate and PDS Business Development teams to develop financial analyses and business cases for various projects, including in-licensing, divestitures, and acquisitions.

  • Support the annual Long Term Financial Plan (LTFP) process in PDS.

  • Lead the coordination within PDS Finance to prepare 10-year P&L projection including new product cost development, analyses, reporting, and presentation of key LTFP deliverables to PDS Leadership.

  • Present financial analyses, business cases, and key deliverables to senior leaders in a clear, concise manner, distilling complex data into actionable insights that support timely strategic decision-making.

  • Play key role in Go Team activities including liaison with individual finance representatives in a matrix organization that enables successful supply planning for priority brands.

  • Develop, manage, and maintain financial playbooks used to support business needs; provide training and guidance to PDS finance team members tasked with using the playbook and enhance simplification, automation and digitization capabilities.

  • Monitor and coordinate across PDS Finance the collection of updates to strategic business assumptions and update the related financial models to assess and quantify impact of changes.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum education of a bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance or related field is required. MBA and /or CPA is preferred.

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of accounting/financial experience with demonstration of increasing levels of responsibility is required. Comprehensive knowledge of complex financial modeling, and business case development is highly preferred.

  • Highly driven individual with strong FP&A skills; prior operations experience and/or cost accounting experience is a strong plus.

  • Ability to understand complex business operations and the associated financial implications.

  • Requires strong business partnering, communication, and presentation skills; must be able to work with all levels of management.

  • Ability to manage and lead in a complex matrix environment.

  • Ability to work in and manage multiples tasks in a highly pressurized and time-compressed environment.

• Bachelor Degree holders in Computer Science, Information Technology or related disciplines.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in enterprise network management and system administration.

• Proven experience in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting hardware and software systems.

• Experience with network setup and troubleshooting, including LAN, WAN, and wireless networks.

• Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) for managing incidents and change requests.

• Able to work independently as well as collaboratively

• Good team player, able to communicate effectively with regional and global teams

• Good command of written and spoken

title: Vice President, Middle Office
description:

At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. About the Team & Business Line:

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Your Role:

  • Lead multiple teams within the Reconciliations, Client Service and Delivery group. The Reconciliations function is responsible for reconciling client transactions to 3rd party data, to ensure the integrity and accuracy of the records. The focus of the CSandD function is to identify and resolve issues described in the 3rd party reconciliations, to ensure that the portfolio is maintained (cash flows and security updates), and that any residual risk is captured and signed off prior to production of financial statements.

  • Actively review portfolios and Service Level Agreements to ensure compliance and adherence to best practice protocols.

  • Initialize new client relationships, lead new fund setups, conversions and migrations.
  • Coach and develop staff to perform successfully in their current roles and develop them into senior management positions.
  • Contribute to and/or take a leading role in projects, initiatives and audit requests from both internal and external parties.

  • You have a Bachelor or Master level degree.

  • You have strong customer relationship management skills.
  • You have strong analytical skills.

title: Executive Pastry Chef
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

A warm welcome framed by spacious, modern design awaits you in the heart of Toronto's historic Yorkville neighbourhood. Enjoy authentic French cuisine paired with one of our 350 wine labels at Café Boulud, and specialty craft cocktails at our spirited lobby lounge and bar. Enjoy the serenity of our Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rated Spa, or step out and explore the vibrant character of Toronto's most glamorous shopping and restaurant district.

Join our team!

Are you ready to take the next big step in your hospitality career? Four Seasons Hotel Toronto is seeking an Executive Pastry Chef who shares our passion for excellence and brings warmth and authenticity to every interaction. The Executive Pastry Chef is a Department Head position reporting to the Director of Food & Beverage and oversees all pastry and bakery production for the hotel’s outlets, in‑room dining, banquets, and special events, ensuring that every creation reflects the craftsmanship, quality, and luxury synonymous with the Four Seasons brand.

About the role:

As the Executive Pastry Chef at Four Seasons Hotel Toronto, you will serve as a key member of the Food & Beverage leadership team, responsible for shaping the strategic direction, operational excellence, and creative vision of the hotel’s pastry program. You will lead a talented pastry team, consisting of a Pastry Junior Sous Chef and over 15 pastry team members. In your role, you will manage daily production, develop innovative menus, and uphold the highest levels of food quality, consistency, safety, and guest satisfaction.

What you will do:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide inspirational leadership, vision, and direction for the Pastry Department, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and creativity.

  • Select, train, mentor, evaluate, and develop pastry team members to support continuous improvement and long‑term talent growth.

  • Oversee scheduling, staffing needs, and performance management to ensure optimal daily operations.

Culinary Excellence & Menu Development

  • Design, plan, and execute seasonal and innovative pastry menus across all hotel outlets and events.

  • Ensure consistently superior quality in the preparation, presentation, and flavour of pastries, desserts, breads, and baked items.

  • Conduct tastings, demonstrations, and pre‑service briefings to educate staff on products, techniques, and service standards.

  • Collaborate with the F&B leaders to support marketing, PR, and social media initiatives with creative pastry concepts.

Operational & Financial Management

  • Oversee all pastry production while ensuring smooth workflow, accurate planning, and alignment with business volumes.

  • Monitor and manage departmental budgets, labour forecasting, food costs, inventory, waste, and purchasing to achieve financial targets.

  • Establish and maintain effective control systems to ensure portion consistency, product quality, and proper inventory management.

  • Review vendor options and purchasing specifications to ensure premium ingredient quality.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Uphold Four Seasons standards, local regulations, and federal guidelines related to hygiene, sanitation, food and kitchen safety.

  • Maintain impeccable cleanliness, organization, and operational readiness within all pastry kitchen areas.

  • Conduct regular product quality checks, ensuring freshness, accuracy, consistency, and excellence.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with culinary, banquet, restaurant, and room service teams to ensure seamless guest experiences.

  • Attend leadership and operational meetings to communicate departmental needs, updates, and initiatives.

  • Address guest feedback professionally, ensuring personalized responses and creative solutions that exceed expectations.

  • Keep the Director of Food & Beverage informed of operational challenges, recommending effective solutions and improvements.

What you will bring:

  • Minimum 3–5 years of previous experience as an Executive Pastry Chef, Head Pastry Chef, or senior pastry leadership role within a luxury hotel, fine‑dining restaurant, or high‑end hospitality environment.

  • Proven expertise in pastry arts, including modern pastry techniques, chocolate work, plated desserts, and bakery production.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, train, and guide a diverse team in a high‑volume environment.

  • Comprehensive understanding of F&B operations, cost control, labour management, menu engineering, and purchasing.

  • Exceptional creativity, precision, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining the highest culinary standards.

  • Proficiency with kitchen management systems, inventory software, and POS systems.

  • Flexibility to work varied schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs.

  • Culinary degree or equivalent professional training strongly preferred.

  • Outstanding communication skills and command of the English language.

  • Additional languages are a strong asset for career growth.

What we offer:

  • Paid time off, including vacation days, management holiday days, and sick days

  • Exclusive discount and travel programs with Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts worldwide

  • Complimentary meal per shift in our employee dining room, OASIS

  • Complimentary dry cleaning of business clothes

  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities, including educational assistance, discounted eCornell courses, and access to complementary e-training

  • Robust extended flex benefit plan through Manulife, including medical, HCSA, dental, vision, life insurance, virtual health care, EAP, DPSP/RRSP/TFSAs

  • Monthly Employee Recognition celebrations and Bi-Annual Employee Parties

  • Sponsorship of work permits for qualifying candidates

... and more!

The salary range for this role is $85,000 to $95,000.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Electrical Systems Engineer
description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Workplace: On-site, 5 days per week
Location: Las Vegas, NV

As an Electrical Systems Engineer, focused on Root Cause Analysis, you will be the critical link between our design engineering teams and the fleet operations technicians. Your primary mission is to ensure the reliability and uptime of our public vehicles by driving hands-on repairs, contributing to complex electrical troubleshooting, and executing formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurring issues. You will collaborate daily with technicians on the shop floor and translate diagnostic findings into actionable engineering improvements.

Responsibilities
Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action
• Lead cross-functional RCA investigations for systemic or high-severity electrical failures using industry-standard methodologies
• Implement temporary containment actions (workarounds/immediate repairs) while simultaneously driving long-term, permanent corrective actions.
• Present RCA findings to hardware, firmware, and software engineering teams to influence future design iterations and improve vehicle reliability
• Maintain detailed failure analysis documentation and track the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time
Technician Collaboration & Mentorship
• Work shoulder-to-shoulder with service technicians on the floor to guide complex repairs and component replacements
• Translate complex engineering concepts into accessible, practical guidance for the technician team.
• Actively listen to technician feedback regarding serviceability and diagnostic pain points, advocating for improvements in diagnostic software and vehicle design
• Provide training to technicians on the use of CAN tools, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and proper electrical safety protocols

Qualifications
• Experience level: 5+ years' experience in automotive/robotics/aerospace or similar
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related technical field.
• Wire Harness Expertise: Understands standard repair processes and can actively demonstrate and coach technicians
• RCA Proficiency: Deep understanding and practical application of formal Root Cause Analysis methodologies (i.e. Shainin, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa diagrams, Fault Tree Analysis)
• Hands-On Aptitude: Strong ability to read complex wiring schematics and use traditional bench tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers). You must be comfortable turning wrenches and working directly on vehicles
• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven track record of building trust and working seamlessly with both blue-collar technicians and white-collar design engineers

Bonus Qualifications
• Harness Manufacturing: Experience with hands on build of electrical wire harnesses
• Functional Safety: Familiarity with strict automotive safety standards like ISO 26262
• Rapid Response Leadership: Experience leading fast-paced teams to solve critical, high-pressure problems
• CAN Network Understanding: Proven, hands-on experience using industry-standard CAN network analysis tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) to monitor traffic, inject signals, and diagnose network health

Salary Range
• $110,000-120,000
• The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: Associate Director - Sustainability
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Sustainability Consultant

We are looking for Sustainability Strategy Consultant for our Sustainability Services team.

JLL is investing in engaged and purpose driven people who believe that they want to make a difference by creating sustainable cities and built environment. With or without experience we are keen to meet with you to share our passion and ambitions.

About JLL

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 92,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honoured to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Context

Becoming more sustainable is one of the biggest challenges facing corporates today – and the built environment accounts for approximately 40% of the world’s CO2 emissions. Everyone’s now asking how can we decarbonise our real estate, preferably in the most efficient and effective way. It’s where JLL’s sustainability experts can make a tangible difference, advising companies on how to invest in and implement measures that deliver a potent combination of financial, environmental, and social returns. Join JLL to drive the change that’s needed and shape the future of real estate for a better world — a net zero world.

The built environment is generating nearly 40% of the total global carbon footprint. With global warming and urbanization this trend can only increase unless we decide to combat it. Many corporations have made pledges to reduce to NZC but the road to deliver on these promises still needs to be defined and implemented. JLL manages more than 500 million square meters of real estate on behalf of its clients so we believe that we have role to play to drive the sustainability agenda to shape a better world.

Our Sustainability Ambition

At JLL, sustainability is more than a saying. As a business we’ve made our own commitment to reduce scope 1, 2 & 3 emissions down to zero by 2040 (see our Global Sustainability report). To achieve this ambitious goal, we will need to engage with our clients - almost 97% of our emissions are generated by the buildings we manage in their portfolios. With this commitment we must deploy best in class sustainability practices with all of our clients across the 500 million billion square meters that we manage globally, whether investors or occupiers, from strategy to transforming assets, project management down to managing assets.

We recognize the importance of sustainability because it enables us to contribute to a better world and shape the future of real estate. We want to make JLL a world-leading, sustainable professional services firm by creating spaces, buildings and cities where people can thrive. To do so, we aim to drive disruptive and impactful change by embedding sustainability into everything we do.

Learn more about Sustainability at JLL

About the Job

At JLL, we are driving sustainability through everything that we do. We are building up our Sustainability practice, to drive our end-to-end sustainability solutions in real estate, including: Client Solutions, Strategy Consulting, Performance & Design, and Operations.

This role is embedded in the Strategy Consulting team, where you will work with our clients to help them think through their sustainability strategies, including what reporting they require and what certification they need. You will deliver consulting services, provide advice and will be accountable for delivering income for our business. Work in this career pathway typically does not require an engineering degree as you will be involved in providing non-engineering related sustainability consulting. The role requires a passion for sustainability and gives professional the opportunity to develop their careers as engineering & energy consultants.

What this job involves

  • Build strong working relationships with client teams through the provision of accurate and timely advice and deliverables.

  • Participate in business development activities to grow client consulting services, support cross-sell of JLL services and contribute to achieving challenging but realistic business growth targets.

  • Support the development of client strategy implementation journeys and bring the strategy to life through engagement.

  • Provide recommendations and action plans to bring sustainability management plans to life through engagement with the client’s internal teams, their property managers and contractors.

  • Manage the delivery of a range of client tasks, ensure a professional relationship and the effective delivery of sustainability reporting services.

  • Carry out research and analysis and create briefing notes on a range of non-technical subjects, sustainability topics, for example, environmental legislation and sustainability supply chain impacts.

  • Provide support to clients in developing processes, targets, guidelines and progress actions through scheduling and leading regular progress meetings to track and promote project progress and liaison.

  • Participate in process and service line enhancement and development activities to embrace best practice, client demand and support upskilling of internal and external teams.

  • Provide support to colleagues in the development, shaping and enhancement of service offering for clients

Sound like you? Here are the skills we are looking for:

Technical Skills:

The job requires a basic level of understanding of some but not all of the following areas,

Climate Risk strategy

  • Develops climate risk strategies suitable for application to varied client situations and circumstances.

Climate science

  • Understands climate science, and the impact of personal, commercial and property on global warming and sustainability.

GHG Emissions

  • Familiar with Greenhouse gas emissions baselining.

Sustainability Regulations / Frameworks

  • Understands local, regional and global regulations (environmental or social) that affect the built environment

External Reporting

  • Understands external reporting structures covering sustainability. Understanding of the protocols governing external reporting, reporting frameworks and knows how to collect and organize the data for external reporting.

Sustainability KPI's

  • Identifies, benchmarks and sets kpi's suitable for application to different sustainability activities

Commercial & Business Driven Sustainability

  • Understands commercial and business drivers resulting in organisations wanting to and needing to monitor their impact on society, climate net zero carbon and the drive to demonstrate improvement.

Sustainable Finance

  • Understands sustainability financials including IRR, NOI, payback, asset value

Sustainability by Asset Class

  • Understands sustainability impact by asset class - Retail, Residential, Industrial, Office, Hotel

Benchmarking Applications

  • Aware of available benchmarking application tools that are readily available inside and outside of JLL.

Technology Solutions Basics

  • Requires a general level of understanding, knowledge and skills relating to issues and priorities for Technology Solutions in sustainability.

Building Systems Knowledge

  • Understanding the physical behaviour of a building as a system and how this impacts energy efficiency, durability, comfort and indoor air quality and how this impacts innovating high-performance buildings.

Business Development / Sales

  • Emanates and/or facilitates revenue on behalf of the business through market, product or client development. Employee maintains accurate sales pipeline

Performance Management

  • Manages the performance and/or development of others.

JLL Services & Service Lines

  • Understands and can explain JLL's services and how they can interact with each other, understands the primary roles and responsibilities of the individuals who deliver the work of each service line.

Client Management

  • Clarifies client expectations, aligns priorities, and delivers results that earn repeat business and meet/exceed clients objectives.

Strategy

  • Crafts and documents a strategy to align to client goals, contract requirements, and covers required facets of a successful program or project.

Presentation

  • Builds clear and persuasive slide decks, presents them effectively and drives the audience to the desired outcome.

Communication

  • Expresses thoughts, messages and ideas, both written and verbal, so that others comprehend and receive positively.

Reporting

  • Collects & collates information and produces reports that are clear and accurate.

Personal Skills:

The job requires a basic level of understanding of,

Active Listening

  • Makes the effort to hear the words another person is saying and interpret & understand the complete message that is being communicated

Building Trust

  • Interacts with people in ways that build confidence in one’s intentions and those of the organisation as a whole

Client Orientation

  • Helps or serves the client or customer, builds rapport, builds partnerships and maintains constructive & respectful relationships in order to anticipate, understand, meet & exceed their needs and maximise value creation.

Commercial Awareness

  • Focuses on the bottom line and identifies opportunities that hold the most promise for additional sources of income or cost reduction.

Creativity & Innovation

  • Uses imagination to create innovative & engaging products & solutions that challenge the status quo

Prioritisation

  • Arranges activities in order of their importance, designates somethings more important than other things to meet delivery commitments

Relationships & Networks

  • Builds rapport and maintains friendly, respectful relationships across the business & externally with stakeholders, customers & stakeholders

Solution Development

  • Determines the best way of satisfying project or change goals, objectives & requirements

Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Believes that by working together you can do better work than by working separately or competitively

Technology Adoption

  • Understands how analytics & technology can be used to explain success, measure the effectiveness of activities and support decision making

What we can do for you:

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

title: SoC Security Architecture & SDL Lead
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced SoC Security Architecture & SDL Lead to drive both the Security Architectural definition and the end-to-end Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) across Arm’s hardware security IP and SoC programs.

This role unifies security-by-design leadership with process governance, ensuring that our silicon platforms achieve industry-leading trustworthiness from architecture through post-silicon delivery.

We have exciting opportunities for experienced and self-motivated Security Engineers with demonstrated expertise in SoC Solutions and looking to make a difference in an innovative and inclusive team. If you're ready to make an impact, you have found the right place!

Responsibilities:

The Security Architecture & SDL Lead is responsible for driving both the Security Architecture definition and the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) for Arm IP and SoC products. This role ensures that all subsystem and SoC designs meet Arm’s security requirements through detailed threat modeling, architecture, verification, and documentation. Acting as both a security process owner and technical authority, the SDL & Architecture Lead guarantees that security is embedded and successful from concept to production silicon.

As the Security Architect, you will be responsible for defining and developing creative Security Architecture solutions for SoCs for multiple product market segments. This includes solutions for the SoC Root of Trust, Secure Boot, Key Management, Confidential Compute, Authentication and Encryption, and Secure Manufacturing and Device Lifetime Management.

As the SDL Lead, you will lead the successful implementation of the Solution SDL process for the product, ensuring security objectives are achieved throughout the development and productization phases. This would include Threat Model, Security Architecture, Security V&V Plan, Documentation, and Certifications and Compliance leadership.

Required Skills and Experience:

Security Architecture Leadership

  • Develop architectures for SOC and subsystem Security, Root of Trust, Secure Boot, Key Management, Confidential Compute, Authentication, Encryption, and Secure Manufacturing. Architect robust access control, privilege management, isolation, and confidentiality mechanisms between hardware and software domains.
  • Develop and maintain architectural threat models, mapping assets, attack surfaces, and mitigations aligned with the Secure Development Lifecycle methodology. Derive Security Functional Requirements (SFRs) from threat models and ensure traceability through development and verification.
  • Working knowledge of cryptographic design, fault/side-channel mitigation, and firmware security. Lead creation of the Key Management Plan, ensuring secure key generation, distribution, storage, and lifecycle alignment across device usecases and manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with security certifications (PSA Certified, ISO/SAE 21434, FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria).

SDL Leadership

  • Own and lead the Solution SDL process across all project phases, ensuring compliance with Arm standards and external certifications.
  • Drive timely creation and review of SDL artifacts (Threat Models, Security Architecture, V&V Plans, and Security Documentation) and coordinate as necessary for for external audit and certification.
  • Integrate SDL checkpoints into program plans and ensure organizational engagement from design through post-silicon validation.
  • Deliver complete security documentation including Threat Models, Security Architecture Reports, Key Management Plans, and Assumptions of Use (AoUs).
  • Mentor engineering teams and champion SDL adoption across global engineering teams.

Verification & Validation Leadership

  • Collaborate with Verification & Validation Leads to define and implement Security Verification & Validation (V&V) Plans.
  • Ensure all SFRs are testable, verified, and validated at pre- and post-silicon stages. Ensure security issues are triaged, resolved, and systematically looped back into the SDL process for continuous improvement.
  • Approve sign-off criteria and ensure security verification evidence supports product release readiness.
  • Support security assessments, penetration testing, and certification activities (PSA Certified, FIPS 140-3, ISO/SAE 21434).

In Return:

We are proud to have a set of behaviors that reflect our culture and guide our decisions, defining how we work together to innovate, defy ordinary, and shape outstanding products!

  • Partner and Customer focus – We anticipate and exceed customer needs.
  • Teamwork and Communication – We collaborate optimally across diverse teams.
  • Creativity and Innovation – We challenge the status quo. We develop careers and personal growth.
  • Impact and influence – We deliver measurable, trusted results.
  • Deliver on your promises –You demonstrate ownership and accountability.
  • United in Purpose, Empowered Through Inclusion – We value diversity to build better solutions.

title: Senior Order Engineer
description:

title: Elektriker søges til installation af ladestandere i Hovedstadsområdet | Fast stilling
description:
På vegne af vores kunde søger vi, til en FAST stilling, erfarne og faglærte elektrikere til installation af ladestandere hos både private og erhvervskunder. Du får en selvstændig hverdag med ansvar for planlægning af egne opgaver og bliver en vigtig del af den grønne omstilling. Sammen sikrer vi, at projekterne gennemføres effektivt, sikkert og i høj kvalitet – altid i overensstemmelse med gældende standarder og forskrifter.


Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil omfatte:

  • Rådgive kunden om valg af ladestander og ladeeffekt.
  • Installere og montere ladestanderen på væg eller stander.
  • Trække kabler fra eltavlen til ladestanderen.
  • Opgradere eltavlen, hvis den eksisterende installation ikke har tilstrækkelig kapacitet.
  • Teste og fejlfinde installationen efter montering.
  • Informere kunden om korrekt brug og sikker opladning.
  • Udføre service, vedligeholdelse og reparation af eksisterende ladestandere.



Faglige Kvalifikationer
  1. Faglært elektriker
  2. Dybdegående kendskab til elektriske systemer, komponenter og installationsteknikker
  3. Kendskab til relevante lovgivningsmæssige krav og sikkerhedsstandarder inden for elektriske installationer
  4. Erfaring med installation af ladestandere er et plus



Personlige kvalifikationer
  1. Gode kommunikationsevner og evne til at forstå kunders behov
  2. Selvstændig og ansvarsfuld med evnen til at arbejde effektivt
  3. Fleksibel og tilpasningsdygtig med evnen til at planlægge arbejdsopgaver



Særlige forhold
  1. En spændende og udfordrende stilling med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling
  2. Konkurrencedygtig løn og attraktive medarbejderfordele
  3. Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i vores kunders liv ved at imødekomme dem og deres krav
  4. Fleksible arbejdstider
  5. Fast arbejde på 37 timer
  6. Overenskomst
  7. Firmabil



Ansøgning

Har du de rette erfaringer og kompetencer til at installere ladestandere i en fremtid med flere elbiler, opfordrer vi dig til at sende dit CV til Signe Frydendahl Jensen på mail aalborg-b@jobteam.dk.


Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig på 93633409 og uddybe muligheden hos virksomheden, hvor I sammen skaber gode løsninger!

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Kiro
description:
The future of software development is agentic. AWS is building Kiro — a frontier AI coding agent that tackles development tasks end-to-end, retains context across complex workflows, and continuously learns from its work. Kiro is already transforming how developers build and maintain software, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for engineers who want to shape this transformation. You'll work alongside exceptional talent solving novel problems at the intersection of AI and software engineering. The challenges are unique: orchestrating AI workflows across dozens of models, building context systems that make every interaction smarter than the last, and scaling it all to meet AWS's exacting standards for reliability and security.

Your impact will be immediate and visible. You'll ship features that directly improve how developers work — from launching new models in hours, to building intelligent routing, to designing the context layer that makes Kiro genuinely understand your project. These aren't incremental improvements; they're the building blocks of a new category of developer tool.

From day one, you'll have opportunities to lead — whether that's owning a critical system, defining technical direction for a new capability, or shaping how the team operates. You'll work across distributed systems, real-time streaming, multi-model orchestration, and AI infrastructure at scale. The team is small enough that your decisions matter and large enough that you'll always have someone to learn from.

This is your chance to build the agent that builds the future.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: CTO — AI 영상 생성·IP 권리 인프라 (5년이상, 지분·스톡옵션)
description:
About

AI 영상 생성 워크스페이스를 만드는 스타트업에서 기술 조직을 함께 소유할 CTO를 찾습니다.

저희는 기획부터 이미지·영상 생성, 편집까지 파편화된 AI 제작 파이프라인을 하나의 워크스페이스로 통합하고,
그 위에 얼굴·캐릭터 IP의 권리 관리 레이어를 얹는 것이 목표입니다.

법인 설립과 창업자 출자를 마쳤고 초기 투자를 유치했습니다. 신사동 사무실을 확보했고 공동창업자 3인이 풀타임으로 재직 중입니다. TIPS 신청을 준비하고 있으며, 2026년 MVP 출시와 2027년 1월 런칭 로드맵을 갖고 있습니다.
상세 제품 스펙과 기획, 인터랙티브 프로토타입은 완성되어 있습니다. 구현할 사람만 남았습니다.

이후 로드맵은 명확합니다. 한국 법인을 시작으로 미국 시장 진출과 현지 법인 설립을 계획하고 있으며, 글로벌 스탠다드의 지분 구조를 함께 만들어갈 예정입니다. 지금 합류하는 CTO는 한국에서 제품을 만들고, 미국 무대에서 회사를 키우는 전 과정을 함께합니다.
창업 팀은 글로벌 메이저 금융사와 IP 금융화 플랫폼 CSO 출신, 지상파 PD·VC 심사역 출신, 130만 회원 OTT·팬덤 플랫폼을 만든 콘텐츠 기업가로 구성되어 있습니다. 뉴욕대, KAIST 등 출신으로 한국을 시작으로 글로벌 시장을 목표로 합니다.
비전은 "모든 사람이 IP가 되는 세상"입니다.

비즈니스·콘텐츠·금융 쪽 창업자는 모두 모였고, 이 제품을 함께 소유하고 직접 만들 CTO가 마지막 퍼즐입니다. 지분(베스팅 조건)과 함께 스택·아키텍처·기술 조직의 전권을 가져가는 자리입니다.

Responsibilities

AI 영상 생성 파이프라인 설계 및 구현 (멀티모델 API 오케스트레이션 — Seedance, Veo, Kling 등)
기획이미지영상편집으로 이어지는 워크스페이스 백엔드 아키텍처 설계
생성 작업 큐잉·비동기 처리·실패 복구·크레딧 정산 시스템 구축
프롬프트 파이프라인 및 씬 슬롯 기반 생성 엔진 구현
데이터 모델 설계 (프로젝트·애셋·세션·IP 메타데이터)
기술 스택 의사결정 및 초기 개발 조직 빌딩

Requirements

백엔드 또는 풀스택 개발 경력 5년 이상
Zero to One 제품 구축 경험 (초기 스타트업 또는 신규 서비스를 아키텍처 설계부터 런칭까지)
LLM/생성형 AI API를 활용한 프로덕션 서비스 개발 경험
비동기 작업 처리·큐 시스템 설계 경험 (장시간 생성 작업 파이프라인)
클라우드 인프라(AWS/GCP) 설계 및 운영 경험
초기 스타트업 환경에서 오너십을 갖고 일할 수 있는 분

Preferred

AI 영상/이미지 생성 모델 API 연동 경험 (Seedance, Runway, Kling, Midjourney 등)
Cursor, Claude Code 등 AI-native 개발 도구로 프로덕션 코드를 작성해본 분
멀티모델 라우팅·폴백 설계 경험
초기 스타트업 CTO 또는 리드 엔지니어 경험
크리에이터 툴·영상 도메인에 대한 이해
영어 커뮤니케이션 가능 (미국 진출 시 글로벌 협업의 중심이 됩니다)

Benefits

지분 보상: 베스팅 조건의 지분 또는 스톡옵션 참여 (구조·규모는 협의)
글로벌 트랙: 미국 법인 설립 계획에 따라 글로벌 시장을 무대로 일합니다
기술 전권: 스택·아키텍처·채용까지 기술 관련 모든 의사결정을 소유합니다
준비된 출발점: 상세 제품 스펙과 기획, 인터랙티브 프로토타입 — 백지에서 시작하지 않습니다
안정적 기반: 법인·출자·초기 투자·사무실이 갖춰진 상태에서 합류합니다
AI-native 업무 환경: Cursor, Claude Code 등 최신 AI 툴 전사 지원
업무용 노트북 및 제반 기기 지급

title: Transporter - 40hrs/Day Shift
description:
Site: Cooley Dickinson Hospital, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

Under the direction of the Support Services Manager and within established organizational and departmental policies and procedures, responsible for performing a variety of duties, including transporting patients, and sorting, processing and delivering mail and packages.

This position is part of the 1199SEIU Bargaining Unit at Cooley Dickinson Hospital.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Non-Violent Crisis Intervention training (MOAB or equivalent) required within three (3) months of hire

  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills required

  • Demonstrated basic computer skills required

  • Demonstrated good judgment required; demonstrated ability to interpret and adhere to both verbal and written instructions required

  • Three (3) to six (6) months Transporter experience preferred

  • Availability to work weekends, and holidays required


Additional Job Details (if applicable)

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Use proper body mechanics to transport patients and equipment to all areas of the hospital. Transport and lift bodies into the morgue.

  • Transport blood to the floors as requested.

  • With, or without, nursing personnel, transfer patients onto and/or off beds, wheelchairs, and stretchers during patient transport.

  • Change oxygen tanks and maintain proper number of oxygen tanks in each unit.

  • Ensure proper IV positioning; make minor body adjustments and reset IV accordingly during patient transport.

  • Monitor patients requiring one to one observation, reporting change(s) in conditions and needs, and care as supervisor indicates.

  • Respond to security and life safety issues as needed.

  • Process incoming and outgoing mail and packages using a variety of delivery companies including, but not limited to, United States Postal Service, United Parcel Service and Federal Express.

  • Process and track packages using UPS computer.

  • Process outgoing letters using an automated mailing machine. Maintain related records and track charges by printing reports.

  • Prepare special mailings with Postal Service, i.e. First Class, Pre-sort and Third-Class Bulk Mailings. Complete necessary forms, sort and set up mailing for proper classification.

  • Sort interoffice memoranda and doctor’s reports and distribute them to the proper locations.

  • Adhere to strict confidentiality guidelines.

  • Maintain established hospital and departmental policies and procedures, objectives, confidentiality, quality improvement program, compliance, safety, infection control, and environmental standards.

  • Maintain professional growth and development through attendance at seminars, workshops, conferences or in-services, professional affiliations, or journals to stay abreast of current trends in field of expertise.

  • Meet annual competency and retraining requirements.

  • Attend meetings as required.

title: Assistant Project Lead
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Assistant Project Lead

Project and Development Services

What this job involves:

Pillar of the team

Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both), you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of small projects, and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore ways to bring out the best in your team by walking the talk when it comes to ensuring optimal outcomes for all stakeholders. Likewise, you’re in charge of the organisational structure for each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.

Your attendance to Project Control Groups (PCG) meetings is necessary—it is the best way to assist the project manager in creating accurate PCG reports. Additionally, you’ll help drive the effective use of JLL technology, which includes Project Home Page (PHP), Prolog and Atlas. And if you have excellent budget management skills, you’re perfect for this job! As this role needs someone who is good at forecast expenditure project and, most important, ensure that each process is within reasonable cost.

Building strong client relationships

We live and breathe client satisfaction. Thus, we need someone who share the same passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.

Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.

Upholding excellence in project delivery

For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect commercial interests of client and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Furthermore, you will create project-related reports, analyses and reviews.

Sound like you? To apply you need to be:

An expert in the field

Do you have a degree in any property-related discipline? How about at least three years of experience in design, construction or project management? If yes, we’re keen to discuss with you.

An empowering colleague

In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the ideal candidate is expected to promote open, constructive and collaborative relations with superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. Likewise, you’ll strive to gain the respect of JLL staff, clients and the broader business community.

What we can do for you:

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

Apply today!

Job Title:

Extension Educator, Urban Agriculture & Natural Resources/Community Development - Cuyahoga County

Department:

FAES | Cuyahoga County

This position is located in Cleveland, Ohio.

The Ohio State University Extension (OSUE) seeks an Educator to work collaboratively with county, area, and state teams of OSU professionals and with local agency leaders and volunteers. The Educator should have an understanding and familiarity with the agriculture and farming landscape of Cleveland. The Educator will be responsible for a broad range of basic to complex duties that could include but are not limited to: Providing guidance and/or leadership for Agriculture and Natural Resources and Community Development, targeted to local and area needs, focusing on urban audiences. Utilize appropriate methods, both formal and informal, of community assessment to identify educational needs and opportunities of local community. Design, implement and teach educational programming, based on these needs, to groups and individuals comprised of adults and/or youth. May also convene and facilitate community coalitions focused on those needs. The Educator may be required to replicate and adhere to existing programs that meet the needs of their local community.


The Educator will develop promotional material, work with and/or lead committees and volunteers, and establish and maintain partnerships within the community that support the achievement of the program goals. The Educator evaluates educational programs and dissemination methods, as well as, utilizes existing evaluation instruments to evaluate the teaching effectiveness, program quality and results of local programs. Participate in discussions with county representatives concerning program funding and may be responsible for the management of the county bud. May also be responsible for securing external funds to support local programming. Participate as a member of county, multi-county, and/or state Extension teams to further the overall mission, vision and values of both Ohio State University Extension and Agriculture and Natural Resources and Community Development.

The Educator will focus on urban agriculture operations, implementing trainings, advancing resource utilization, and providing general support to local growers and agribusiness owners. This Educator’s work will be a collaborative effort with the Farm Service Agency's Cleveland Urban County Committee and USDA's Urban Service Center (USC), the Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), and other community-based organizations. The Educator will focus on improving the sustainability and long-term viability of urban agriculture operations, will facilitate outreach and engagement, online resource access, research and technical assistance, and urban stakeholder data and mapping.

This Educator position is located in Cleveland and reports to OSU's statewide Urban Agriculture Specialist, with additional support and guidance from Cuyahoga County's Extension leader. This Educator will pilot new programs, leverage existing resources, and support statewide urban ag team communications, events, networks, and other emerging developments. To boost and foster the connection to Ohio's urban agriculture community, this Educator will help transfer knowledge gained in Cleveland to benefit Ohio's other metropolitan areas that reflects local contexts and priorities.

title: Lab Services (GXP) Media Prep Technician
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Lab Services (GXP) Media Prep Technician – JLL

What this job involves:

As a Lab Services Media Prep Technician, you'll serve as a critical support partner to research operations by ensuring the timely preparation, sterilization, and delivery of chemical and biological media essential to laboratory experiments. This role requires strict attention to safety, quality, and GXP compliance while managing the complete lifecycle of media orders—from precise calculations and documentation to autoclaving, labeling, and delivery. Working within a collaborative team environment, you'll maintain sterile operations, manage inventory, and adapt to changing operational priorities. Your meticulous work directly enables research staff to conduct experiments safely and efficiently, making you an essential contributor to laboratory operations and overall business success.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Prepare chemical and biological media orders from start to finish, including performing accurate calculations, completing required documentation, autoclaving, proper labeling, and timely delivery of sensitive formulations critical to research activities.

Sterilize laboratory materials including glassware, media containers, bioreactors, protective clothing, and other equipment required for sterile operations using established procedures and safety protocols.

Neutralize, disassemble, clean, and reassemble bioreactors according to standard operating procedures to prepare them for subsequent research use.

Fulfill buffer and media requests, coordinate waste removal services, maintain supply inventory levels, and initiate reordering processes to prevent operational interruptions.

Communicate proactively with supervisors regarding supply stock levels, material needs, equipment calibrations, software upgrades, deviations, scheduling changes, and operational concerns.

Execute both written standard operating procedures (SOPs) and verbal instructions with strict adherence to federal, state, and local regulations, GXP documentation requirements, and Lean 6S principles.

Support other lab services operations as directed by management, demonstrating flexibility and collaborative teamwork to achieve departmental and company objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Valid New Jersey driver's license and willingness to complete appropriate training for vehicles utilized in the role.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in following written SOPs with strict attention to detail, safety protocols, and quality standards in a laboratory environment.
  • Strong mathematical and calculation skills necessary for accurate media preparation, formulation measurements, and documentation completion.
  • Ability to work safely with chemical and biological materials while maintaining sterile conditions and adhering to GXP compliance standards.
  • Excellent communication skills to coordinate effectively with research staff, supervisors, and team members regarding schedules, materials, and operational requirements.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing work schedules and priorities as determined by operations management.
  • Commitment to strict adherence to all federal, state, and local laboratory regulations and safety requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a laboratory services, media preparation, or GXP-regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with autoclave operation, sterilization techniques, and aseptic practices.
  • Knowledge of bioreactor systems, cleaning procedures, and equipment maintenance protocols.
  • Experience with inventory management systems and supply chain coordination in laboratory settings.
  • Understanding of Lean 6S methodologies and continuous improvement principles.
  • Basic computer proficiency for documentation, inventory tracking, and communication purposes.
  • Background in chemistry, biology, or related life sciences field.

title: Team Lead - Rotating Equipment
description:
Keyera Career Opportunity

Why Keyera?

It’s our purpose-driven culture, benefits, and people. From flexible, customizable benefits and an employer-funded pension plan to our Keyera Connects social investment program and paid employee volunteer days, we’re focused on empowering our people and communities.

When you work with us, you'll enjoy:

  • Saving plan options, including an Employee Share Purchase Plan, RRSP, and TFSA

Paid vacation and eight flex days each year

Role/Location Specific

  • Keyera’s Northern Allowance is a tiered incentive program based on years of service, currently offered to employees working at the following locations: Grande Prairie Office, Wapiti, Simonette, Gold Creek, South Cheecham, and Fox Creek Terminal. This information reflects the current state of the program and may be subject to change over time.

Please note that compensation and benefits may be different based on the work location, position, and a candidate's experience and qualifications.

Job Type:

Permanent

THE POSITION

As the Team Lead – Rotating Equipment, you will be responsible for leading the maintenance strategy and execution for all rotating equipment at the KFS North facility. This includes oversight of Millwrights and contractors, ensuring safe, reliable, and cost-effective operations aligned with Keyera’s mission and values.

RESPONSIBILITES

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the technical expert for Millwright trade disciplines and rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines, etc.).
  • Lead work identification, validation, planning, scheduling, and execution for rotating equipment.
  • Ensure effective use of CMMS (Maximo) for all maintenance documentation.
  • Support planning and purchasing of corrective and preventive maintenance work orders.
  • Manage off-site equipment overhauls and repairs with third-party vendors.
  • Monitor and optimize PM and PDM programs to drive proactive maintenance culture.
  • Participate in daily and weekly scheduling meetings, backlog reviews, and MOC processes.

People & Performance Management

  • Lead and develop a team of Millwrights and contractors, ensuring alignment with Keyera’s cultural behaviors and corporate values.
  • Conduct annual performance reviews and individual development plans (IDPs).
  • Ensure team competency, training compliance, and engagement in continuous improvement.
  • Provide coverage for the Maintenance Manager as needed.

Safety & Reliability

  • Promote a safety-first culture with a strong field presence.
  • Own and resolve Maximo events (e.g., near misses, incidents, hazard IDs).
  • Ensure adherence to procedures, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Conduct job site visits to evaluate safety, quality, and compliance.

Financial Management

  • Accountable for OPEX, R&M, maintenance capital, and AFE project budgets.
  • Develop cost-effective strategies for in-house and third-party repairs.
  • Identify and implement maintenance cost avoidance and supply chain value initiatives.
  • Lead annual AFE submittals for rotating equipment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Journeyperson Millwright certification or equivalent technical background (P.Eng., P.Tech., C.E.T.).
  • Minimum 10 years of industrial maintenance experience with demonstrated technical expertise in rotating equipment, including the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and reliability of pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines, and other critical mechanical equipment.
  • 2+ years of leadership experience within a maintenance or operations environment is preferred; however, strong candidates with demonstrated leadership capability and a willingness to grow may also be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably Maximo, and industrial maintenance workflow processes.
  • Experience leading technical teams, managing contractors, and overseeing third-party repair vendors and major equipment overhauls.
  • Experience leading or overseeing employees within a unionized environment is considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated commitment to personal and process safety, plant reliability, and continuous improvement.

Posting Expiry Date:

Aug 9, 2026

At Keyera, we embrace collaboration, inclusion, and a workplace that is as diverse as the communities we serve. Our values foster an environment for every person to bring their whole self to work.

title: Transportation Design Engineer - CEIII
description:
AECOM is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Transportation Design Engineer to join our growing team in Murray, Utah. In this role, you will contribute to the design and delivery of impactful transportation projects including interchanges, highways, and urban corridors across the region. You will play a key role in developing 3D design models, preparing engineering calculations, and supporting project execution from concept through construction. This position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, take ownership of design elements, and further develop your technical expertise while mentoring junior staff.

  • Perform transportation engineering design for roadways, interchanges, and urban corridors using industry-standard tools and methodologies.
  • Develop and manage 3D models using AutoCAD Civil 3D, MicroStation, and OpenRoads / InRoads platforms.
  • Execute engineering calculations, analyses, and design tasks for moderately complex assignments.
  • Gather, review, and interpret engineering data to support design decisions and project development.
  • Prepare design plans, specifications, reports, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies while ensuring adherence to internal quality control processes.
  • Propose solutions to design challenges by adapting standard engineering techniques and prior experience.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure coordinated and efficient project delivery.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to entry-level engineers and support staff.
  • Manage assigned tasks to meet project budgets, schedules, and quality expectations with minimal supervision.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline and 4+ years of relevant transportation engineering experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or closely related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in transportation design, specifically with highways, interchanges, or urban roadway projects.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in the state of Utah or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.
  • Experience working with the Utah Department of Transportation or similar state or local agencies.
