Oceanfront splendour in perfect harmony with nature. Surrounded by white-sand beaches and black-lava landscapes, Four Seasons Resort Hualalai is perfectly situated for all kinds of island adventures. The spirit of Hawaii, from its long-held traditions to its inspired art, informs every detail of our idyllic retreat.

RESIDENTS BEACH HOUSE SERVER ASSISTANT

At Four Seasons Resort Hualālai, the Residents' Beach House is an exclusive oceanfront dining destination designed for Hualālai homeowners and their guests. Located along the shoreline and surrounded by the natural beauty of Hawaiʻi Island, the Residents' Beach House offers a relaxed yet elevated dining experience where personalized service, genuine relationships, and a strong sense of community come together.

We are seeking a dedicated and service-oriented Server Assistant to join our Food & Beverage team. This role is essential to delivering the exceptional dining experiences our guests have come to expect from Four Seasons. The ideal candidate is energetic, attentive, and passionate about hospitality, with a desire to support the service team while anticipating guest needs and ensuring every dining experience is seamless and memorable.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Assist Food Servers with delivering exceptional service and creating memorable dining experiences for guests.
  • Stock and replenish linen, china, silverware, and glassware while ensuring all items are polished and presentation-ready.
  • Greet guests with warmth and professionalism.
  • Serve food and beverages while providing accurate information about menu offerings.
  • Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly to requests.
  • Assist with the preparation of condiments, garnishes, and service stations.
  • Retrieve food from the kitchen and safely transport items to guests using trays.
  • Clear tables efficiently and maintain a clean, organized dining environment.
  • Set up, break down, and maintain dining areas, buffets, and food stations.
  • Support restaurant operations by moving tables and chairs and assisting with event or service preparations as needed.
  • Maintain Four Seasons standards of cleanliness, safety, and service excellence.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow team members and leaders to create a positive and productive work environment.

WHAT TO BRING

  • Required by the Hawaii State Department of Health to obtain a Tuberculous (TB) clearance card when working in food and beverage
  • High school diploma or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Minimum one year of food service or related hospitality experience.
  • Ability to carry and balance service trays safely and efficiently.
  • Strong guest service skills and a passion for hospitality.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality service.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and varied schedules based on business needs.

JOIN OUR ‘OHANA & ENJOY OUR AMAZING BENEFITS:

  • Hourly Rate: $17.15
  • An on-site Physical Therapist
  • 24-hour access to Indoor and Outdoor Gym
  • Holiday, Vacation & Sick pay
  • Robust Benefit Plan
  • Company Match 401K Plan
  • Laundered Employee Uniform
  • Free employee meals prepared by the Four Seasons Culinary ‘Ohana
  • Complimentary stays at Four Seasons Worldwide
  • Training and Development Opportunities
  • Employee Recognition Programs

Property Executive – JLL

As a Property Executive at JLL's Aljunied Jurong Industrial Estate site, you'll be the hands-on guardian of building operations for a JTC terrace workshop facility. This is a critical, independent role where you'll manage day-to-day building operations including M&E systems, cleanliness standards, pest control, and most importantly—tenant engagement and coordination. You'll oversee repair and replacement work, manage defects rectification throughout the Defects Liability Period, and serve as the primary liaison between building owners, facilities management companies, tenants, and contractors. This isn't a high-rise intelligent building—it's an open-area terrace workshop environment that requires regular site walking, climbing stairs, and being ready to respond 24/7 to critical situations like fire or electrical outbreaks. If you're someone who thrives working independently, values safety above all, and enjoys building strong relationships with tenants and service providers, this role offers the opportunity to make a real impact on facility operations.

What your day-to-day will look like:

What we offer:

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary:

Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.

Job Responsibilities:

About the Role

The Software Lead is responsible for the successful development and maintenance of the automotive embedded software products (ADAS ECU) from concept to production within project and company mandated targets. The Software Lead is the key technical interface for all software engineering topics.

This role involves hands-on ADAS ECU SW development, and the SW project management. The role requires independent operation, leadership of the software team, and effective communication of project status and deliverables.

Your Responsibilities

  • Development (design, implement, test and debug) of core and/or application specific software requirements for complex automotive embedded electronic module serial production projects
  • Create/Maintain SW Timeplan per internal and external milestones, including effort estimates, expected work products, and product deliveries. Also, responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the project SW team per the production engineering schedule, providing high level guidance and direction on project work.
  • Responsible for the releasing the software deliverables with all needed work products to the Engineering project team and the manufacturing team (Release Notes, Software Test Reports, First Article)

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership to software team members, supporting their development and ensuring project success.
  • Define, communicate, and document software architecture, making technical trade-offs when needed.
  • Support system requirements negotiations, and review/approve engineering work products.
  • Facilitate continuous improvement by implementing enhancements to products, processes, and programs.
  • Manage SW risks. Report status, prepare contingency and mitigation plans and execute corrective actions

Who we are looking for

Education

  • Master’s degree in software engineering

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience in serial development for automotive software
  • Minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in a software leadership role is desired
  • Comprehensive knowledge working with operating systems on MCU or ARM
  • Strong technical background; comprehensive working knowledge in embedded C/C++ Development
  • Comprehensive knowledge of configuration management, project planning and tracking techniques

  • Involvement in successful launches of automotive software products is a plus

title: Fulfillment Strategy & Network Lead

About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

As the Fulfillment Strategy & Network Lead, you will be the "right hand" to our fulfillment leadership, acting as the primary architect for our most critical scaling initiatives. From launching new regional distribution hubs to re-engineering our NPI (New Product Introduction) readiness, you will translate executive vision into the physical reality of a world-class supply chain. If you are a high-level problem solver who thrives on navigating ambiguity and building the systems of the future, come help us shape how cutting-edge technology reaches the world.

What You’ll Do:

title: Mech and Robotics Tech
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician - JLL

What this job involves:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will have the opportunity to mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

  • Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

  • Maintain a positive working relationship across all the Operations facility

  • Track and store department inventory

  • Move up to 49lbs as well as stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, with or without reasonable accommodation

  • Possible travel up to 20% at a minimum.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights and/or holidays

  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment

  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field

  • 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls

  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading

  • 1+ year of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles

  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards

  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)

  • Experience with robotic or electromechanical operation and maintenance

  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions

Physical Demands

  • Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking

  • Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds

  • Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)

  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces

  • Standing/walking on concrete surfaces for 10+ hour shifts

  • Working at heights (as stated previously)

  • Pushing/pulling wheeled equipment and carts up to 100+ pounds

  • Maneuvering awkward or bulky equipment parts

  • Working in cramped positions under/behind machinery

At JLL, we work together to create a brighter future for our clients, colleagues, and communities. Our collaborative culture—locally and globally—drives innovative solutions. We value wellbeing, inclusivity, and belonging, ensuring every team member feels supported. JLL is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

On-site –Brookshire, TX

RME

title: Calibration and Instrumentation Technician
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

Join JLL as a Calibration and Instrumentation Technician, where you'll oversee the daily operation of campus systems, utilities, and process equipment while ensuring critical building automation systems operate within design parameters in the most energy efficient manner. This highly technical position is essential to JLL's commitment to delivering safe, reliable, and optimized facility operations for our pharmaceutical and life sciences clients by managing Building Automation Systems (BAS), troubleshooting advanced control systems, and performing calibrations and preventive maintenance on instrumentation and process equipment. You'll utilize the site BMS to monitor and control systems, manage outside BMS contract service providers, and take appropriate actions to protect equipment and personnel when systems are not functioning properly, directly impacting product quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance in cGMP manufacturing environments. At JLL, we are shaping the future of real estate for a better world, and as a Calibration and Instrumentation Technician, you'll be instrumental in maintaining the sophisticated control systems and critical utilities that enable pharmaceutical manufacturing operations including WFI, Clean Steam, HVAC, Compressed Gases, Waste Treatment, CIP systems, Autoclaves, and Aseptic Filling systems. This position offers an excellent opportunity for experienced instrumentation and controls professionals who possess a high level of technical expertise with building and process systems, excel at troubleshooting complex automation platforms, and thrive in regulated environments where precision, documentation, and customer service directly impact manufacturing operations, facility reliability, and regulatory compliance. Whether you have deep experience in pharmaceutical facilities or are looking to apply your instrumentation expertise to a dynamic life sciences environment, we're committed to empowering you to develop advanced technical skills and build a meaningful career with JLL while supporting critical manufacturing operations that make a difference in patients' lives.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Troubleshoot building and process automation from basic to advanced control including digital communications used in automation and control systems, field and test instruments, and install, troubleshoot, and repair campus systems, utility, and process equipment & instrumentation while fine-tuning loops to achieve better environmental control and energy savings.

  • Work on Siemens Building Automation System by installing physical devices/instruments, connecting them to field panels, building points and graphics, trending points, managing alarms, performing field troubleshooting, and troubleshooting, repairing, and verifying operation of the SCADA remote monitoring and control system for campus systems, utility, and process equipment.

  • Perform troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, calibrations, and physical repair work by testing and calibrating electrical, mechanical, electromechanical, and analytical instruments & equipment for conformance to established standards using engineering principles on systems including WFI, Clean Steam, HVAC, Compressed Gases, Waste Treatment, CIP, Autoclaves, Glassware Washers, vessels, Cold/Warm equipment & rooms, Control Systems, and Aseptic Filling systems.

  • Interact with other departments to schedule activities around the production schedules of cGMP Manufacturing and Process Development departments, schedule self-performed work assigned at beginning of month and due by end of month, assist team members during equipment startup to identify and correct problems during troubleshooting, and evaluate control system performance to make recommendations that optimize process efficiency, reliability, and safety.

  • Read and interpret prints, schematic drawings, manuals, and specification documents, mark up and create red line drawings, provide complete and accurate documentation, maintain trained and certified status as required in cGMP, GLP, HR, and industry procedures, support internal, Client, and Regulatory Agency audits as required, and contribute to the creation and updating of maintenance and calibration procedures to match best practices and lessons learned.

  • Identify and order spare or replacement parts for equipment utilizing inventory management system, work with shipping to send out equipment or standards for offsite vendor service and track status, recommend facility improvements to meet OSHA safety, ISPE, or FDA guidelines, review system operations reports to ensure systems function properly and operate energy efficiently without running redundant equipment when not required, and provide responsive customer support with emphasis on customer satisfaction.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10+ years of experience working with electrical or instrumentation/controls systems demonstrating hands-on technical expertise in troubleshooting, calibrating, and maintaining process instrumentation, building automation systems, and control platforms in industrial, pharmaceutical, or commercial facility environments.

  • Knowledge of BMS platforms including but not limited to Siemens, DeltaV, Honeywell, and Allen Bradley with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot automation systems from basic to advanced control, manage digital communications, install and configure field devices, build points and graphics, and perform trending and alarm management.

  • Proficiency in basic computer application software such as MS Office, Outlook, and CMMS systems for documentation, work order management, reporting, and tracking of calibration activities, maintenance records, and equipment service histories to support regulatory compliance and data-driven facility operations.

  • Adequate skills to perform required job functions with minimal supervision including ability to read and interpret technical documentation such as P&IDs, schematic drawings, loop diagrams, manuals, and specification documents, and create accurate red line drawings and documentation for regulatory compliance.

  • Valid driver's license with availability for 24-hour on-call responsibilities to respond to emergency situations, system malfunctions, or critical equipment failures that require immediate technical expertise to protect equipment, personnel, and manufacturing operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Controls, Automation, or related technical discipline, or equivalent work experience demonstrating advanced technical knowledge of control systems, instrumentation theory, and process automation in pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing environments.

  • Valid trade license or completion of an approved apprenticeship program in instrumentation, electrical systems, or industrial controls demonstrating formal technical training and regulatory compliance for specialized technical work.

  • Proficiency in programming Controls (BAS/BMS) systems with hands-on experience in control and simulation techniques and strategies, PID loop tuning, control optimization, and implementation of advanced control strategies to improve process efficiency, reliability, and energy performance.

  • Experience working in a customer service environment interacting with clients in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or cGMP manufacturing settings with ability to remain focused and independent with minimal supervision while demonstrating excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively through oral and written reports.

  • Strong conflict resolution skills, ability to handle and resolve customer/consumer complaints efficiently, demonstrates leadership by example, effectively manages competing priorities, possesses strong analytical skills, and makes well-informed decisions based on a wide range of data to support facility operations and manufacturing success.

Location: Onsite

Work Schedule: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and Weekend Shifts Available. Subject to 24-hour availability for emergency response.

Physical Job Requirements: Overhead work and working at heights required. Must be able to work in cleanroom manufacturing environments which include gowning and respirator requirements. Environmental conditions vary based on job being performed; work may take place in calibration lab and/or plant. Must be capable of working outdoors in all types of weather conditions. Skilled and physically able to operate electric hand tools, work on ladders, carry tools, lift and carry heavy loads, and operate required equipment.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

title: Clinic/Practice Assistant, Orthopedics
description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Medical Group Northern Massachusetts, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

Mass General Brigham Sports Medicine is seeking a Medical Administrative Assistant to support smooth and efficient clinical practice operations at our Beverly location. Our nationally recognized sports medicine specialists provide advanced care for the full spectrum of sports-related injuries and orthopedic conditions, serving athletes and non-athletes of all ages through innovative, research-based treatment and rehabilitation services.
Role Summary
Under general supervision, the Medical Administrative Assistant performs a combination of administrative and clerical duties to support patient visits, scheduling, registration, check-in and check-out, documentation, and day-to-day office operations. This position does not require direct patient care, but plays an important role in creating a welcoming, organized, and efficient experience for patients, providers, and care teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Perform routine administrative and clerical duties for a clinical service or physician practice office.
• Greet and assist patients while supporting appointment scheduling, check-in, and check-out processes.
• Make, update, and maintain patient appointments and appointment records.
• Answer telephones, assist callers with routine inquiries, take accurate messages, and route questions appropriately.
• Support patient documentation by filing materials, printing appointment schedules, scanning documents, and processing information into patient medical records.
• Process patient billing forms and may accept co-payments when required.
• Request patient medical records and laboratory test results as needed.
• Open and distribute unit mail, faxes, and other office communications.
• Prepare forms, records, schedules, memos, and other materials as directed.
• Handle, screen, and route messages related to prior authorizations, provider questions, prescription refills, and test results.
• Serve as a scheduling, registration, and billing system resource or “Super User,” providing assistance and training to others as appropriate.
• May perform more complex or specialized administrative functions, such as surgical scheduling or schedule changes and blocking, at an advanced competency level.


Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and general office systems.
  • Knowledge of office operations, standards, and procedures, including filing, copying, scanning, printing, and faxing.
  • Ability to use phone systems, manage non-routine calls, and resolve routine issues appropriately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to compose and edit emails, memos, and letters.
  • Ability to understand written work-related documents and take complete, accurate messages.
  • Strong organization, time management, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to follow established protocols and work effectively within clinical office systems.

Schedule and Location

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position based at 100 Cummings Center in Beverly, MA. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Two to three years of office experience required.
  • Certified Medical Administrative Assistant (CMAA) credential preferred.

title: Electrical Engineering Intern - Transmission & Distribution (Nov 2026)
description:
As an Electrical Engineering Intern within our Transmission & Distribution team, you will support primary and secondary substation design across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), gaining exposure to the breadth of T&D electrical engineering so you can explore your interests and potential career path with us.

You will work alongside a supportive, experienced team and high-calibre clients, assisting with substation electrical design tasks and studies such as grounding, lightning protection, and introductory power systems analysis. Each week will bring new learning opportunities and real project experience.

How you’ll make a difference:

  • Assist with substation primary/secondary design inputs and draft brief sections of reports/specifications under guidance.
  • Assist with the development of substation models and undertake simulations for primary electrical studies using specialised software packages.
  • Join supervised site visits and basic testing (e.g., soil resistivity), then capture and organise field data for design use.
  • Providing construction support during the build phase while collaborating across multiple disciplines to deliver projects
  • Supporting project delivery by preparing budget estimates and ensuring outputs meet time, quality, and cost objectives

  • 12-week paid internship (mid-November to mid-February)
  • Real project experience: Contribute to meaningful work and apply your university learning to real-world projects from day one.
  • Exposure to iconic projects: Be part of projects that help shape communities, cities and infrastructure across Australia and New Zealand.
  • AECOM Summer Series: Connect with senior leaders from across our business through an exclusive program of presentations providing insight into different career pathways and areas of expertise.

  • Summer Intern attributes: Interns who are curious and excited to apply their studies in a professional environment. You'll bring strong communication and teamwork skills, a positive and proactive attitude, adaptability, and a commitment to professionalism and integrity.
  • Bachelor’s Degree: You must be in your penultimate year of a Bachelor’s or Postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.

title: Account Director
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Position Overview:
The Account Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational oversight, and successful delivery of all contractual obligations for the Consolidated Facilities Management (CFM) Services contract covering multiple federal locations. This role ensures performance standards, client satisfaction, compliance, and financial results are achieved in alignment with the Master Consolidated Facilities Management Performance Work Statement and all relevant federal, state, and local regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide overall direction and management for all facilities management, operations and maintenance, elevator, and landscaping services across contract locations, ensuring compliance with the scope of work, contract requirements, and performance standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the client (GSA) and act as escalation point for any contractual or operational issues.
  • Oversee all key contract personnel, including Project Managers, Facility Managers, Supervisors, and technical staff, ensuring they meet qualifications, training, and certification requirements as specified in the contract
  • Ensure implementation and adherence to Quality Control Program (QCP) and facilitate audits and reviews per the Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP).
  • Manage the performance of preventive and corrective maintenance activities, work orders, inspections, and scheduled services in GSA’s National Computerized Maintenance Management System (NCMMS).
  • Lead contract compliance practices, including safety, security, sustainability initiatives, and environmental management; drive adherence to all sustainability and reporting requirements.
  • Oversee contract financial management, budgeting, cost tracking, invoicing, and reporting.
  • Ensure all contract deliverables, reports, and documentation are prepared accurately and submitted on schedule.
  • Drive operational standardization throughout the portfolio.
  • Foster and maintain strong client and stakeholder relationships, addressing issues proactively and ensuring high customer satisfaction.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all service lines, leveraging industry best practices.
  • Oversee compliance with all wage determinations, Service Contract Act/Davis-Bacon Act provisions, and labor relations requirements for covered employees.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in facilities management or related field, with at least 5 years in a senior management role overseeing large, multi-site contracts or government accounts.
  • Experience managing union labor and compliance with collective bargaining agreements preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of federal government contract requirements and performance-based service delivery.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills.

• Collaborative driven with client and team

  • Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearances and suitability determinations as specified.

title: Research Scientist
description:
Job Description:

Title: Research Scientist (P3)

Location: Remote – USA, Canada

Reports to: Managing Director, Research Science

Vacancy: New vacancy

The Role:

As a Scientist in Research Science, you will analyze and interpret the results of survey research studies that measure customer satisfaction, and provide technical programming expertise working with Python, SQL, and other automation tools. Your job is to work closely with other researchers and scientists in the execution of programs to run advanced statistical modeling, data mining and analysis on survey and non-survey data.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

How will their role impact the business, department, and/or the marketplace? You will support syndicated studies that address industry-level consumer needs and serve as customer satisfaction benchmarks in a variety of industries such as Automotive, Financial Services and Insurance, or other Auto-adjacent sectors. The outcome of your work will be used by clients to help them understand what is important to consumers, how their brand performs relative to their competition, what their brand needs to do to improve and the financial benefit of making these improvements.

You will have the opportunity to work with industry experts to learn how different industries are structured and how they leverage consumer information to guide product development and service improvement efforts. You will also have the opportunity to strengthen your project and data design and statistical skills by daily exposure to senior research staff at JD Power.

Research Science has global responsibility for the research design, analyses planning and execution of all advanced analytics at JD Power Research Science department. Additionally, the team is responsible for establishing and monitoring the adherence of research best practices that serve as the basis for the quality of all research products at JD Power. Our role is critical to the success of not only individual studies, but to the strength and credibility of the JD Power brand. You will report directly to the Research Science Managing Director and join a team of highly educated and enthusiastic data scientists and researchers that collaborate regularly with each other and with other teams across the firm.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

  • Organized, detail oriented, and analytical thinker with experience in data modeling/mining, analysis, and reporting.

  • Able to leverage broad scope of knowledge including business rules and methodologies when performing basic and advanced analyses on datasets

  • Creates and maintains scripts/codes to clean and manipulate data, develop models, accurately calibrate model parameters, validate model performance, and create analytical outputs

  • Able to take ownership of projects and work with other individuals and teams to ensure project accuracy and timeliness of information to clients

  • Work with Research Science leads and other department leads in new product development

  • Work in collaboration with other team members to develop, test, interpret, and present research on new and innovative approaches, methods, or techniques that can be applied to the advancement of our business

  • Knowledge of and ability to work in a cloud computing environment is a plus

  • Knowledge of survey design and sampling methodology is a plus

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Python (required), SQL, SAS, SPSS

  • Masters with 2+ years of work experience or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Data Engineering, Psychology, Economics or related quantitative major fields

  • 4+ years of an advanced understanding of statistics and/or machine learning methods

  • Must be able to work effectively and collaboratively in a team oriented, global, and multi-cultural environment.

  • Fluent in English (read, write and speak)

The Hiring Manager says:

I’m looking for someone who can work as part of a broader engagement team and can use our data to help companies understand what drives customer satisfaction for their industry. This individual also has to work independently to analyze data using analytic packages (Python, SQL, SAS). If you’re right for this role, you are a self-starter who is able to develop creative solutions to problems, not be afraid to ask questions as you learn our company’s culture and do it all with enthusiasm.

This position has a starting salary range of $90,000 - $100,000 CAD / $100,000 - $110,000 USD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday

title: Senior Medical Safety Specialist
location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Senior Medical Safety Specialist is responsible for providing medical expertise and assessment to support patient safety throughout the product lifecycle for Neurovascular and Neuromodulation therapies.

The Senior Medical Safety Specialist is primarily responsible for providing technical and clinical information regarding product usage and performance, specifically as it relates to patient safety. You will collaborate with multiple functions including Research and Development, Risk Management, Quality/Post-Market Vigilance, Regulatory, and Clinical.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. This position is remote to enhance our competitive edge and expand our cross-functional collaboration efforts. This role will require 10% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Provides medical expertise and assessment to support patient safety throughout the lifecycle.

  • Provides technical and clinical information regarding product usage and performance, specifically as it relates to patient safety.

  • Collaborates with multiple functions including Research and Development, Risk Management, Quality/Post-Market Vigilance, Regulatory, and Clinical Affairs.

  • Maintains medical knowledge in medical specialties, diagnoses, treatments and procedures related to product and therapy areas.

  • Leverages medical knowledge and advocate for patient safety by providing medical safety input to internal functions and business processes across the product life cycle.

  • Acquires and maintains proficient knowledge of assigned products and therapies, such as device design and function, product labeling, indications, mechanism of action, care pathways, and overall safety profile (i.e. hazards and harms).

  • Actively acquires and maintains knowledge of relevant scientific literature associated with assigned devices/therapies.

  • Evaluates events and potential safety signals identified through Quality, Clinical, and Regulatory related business unit processes.

  • Authors high quality and accurate safety assessments per business unit processes, leveraging complaint data, literature, registries, or other data sources as appropriate.

  • Critically assesses and escalates newly identified safety issues per business unit processes for investigation assessment and action.

  • MD Designation only: MD may also need create and provide clinical information and safety reports as required by regulatory agencies including adverse events data from clinical trials and/or consumer usage, spontaneous or solicited sources, periodic and experience reports.

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of clinical experience (2+ years with an advanced degree).

  • Active healthcare license with clinical knowledge and relevant patient care experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a biologic science with preference towards healthcare or medical profession (e.g., nurse, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or other related medical/scientific field).

Nice to Have

  • Solid medical background with the ability to understand complex disease states and different treatment outcomes and complications with a preference towards Neurovascular and/or Neuromodulation specialty experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

  • Good understanding of regulatory guidance from European Medicines Evaluation Agency (EMEA), Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Microsoft Word and Excel and ability to learn new document systems/solutions.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Manager, Software Development Engineer
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

The Agent Platform team delivers a new AI focused experience for Workday customers, and most importantly their employees. We are at the forefront of Workday’s AI & Agentic initiatives with the objective to deliver and integrate Agentic capabilities across the entire Workday platform, including the widespread adoption and AI powered Assist features, rapid creation and deployment of Workday-native AI Agents, and the delivery of Workday’s Agent System of Record.

The Agent System of Record (ASOR) platform brings the Human and Digital Workforce experience together. Customers can securely deploy, extend, manage, and measure Workday-delivered agents, as well as partner-built and 3rd party agents all in the Agent Analytics Hub. ASOR is responsible for designing a highly configurable agent lifecycle for all types of agents (Workday Built, Third Party, and Managed Agents) with robust analytics and features for Agent Administrators.

We also contribute to significant agentic initiatives and features at Workday such as Ambient & Delegate runtime design, Agents as MCP Tools, and more!

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Manager to help lead our growing Workday Agent System of Record (ASOR) team. In this role, you will manage two scrum teams responsible for delivering core, critical features that power Workday’s agentic AI roadmap.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Functional Architects, cross-functional engineering partners, and key external partners to design and build the foundational Agent System of Record platform. Beyond technical execution, you will play a pivotal role in fostering a high-trust engineering culture, mentoring engineers, and instilling strong operational practices.

In this role, your responsibilities include:

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Manage and grow a team of 7–8 engineers working across front-end (React), Workday proprietary technology (XO), and various back-end services across our AI Platform.

  • Mentor and guide engineers through career development, cultivating a strong culture of continuous feedback, trust, accountability, and psychological safety.

Execution & Strategy

  • Take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery, execution quality, and technical outcomes for features across the ASOR platform.

description:

Quality Manager

Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. Global relocation/LTA support will not be considered for this position.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead and manage the Customer Quality team, setting priorities, assigning resources, and ensuring team development and performance.

  • Establish and oversee the complete customer complaint management process, from collection and measurement through root cause analysis and corrective actions, ensuring alignment with company standards.

  • Define and implement Customer Quality strategies and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement across all customer touchpoints.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams in root cause analysis and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions at product line level, promoting a fact-based and data-driven culture.

  • Manage customer case monitoring and escalation protocols, ensuring timely containments and resolution while maintaining compliance with warranty and service level agreements.

  • Coordinate with post sales services, engineering, operations, and other departments to push improvement initiatives, tracking closure rates and measuring impact on customer satisfaction and cost reduction.

  • Oversee warranty account management and cost allocation strategies, optimizing financial resources while ensuring proper case disposition compliance.

  • Develop and promote the Customer Care Response Process across the organization, establishing metrics, training the team, and monitoring adherence.

  • Drive identification and implementation of cost-saving and revenue-protection initiatives aligned with departmental targets, providing visibility to senior management.

  • Champion the voice of the customer in new product development and design reviews, ensuring quality perspectives are integrated early in the product lifecycle.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers, ensuring their concerns are addressed, and serving as the escalation point for critical issues.

  • Prepare strategic reports, dashboards, and business reviews for senior management on customer quality performance and improvement initiatives.

  • Supporting specific communication relevant to quality management in your area of responsibility.

  • Assisting in continuously identifying and addressing risks and opportunities related to quality management in the local organization.

  • Using quality data analytics from the organization to identify risks, failures, and non-conformances.

  • Facilitating resolution of customer cases by following a robust root cause analysis and implementing preventive and corrective actions.


Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

title: Sr Admissions Representative
description:
Purpose of the Position:

Under direct supervision, recruit qualified candidates for the college’s academic programs in a compliant, appropriate, and professional manner. Provide basic information, routine guidance, and assistance to potential students on matters related to enrollment and the admissions process. Evaluate and resolve student inquiries, issues, and problems, and ensure appropriate action is taken to the satisfaction of the student, Unitek College, and/or relevant regulatory agencies. Uphold enrollment standards by complying with related governmental regulations and standards of accreditation, and by enrolling only students who meet eligibility requirements as published in the college’s catalog. Demonstrate positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, excellent time management skills and the work ethic to follow-through on commitment to students and the organization. Use Company approved Admissions materials during telephone calls, interviews, and enrollment process. Observe and adhere to all company polices and best practices. Exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate course of action. All activities will be monitored to ensure consistency with company standards.

Job Responsibilities:

The expectation is that the majority of an Admissions Representative’s time will be spent directly interacting with prospects/students either in person or on the phone. It is also expected that the Admissions Representative meet all minimum standards outlined per the performance management program.

Prospect/Student Interaction (90%)

Building Relationships

  • Take inquiry calls from all potential students interested in knowing or receiving information about the programs—including entrance requirements, curricula, and academic standards—and encourage qualified prospects to schedule an appointment for an interview.
  • Return web inquiries and calls promptly to all potential students and give accurate information about the programs, including entrance requirements, curricula, and academic standards.
  • Make outbound phone calls to potential students that have expressed interest in attending the institution. Outbound calling efforts are a key component of this role.
  • Participation in organized phone-a-thons and dialing campaigns according to company best practices is required and is an essential part of day-to-day activity.
  • Initiate unsolicited leads and generate new business when not responding to outstanding
  • inquiries or working with current prospective students.
  • Follow up on all inquiries that fail to schedule or show for an interview.
  • Follow up with interviews that did not progress in the enrollment process and dropped/cancelled students to resolve any issues or address concerns.

Interviews

  • Schedule and conduct student interviews, wherein any reference to Financial Aid complies with the stated Company Policy.
  • Utilize only approved company materials during the interview process, and conduct interviews according to the stated policies and process at all times.
  • Meet with the potential students to explain the program offering and match the college’s benefits and advantages to the student’s needs. Discuss and advise suitable programs in accordance with the student’s desires, qualifications, and objectives.
  • Make all efforts to ensure that admissions management meets with the potential student and is well informed about the student’s motivations and concerns about attending the college.

Mentoring and Guidance (5%)

  • Provide basic information and routine advice, guidance and assistance to students using established procedures and policies on available programs and eligibility requirements, including the application of policies, procedures, and documentation regarding the admissions process.
  • Serve as a liaison between student and campus, and make all necessary enrollment forms available and assist in completion as needed (including reviewing applications and related documentation for compliance, partnering with Finance to ensure a high level of customer service during the transition, and following up to ensure that financial aid packaging is complete).
  • Mentor and advise students to help them identify their unique skills and interests.
  • Address any easily-resolved inquiries, questions, concerns or issues (may refer more difficult issues to a more experienced staff member), and ensure appropriate action is taken to the satisfaction of the student, Company, and/or regulatory agencies in compliance with policy, procedures and legal requirements.

Administrative (5%)

  • Accurately account for all inquiries and the admissions activity associated with all Inquiries.
  • Complete daily activity reports.
  • Ensure that all pre-start paperwork is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Keep all required reports current and accurate, including information stored in the system.
  • Attend and successfully complete all training for this position, as required at any time by the Company.
  • Attend meetings as directed by supervisor.
  • Key Behaviors
  • Dependability: Responds to requests for service and assistance
  • Teamwork: Balances team and individual responsibilities
  • Decision Making: Displays willingness to make decisions
  • Communication: Effectively communicates with others
  • Time Management: Is able to complete all job requirements in allotted time
  • Work Ethic: Displays an organized and results-oriented approach, and motivation to perform without extensive direction.
  • Accuracy: Displays high quality of work and level of accuracy
  • Regular, in-person attendance up to 5 days per week on campus/on site is an essential function of this position
  • This role requires on-site collaboration with students, faculty, and staff
  • Perform other duties as assigned by local leaders.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 2 years as an Admissions/Enrollment Representative or 5 years in a position with similar duties and responsibilities; sales or recruiting experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to fulfill Company Key Behaviors.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Ability to work assigned/flexible hours necessary to complete the job on a weekly basis.

We Offer:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment

  • 401K with a Company Match

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS

The Catering Supervisor is responsible for ensuring that their assigned events and activities are organized and executed providing a high-quality catering service throughout the catering department, suite services, backstage catering for performing artists, bar service and off premise catering events to achieve customer satisfaction and retention.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Planning, assigning, and directing work for catering employees.
  • Maintaining labor costs by adhering to schedules put before them.
  • Position is very hands on with excessive interaction with staff and customers during events.
  • Be at work and in proper uniform according to the scheduled time.
  • Assist with collecting all banquet equipment to include flatware, china, glassware, and serving pieces needed for each event.
  • Assist with preparation and set-up of event room when necessary.
  • Inventory Control, to include counting and requisitioning food, beverage and supplies, as needed before, during and after the event.
  • Complies with Health Department rules and regulation.
  • Provide friendly and courteous customer service at all times.
  • Breakdown tables and banquet equipment after each event.
  • Clean and return catering equipment and serving pieces to proper storage areas
  • Perform other duties as assigned and deemed necessary.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directly supervises multiple team members in the Catering Department.
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Bryce Jordan Center policies and applicable laws.
  • Acting as supervisor on duty for a particular event, responsibilities may include planning; assigning and directing work; ensuring event activities run smoothly, meeting guest and client needs and expectations; communicate any event or employee issues with Catering Manager or Director.

BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES

title: Process Engineer II, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT)
description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

Position Summary:

Process Engineer II, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) drives process optimization, technology transfer, and manufacturing scalability across Empower's 503A and 503B operations. Leveraging AI-enabled analytics, predictive modeling, and digital manufacturing systems, the role improves process performance, compliance, and operational efficiency. Success requires strategic thinking, execution rigor, learning agility, and technical expertise within a hyper-growth, highly regulated environment. P80–P90 talent demonstrates accountability, innovation, collaboration, and problem solving supporting manufacturing excellence and business performance.

Responsibilities:

Process Development

  • Process Optimization: Develops and improves manufacturing processes supporting efficiency, scalability, and compliance. Utilizes AI-enabled analytics and process intelligence tools to reduce variability, strengthen performance, and support reliable production execution, including packing operations.
  • Technology Transfer: Supports technology transfer activities ensuring successful transition from development to commercial manufacturing. Leverages AI-powered analytics and operational dashboards to improve readiness, process consistency, and product commercialization.
  • Process Validation: Executes process validation activities supporting manufacturing readiness and regulatory compliance. Applies AI-assisted analytics and statistical tools to strengthen process control, reduce risk, and support sustainable manufacturing performance.

Manufacturing Support

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Investigates manufacturing challenges, process deviations, and performance issues impacting quality or throughput. Utilizes AI-enabled analytics and root cause methodologies to accelerate issue resolution and improve process reliability.
  • Operational Collaboration: Partners with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Validation, Engineering, and R&D teams supporting process improvements and operational objectives. Leverages AI-powered collaboration tools to strengthen communication and execution.
  • Data Analysis: Evaluates manufacturing data, process trends, and performance metrics supporting data-driven decision-making. Applies AI-assisted analytics and statistical methodologies to identify opportunities and improve operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement

  • Innovation Support: Implements manufacturing solutions improving efficiency, product quality, and scalability. Utilizes AI-enabled analytics and automation technologies to strengthen process performance and support enterprise growth.
  • Risk Management: Identifies process risks and manufacturing challenges impacting quality or compliance. Applies AI-powered predictive analytics and risk assessment methodologies to improve process control and mitigation planning.
  • Operational Excellence: Drives continuous improvement initiatives supporting manufacturing performance and process reliability. Leverages AI-assisted workflow optimization and performance analytics to improve execution quality and operational consistency.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, process optimization, technology transfer, process validation, statistical process control, manufacturing science principles, and packing operations.
  • Proficiency using AI-enabled analytics platforms, manufacturing execution systems, statistical software, process monitoring technologies, and digital manufacturing tools supporting operational excellence.
  • Develop the Manufacturing Batch Record (MBR) and Packing Record, process flow, conduct site gap analyses, and prepare summary reports upon completion of engineering trials and stability batches.
  • Advanced knowledge of cGMP requirements, process validation methodologies, continuous improvement principles, risk-based decision-making, and regulated manufacturing operations.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and support complex manufacturing environments.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Minimum of four years of process engineering, manufacturing science, process development, or related experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Experience supporting technology transfer, process validation, scale-up activities, manufacturing troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems, statistical analysis software, AI-enabled process analytics, and digital manufacturing technologies preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Certified Pharmaceutical Industry Professional (CPIP), Professional Engineer (PE), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) certification preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

description:

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. Job Summary

SCHEDULE
36 hours a week
Day schedule 7a-5p or 7a-7p
Evening schedule - 9a-9p or 11a-9p
Self-scheduling based on the need of the unit
Three weekend shifts per time plan but based on the need of the unit (a Saturday or Sunday)

The Opportunity: Unit Coordinator | Inpatient Psych – Blake 11

Blake 11 is a twenty-four-bed locked psychiatric unit. The unit serves adults ages 18 and older. The inpatient service provides acute psychiatric care, diagnostic evaluations, and brief inpatient treatment. As a tertiary health care provider, Blake 11 accepts patients with diagnostically complex or treatment resistant disorders as well as patients with concomitant medical disease. Patients may be admitted to the unit 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The average length of stay is 7-10 days.


Essential Functions (Key Roles & Responsibilities)
• Provides administrative support to unit-based and hospital-wide clinicians and staff in an inpatient unit, functioning as the liaison between the patient, visitors and the clinicians.
• Expected to effectively organize priorities, complete tasks on time and to manage confidential patient information.
• Responsible for partnering with nursing to coordinate the day-to-day patient flow including communication to key players regarding patient admissions, discharges and transfers.
• Also expected to provide outstanding services for every customer interaction.
• Actual job duties may vary by department.

• Performs clerical and other duties to assist in the general administration of the floor or unit.
• Greets and interacts with patients, families, visitors and coworkers in person and via communication tools in a professional manner.
• Receives, prioritizes, organizes and manages information at the central nursing station, and throughout the unit.
• Schedules consultations, tests, procedures, and patient transport to other departments.
• Enters into electronic medical record accurate and timely information about admissions, discharges and transfers to facilitate efficient patient throughout the unit.
• Contacts ancillary service departments to obtain equipment, services and supplies; tracks status and location; uses designated process for identifying and facilitating repairs.
• May assist manager with payroll duties or scheduling of staff, or supervision of unit secretaries. Duties may vary by department
• Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all policies and standards


Qualifications

Education High School Diploma or Equivalent required or Associate's Degree Related Field of Study preferred Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree? No Licenses and Credentials Certified Health Unit Coordinator - National Association of Health Unit Coordinators (NAHUC) preferred Experience Administrative support experience 1-2 years required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities - Proficiency with office procedures and equipment, i.e., filing, copying, scanning, printing, and faxing. - Proficiency in MS Office. - Ability to proofread and edit written documents. - Ability to use the phone system. - Managing one's own time and the time of others. - Strong verbal & written communication skills. - Strong interpersonal, written, and oral skills. - Ability to use standard office equipment. - Familiarity with medical terminology.

title: Data Entry Operator
description:
AECOM is seeking a motivated Data Entry Operator. This position will be located on site.

The data entry operator is responsible for performing data entry work using appropriate software. The Data Entry Operator works from various standardized source documents that have been coded and require little or no selecting, coding, or interpreting of data. Problems such as erroneous items and codes, or missing information are resolved by a government employee. Work is routine and repetitive.

The responsibilities of the Data Entry Operator includes:

  • May review the work of entry- and mid-level clerks.

  • Works cooperatively with others, displaying good verbal and written communication and organizational skills.
  • Uses Word, Excel and Outlook. Other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High School + 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Due to the nature of the project US citizenship is required
  • Must pass a State and Federal criminal history/security background check.
  • Must pass a pre-employment drug screen

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Three years of Data Entry experience
  • Position requires often keyboard/mouse operations; occasionally standing/walking; rarely working with arms above shoulder level, repetitive bending/stooping, climbing stairs, repetitive or fine hand movements, and lifting 50 pounds or less.
  • Must be proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Teams, Excel, and Word)
  • Relocation is not available for this position
  • Due to the nature of the project US citizenship is required

title: Programme Facilitators/Coach
description:
Programme Facilitators/Coach


Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and responsible Part-Time Programme Facilitators/Coaches to support the delivery of a variety of educational and sustainability-themed programmes. description:

Job Description

The Montgomery College, Rockville campus, is currently accepting applications for possible openings as a part-time faculty member to teach Chemistry. We are seeking enthusiastic and dedicated individuals who exhibit a high degree of professionalism, a strong commitment to our students, and demonstrate the ability to motivate and educate students in an engaging manner.

  • During the academic year part-time faculty at Montgomery College may teach no more than 11.5 ESH (equivalent semester hour) per semester and no more than 23 ESH per academic year.
  • During summer part-time faculty at Montgomery College may teach no more than 10 ESH (equivalent semester hour) for both sessions combined.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Teach assigned lecture, discussion and/or laboratory courses in chemistry. Courses may include introductory chemistry, general chemistry, organic chemistry or chemistry for non-majors.
  • Teach a varied schedule of courses that may include daytime, evening, weekend and/or accelerated sections, or possibly be asked to teach on another campus if needed. Opportunities may exist to teach summer session classes.

  • Administer, grade and provide feedback to students in a timely manner to monitor student mastery and progress through a course.
  • Meet established deadlines to submit student mid-term and final course grades.

  • Master’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry or related chemistry discipline.
  • Experience teaching introductory chemistry, general chemistry or organic chemistry.
  • Proficiency with and ability to use a Learning Management System (LMS) and other web-based instructional technology to facilitate learning in a web-enhanced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching using a variety of pedagogical strategies and instructional delivery methods, online resources and technology applications to deliver content.

Subject to available funds, the college may be able to provide temporary access to resources.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without a sponsor.

Preferred Qualifications for teaching:

  • Ph.D. degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry or related chemistry discipline.
  • Experience teaching introductory chemistry, general chemistry or organic chemistry lectures and laboratories at the college level.

The Senior Director – Special Assets will lead a dedicated Special Assets team with the ability to identify existing and emerging risks from all perspectives, including but not limited to financial, market and physical conditions, to drive risk mitigation strategy across the portfolio and the team. In this important role, the Senior Director – Special Assets will provide exceptional service to our clients, both internal and external, and proactively mitigate risks for a portfolio of multifamily and senior housing loans.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead the identification, triage and tiering process of elevated-risk loans across the servicing portfolio, ensuring each loan receives a level of oversight appropriate to its risk profile
  • Identify emerging risk patterns across the portfolio and calibrate the team’s risk identification accordingly to capture all emerging risk patterns
  • Direct a dedicated Special Assets team, setting priorities, performance, process, and reporting standards
  • Develop a training program to strengthen risk identification across all asset management teams
  • Maintain ownership of the risk rating framework and the governance for transitioning loans to and from Special Assets
  • Collaborate with senior leadership on loss mitigation strategy for the portfolio’s highest-risk loans, while directing the team’s execution of mitigation plans across the broader portfolio
  • Deliver regular reporting and risk insights to senior leadership and asset management teams
  • Represent Special Assets in communications with agency partners on watchlist and workout matters
  • Benchmark and evolve Special Assets policies, tools, and processes to drive continuous improvement

Qualifications Required:

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills
  • Workout experience preferred, but not required
  • Deep knowledge of real estate markets, valuation methodologies, and loan structures
  • Strong working knowledge of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing guides, watchlist criteria, and reporting requirements
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team of asset management professionals
  • Strong time management skills and ability to operate under demanding deadlines
  • Ability to multitask and manage several elevated-risk relationships simultaneously
  • Ability to recognize, prioritize, and mitigate risk at both the individual loan and portfolio level
  • Excellent attention to detail and communication skill
  • Ability to work independently and lead effectively in a team environment
  • Ability to travel as needed

Education:

Undergraduate degree in a business related field (i.e. Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, Business).

Eight or more years of experience in multifamily and/or commercial real estate finance, asset management, loan servicing, or property management, including direct exposure to Fannie Mae and/or Freddie Mac servicing requirements.

Physical Demands:

May be required to physically inspect residences and common areas at multifamily and senior housing properties, as well as comparable properties within the market. This may require standing and walking for extended periods of time, climbing stairs, and the ability to sit, reach, and bend.

Position requires occasional travel. Travel shall include various modes of travel (including but not limited to planes, trains and automobiles) to different time zones and may require overnight lodging.

All employees are expected to support the organization's mission, vision, and values by exhibiting the following behaviors: excellence, competence, collaboration, innovation, respect, personalization, commitment to our community, accountability, teamwork and ownership.
