title: Toimituspäällikkö, koululaiset ja nuoret, Yle Kulttuuri ja Asia
description:
Haluatko johtaa tiimiä, joka luo sisältöjä Suomen lapsille ja nuorille? Tunnetko nuorten mediamaailman ja tiedätkö, mitkä ilmiöt puhuttavat heitä juuri nyt?

Etsimme innostavaa ja eteenpäin katsovaa toimituspäällikköä johtamaan koululaisten ja nuorten sisältöjä. Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, mitä 10–20-vuotiaat katsovat, kuuntelevat ja kokevat.

Mitä on luvassa?

Toimituspäällikkönä vastaat koko ohjelmistoalueesta ja johdat asiantuntijatiimiä. Sisältöjä syntyy niin omana tuotantona kuin kotimaisina ja kansainvälisinä hankintoina, ja sinä pidät langat käsissäsi kokonaisuuden suunnittelusta toteutukseen.

Tehtävässäsi sinä:

  • seuraat mediamaailman ja nuorten medialäsnäolon kehitystä ja viet toimintaa eteenpäin sen mukaisesti

  • johdat ja kehität kohderyhmätoimituksen sisältöjä ja toimintaa

  • toimit lähiesihenkilönä viidelletoista suoralle alaiselle ja tuet koko tiimin onnistumista

  • vastaat ohjelmistoalueen suunnittelusta, painopisteistä ja resursoinnista

  • johdat sekä omaa tuotantoa että kotimaisia ja kansainvälisiä tilauksia

Mitä odotamme?

Haemme tiimin vetäjäksi kokenutta esihenkilöä ja eteenpäin katsovaa osaajaa.

Arvostamme erityisesti:

  • aitoa kiinnostusta kohderyhmästä ja kokemusta kohderyhmälle tehdystä sisällöstä.

  • vahvaa esihenkilökokemusta ja taitoa johtaa kovatasoista asiantuntijaorganisaatiota

  • osaamista toimituksen keskeisillä sisältöalueilla – kotimaisessa draamassa sekä vuorovaikutteisessa läsnäolosisällössä

  • ymmärrystä siitä, miten 10–20-vuotiaat käyttävät mediaa ja missä he liikkuvat

  • kykyä pysyä kartalla mediamaailman nopeasta kehityksestä

Koska uusimmat ilmiöt rantautuvat usein ensimmäisenä juuri tälle kohderyhmälle, avoin, utelias ja ennakkoluuloton asenne on tärkeää. Innostava ja kannustava ote tiimin johtamiseen vie pitkälle.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme osaavan ja innostuneen tiimin sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, millaista sisältöä Suomen lapset ja nuoret kohtaavat.

Tulet osaksi Koululaiset ja nuoret -kohderyhmätoimitusta, joka luo rakastettua kotimaista draamaa kuten Räjähdysherkkä, Erityiset ja Sori siitä, sekä runsaasti vuorovaikutteista läsnäolosisältöä somessa ja omilla alustoilla – Galaxi, Summeri ja Luuttiklubi ovat hyviä esimerkkejä tekemisestämme.

Pääset johtamaan ohjelmistoaluetta, jolla kokeillaan rohkeasti uutta ja jossa voit todella vaikuttaa. Yle on suuri ja vakaa työnantaja, joka tarjoaa työllesi pitkäjänteisen pohjan sekä monipuoliset edut ja mahdollisuudet kehittyä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hienoa! Hae tehtävää ja lisää CV:si ja hakemuskirjeesi 19.8.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana.

Mikäli sinulla heräsi kysymyksiä, lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa päällikkö Markku Mastomäki 0408691295. Puhelinajat to 6.8. klo 9-11, ti 11.8. klo 9-11 ja ti 18.8. klo 9-11.

description:

  • CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

Penn State is currently seeking a Director of Alumni Career Services in supporting the Penn State Alumni Association (PSAA) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive, data-informed alumni career engagement strategy designed to provide lifelong value to alumni while strengthening their connection to the University and the Alumni Association. This role advances alumni engagement, participation, volunteer involvement, and philanthropic investment by creating meaningful career development, mentoring, and networking opportunities across the full student-to-alumni lifecycle. As a member of the Division of Development and Alumni Relations, you can play an integral role in Penn State’s future and contribute to one of the most successful fundraising and alumni relations operations in the country.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Engagement, and as a key member of the Engagement Team’s leadership group within the PSAA, the Director works closely with colleagues across the University to identify needs, recommend solutions, and deliver high-impact career services strategies that support alumni at every stage of their professional journey.

The Director of Alumni Career Services will articulate Penn State’s needs, ambitions, and values through excellent informal and formal communications as well as:

Leadership

  • Lead and manage the Alumni Career Services team, setting priorities, developing portfolio assignments, overseeing performance, and supporting staff development.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine a comprehensive alumni career services plan that is in-line with the PSAA’s strategic plan, supports alumni across all phases of career development.

  • Manage the Alumni Career Services budget and allocate resources to support strategic priorities and program delivery.

  • Establish and track key performance metrics for alumni career services initiatives; analyze outcomes and provide regular reporting to inform decision-making and demonstrate impact.

  • Represent the Alumni Association on internal and external committees, work groups, and professional organizations.

Strategy and Programming

  • Develop and implement strategies that leverage Penn State’s global alumni network to advance alumni career growth through virtual and in-person programs, services, events, and networking opportunities.

  • Direct expansion, diversification, execution, and assessment of professional development and mentoring initiatives, including resource creation, content delivery, promotional planning, and marketing support.

  • Direct, develop, and provide the ability for the PSAA to offer and execute on scalable individual career support through one-on-one career assessments and virtual coaching sessions.

  • Determine and lead the strategy for integrating technology, digital engagement tools, and AI-enabled platforms into alumni career services, including assessing current systems and identifying new solutions to enhance reach and effectiveness.

  • Increase alumni participation in career-focused programming by designing accessible, relevant, and scalable offerings that meet the needs of diverse alumni audiences.

  • Oversee the development, refinement and future iterations of the Young Alumni Ambassador Program.

Partnerships

  • Establish and strengthen strategic partnerships with university offices, including University Career Services, to create collaborative opportunities that support alumni career development.

  • Leverage existing career services platforms and University resources to enhance alumni career advancement and increase access to professional opportunities.

  • Represent alumni engagement at career-related events, including relevant University-sponsored programs.

  • Coordinate with the Director of Volunteer Engagement to identify areas where the extensive PSAA affiliate group network can be leveraged to expand and strengthen career programming and networking and develop necessary resources and plans to allow for local execution, scaling the PSAA’s reach.

  • Collaborate with campus colleagues to identify, cultivate, and steward prominent alumni, donors, prospects, and volunteers through meaningful career development engagement opportunities.

  • Lead alumni engagement strategy and execution for the Alumni Association’s workplace alumni program through partnering with campus colleagues and industry network volunteers to identify and engage C-suite alumni and other workplace leaders in building employer-based alumni programs; leverage and promote current Alumni Career Services offerings to expand networking and career-related opportunities within partner organizations and alumni networks; collaborate with schools, colleges, and strategic campus offices to coordinate professional development programs, faculty speaker events, and other initiatives that deepen engagement with corporate networks and evaluate opportunities to establish new employer-based alumni networks based on interest, organizational alignment, available resources, and concentration of alumni within a company.

  • Promote internship, mentoring, and professional opportunities for both alumni and students, including opportunities connected to alumni-owned businesses and employer partners.

The successful candidate will have:

title: fwee 상품기획(BM) 3년 이상
description:
About

2018년 설립된 비나우는 스킨케어 브랜드 넘버즈인(numbuzin), 메이크업 브랜드 퓌(fwee), 바디케어 브랜드 노크(Knock,)를 운영하는 글로벌 뷰티 기업입니다.

비나우는 ‘Global No.1 Beauty Company’라는 비전 아래 다양한 카테고리의 신규 브랜드를 지속적으로 선보이며 성장하고 있습니다. 현재 전 세계 약 14개국에 제품을 수출하고 있으며 차별화된 제품력과 브랜드 경쟁력을 바탕으로 글로벌 시장에서 빠르게 입지를 확대하고 있습니다.

특히 브랜드 런칭 6년 만에 외부 투자 없이 2025년 연매출 3,250억 원을 달성하며 업계의 주목을 받고 있습니다. 또한 2027~2028년 IPO를 준비하고 있으며 장기적으로는 연매출 1조 원 규모의 종합 뷰티 기업으로 도약하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

비나우는 회사의 성장이 곧 구성원의 성장에서 시작된다고 믿습니다.
업계 최고 수준의 보상과 성장 기회를 제공하며 구성원들이 자신의 잠재력을 마음껏 발휘할 수 있는 환경을 만들어가고 있습니다. 글로벌 No.1 뷰티 컴퍼니를 향한 도전적인 여정에 함께하며 새로운 역사를 만들어갈 인재를 기다립니다.

About ​fwee ​BM팀
BENOW, 그리고 ​우리가 하는 일

우리는 ‘색조의 ​즐거움’을 ​새롭게 정의합니다.
평범한 ​제품으로는 채워지지 않는 ​감각과 표현의 ​자유.
fwee는 ​그 틈을 ​메우기 ​위해 ​“지금의 뷰티를 다시 ​쓰는” ​색조 브랜드로 성장해 ​왔습니다.

fwee ​BM팀은 ​아이디어를 브랜드로, 브랜드를 ​시장의 언어로 ​바꾸는 ​팀입니다.
트렌드를 읽고 ​제품으로 실현하며 ​고객의 ​반응으로 완성해 냅니다.

매일 ​변하는 시장 ​속에서 빠르게 판단하고 더 과감하게 시도하며
“제품으로 말하는 브랜드”의 여정을 함께할 분을 기다립니다.

Responsibilities

• 뷰티 제품(메이크업, 스킨케어 등) 기획 및 상품화 전반
• 시장 트렌드 및 경쟁사 리서치, 소비자 인사이트 분석
• 제품 컨셉 기획 및 성분·제형·패키징 개발
• 개발 일정 및 예산 관리, 협력 부서(디자인/마케팅/영업/제조 등)와의 커뮤니케이션
• 출시 후 성과 분석 및 후속 제품 전략 수립

Requirements

• 국내·외 4년제 대학 학사 학위 이상을 보유하신 분
• 뷰티 브랜드에서 상품 기획 업무 경력 3년 이상 보유하신 분
• 소비자 리서치 및 인사이트를 바탕으로 전략적인 제품을 기획한 경험이 있으신 분
• 문서 작성(기획서/제안서) 및 커뮤니케이션 능력이 우수하신 분
• 오너십을 가지고 주도적·능동적으로 일을 추진하시는 분

Preferred

• 뷰티/화장품 업계에서 히어로 상품 개발 경험이 있으신 분
• 글로벌 협업 제품 개발 또는 글로벌 시장 경험이 있으신 분
• 스타트업과 같이 빠른 호흡으로 가파르게 성장하는 기업에서 근무해 본 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

• 연 2회 성과급 지급 (월 급여 기준 600%~800%)
• 식비 지원
• 제품 할인 및 신제품 증정 (자사 제품 50% 할인)
• 연계 휴양 시설 지원
• 경조사 지원
• 생일 오후 반차
• 건강 지원
• 교육비 지원
• 팀별 운영비 지급
• 기념일 선물 지급
• 주택 자금 지원

title: Animal Care Supervisor
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Companion Animal Supervisor, you are a trusted subject-matter leader responsible for the health, care, and presentation of our live animals while driving sales, customer experience, and operational excellence within the Companion Animal and Aquatics departments.

You lead through expertise and influence, coaching partners to deliver exceptional animal care and knowledgeable service. You combine a deep commitment to pet welfare with strong operational discipline and business acumen to achieve sales, margin, and shrink goals, all while modeling Petco’s leadership expectations.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Ensure the health, safety, and well-being of all live animals through strict adherence to Petco standards, policies, and veterinary protocols.
  • Complete and oversee hourly animal health checks, wellness cards, and required documentation.
  • Ensure proper handling, care, and documentation of adoption animals.
  • Act immediately and appropriately for sick or injured animals in alignment with veterinary protocols.

Foster the Fun

  • Coach and mentor partners to deliver confident, compassionate, and knowledgeable customer interactions.
  • Create a welcoming, engaging environment in the Companion Animal and Aquatics areas through high presentation standards.
  • Promote a positive culture of teamwork, inclusion, and collaboration.
  • Lead by example modeling Petco’s selling behaviors and customer service expectations.

Let’s Go!

  • Drive Companion Animal and Aquatics sales, margin, and shrink performance through disciplined execution.
  • Utilize business insights to analyze trends, identify opportunities, and implement improvement plans.
  • Efficiently order live animals to balance animal welfare, inventory levels, sales, and margin goals.
  • Support Omni-Channel execution, including BOPUS, ship-from-store, curbside, and endless aisle.
  • Serve as Leader on Duty, supporting Pet Care Center operations, communication, safety, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Animal Care & Operations

  • Execute Companion Animal and Aquatics operations including animal care, maintenance, ordering, regulatory compliance, CAPI, HAHC, CAPC, and veterinary partnerships.
  • Ensure all animal maintenance tasks are completed according to the Maintenance Task List.
  • Maintain operational, safety, and regulatory standards at all times.
  • Achieve high standards of cleanliness, care, and visual presentation in all animal areas.

Business & Customer Experience

  • Process transactions efficiently while delivering a great customer experience.
  • Monitor sales, margin, and inventory reports to support department performance.
  • Share product and animal care knowledge to help customers make informed decisions using Petco’s selling strategy.
  • Assist with additional duties as needed to support business needs.

People Leadership

  • Train, coach, and develop partners in animal care, selling behaviors, and operational routines.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and support to strengthen partner performance and engagement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Animals are healthy, safe, and cared for to Petco’s highest standards.
  • Customers trust the team’s expertise and return for guidance and solutions.
  • The Companion Animal department meets or exceeds sales, margin, and shrink goals
  • Partners are confident, well-trained, and proud of the care they provide.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • High school Diploma or GED preferred.
  • 1+ year of supervisory experience, preferably in a pet retail environment.
  • Strong knowledge of companion animals, aquatics, and animal care practices.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • High focus on customer service and people development.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment. The Companion Animal Supervisor is expected to be regularly present on the sales floor, leading by example and engaging with partners, customers, and pets.

  • Majority of work is conducted indoors; however, occasional duties may require leaving the Pet Care Center for tasks such as bank deposits, merchandise transport, or community events.
  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • This is a full-time position. Eligibility for full-time status is based on average hours worked, as defined by company policy and applicable law.
  • A limited amount of travel may be required for training, meetings, or community engagement.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • Hands-on leadership experience and career growth opportunities.
  • A supportive, inclusive culture built on teamwork and authenticity.
  • The chance to grow your leadership skills while having fun doing meaningful work

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification.

Actual pay rates will depend on factors such as position, location, level of experience, and applicable state or local minimum wage laws. $21.50 - $33.50

title: Vice President, Regional Trade Development
description:
Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.

Time Type:

Full time

Remote Type:

Job Family Group:

Sales

Job Description Summary:

Job Profile Summary
The Vice President, Trade Development is responsible for leading the Trade Development organization and single point of contact for suppliers. Ultimately responsible for business plans, supplier collaboration, in-market cross-functional partnership, and process implementation. This position is responsible for driving business planning, performance evaluation, product and inventory management, pricing and revenue management, demand planning/ forecasting/ budgeting. Responsible for embracing and developing behaviors consistent with BBG’s Trade Development mission. Must always adhere to the established business rules. Must embrace and support BBG’s Reliability Model. Serves as the local market expert on customers, brands, key sales drivers, trends, and market dynamics.

Job Description:

This role follows a flexible hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the office and three days working from home. This role can be performed from our Phoenix, Arizona or Denver, Colorado.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Financial Plan

    • Co-own the annual operating plan and develop regular collaboration cadence with sales.

    • Set, oversee, and manage the Trade Development team to achieve or exceed their annual financial targets.

    • Manage margins, control costs, and capitalize on operational efficiencies in partnership with finance and operations.

    • Oversee low cost high-value programs that help achieve the business plan for the overall market down to each individualized supplier.

    • Work closely with finance and purchasing around business planning managing aspects of the P&L specifically around gross profit, revenue, accounts payable. volume and inventory.

  • Manage supplier relationships in the marketplace

    • Act as the primary contact for market level supplier leaders fostering engagement and solid relationships.

    • Collaborate, review and approve supplier contracts.

    • Negotiate and agree upon annual supplier business plan, to include volume targets by brand

    • Ensure we are meeting BBG and supplier targets.

    • Oversee the quality and quantity of brand building initiatives and outputs.

    • Oversee the localization of national programming, develop brand solutions tailored to consumer insight by channel.

  • Goal Setting and goal model management

    • Prioritize and set goals for each division.

    • Ensure the team works closely with sales and suppliers and signs off on tools that are needed to deliver goals.

    • Approve targets for the organization.

    • Partner and collaborate with Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing and Revenue Management to optimize business performance within the marketplace.

  • Input the process to ensure appropriate levels of inventory around ordering, days on hand and sku rationalization

    • In partnership with Revenue Management, provide the strategic pricing, costing and gross profit direction.

    • In collaboration with Revenue Management, set annual GP target by supplier.

    • Work with the team to identify areas to improve our overall performance.

    • Nurture BBG’s simplification effort and our sell more/make more objective.

  • Lead the Trade Development Team effectively by clearly communicating roles and responsibilities, expectations, and deliverables

    • Oversee the recruitment, management, development, and retention of all associates on the team, evaluating as needed.

    • Establish an environment of teamwork, mentoring and support accountability.

    • Ensure Breakthru Professional Development is implemented throughout the team.

    • Foster a work ethic deeply rooted in innovation and a commitment to being the best.

  • Establish standards, processes, and protocols around ways of working to create a data driven culture

    • Effectively lead direct reports – Business Management, Channel Management, and Analytics – to ensure high-quality outputs.

title: Vice President, Lean Operations & AI Transformation
description:
Role Purpose

The Vice President, Lean Operations & AI Transformation will build and lead the operating system that fuels revenue growth: a disciplined Lean management approach to eliminate waste and variability, fused with AI and intelligent automation deployed as a genuine force multiplier. This is not an automation-for-its-own-sake mandate. The objective is capacity creation — freeing people from repetitive, low-judgment work so they can be redeployed to the higher-value, relationship-driven, and decision-intensive work that actually differentiates the business. Every initiative should answer the same question: does this create capacity we can reinvest in growth?

The role will launch inside Operations — standing up the team, the methodology, and an early portfolio of wins — and is explicitly designed to scale outward. As credibility and results accumulate, this leader will take on a matrixed leadership posture across Sales, Client Services, Finance, Compliance, and other Auto functions, serving as the enterprise's go-to authority for how Lean and AI are applied across the business.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Ten (10+) years leading operations, process excellence, or business transformation, including direct experience designing and running Lean/continuous-improvement programs at scale.
  • Demonstrated success integrating AI and intelligent automation (RPA, IDP, conversational AI, agentic AI, generative AI) into operational workflows, with measurable capacity and financial outcomes.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth or scaling business, with a track record of building operating leverage — enabling revenue growth without proportional cost or headcount growth.
  • Proven matrixed leadership: the ability to earn credibility and drive change across functions without formal authority, building coalitions and consensus in a matrixed organization.
  • Track record building and leading a lean, high-performing team, plus experience scaling capability through citizen development and centers of excellence.
  • Strong change management orientation — comfortable designing workforce transition plans, reskilling paths, and communication strategies alongside technical deployments.
  • Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to translate between Lean methodology, technical AI/automation concepts, and business/financial outcomes for varied audiences.
  • Financial and analytical fluency — able to build the business case for initiatives and credibly own ROI reporting to senior leadership.

Education & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Computer Science, or a related field required.
  • MBA or advanced degree in a related field strongly preferred.
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (or equivalent Lean/continuous-improvement certification) strongly preferred; Master Black Belt a plus.
  • Formal training or certification in AI, automation platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Azure AI, AWS AI/ML), or data science is a plus.

title: Nutrition Service Coordinator
description:
Site: The General Hospital Corporation


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

Join our team as a Patient Dining Associate and play an important role in supporting the patient experience through excellent food service and customer care. In this role, you will work directly with patients and clinical teams to ensure meals are delivered accurately, safely, and in accordance with each patient's prescribed diet.

You will be responsible for coordinating meal orders, preparing and delivering patient trays, assisting patients with menu selections, and providing friendly, compassionate service. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys helping others, takes pride in attention to detail, and thrives in a collaborative healthcare environment.

Essential Functions

Communicate patient diet orders for each meal to the department Data Center and ensure all diet orders are accurately implemented.

Review patient meal trays to confirm each patient receives the correct meal and diet order.

Obtain and deliver trays for new admissions and for patients whose diet orders have advanced.

Prepare and serve patient meal trays, coffee, tea, and other approved food and beverage items.

Add items such as ice cream and yogurt, garnish trays, and remove food packaging and wrappings before delivery.

Assist patients with opening milk, juice, condiments, and other meal items as needed.

Collect and return used patient meal trays following each meal service.

Provide patients with menu selection sheets and information about daily specials, and explain the meal selection process.

Assist patients who are unable to independently complete their menu selections.

Deliver an excellent patient experience by providing friendly, respectful, and compassionate customer service during every interaction.

Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary galley area after each meal service and complete scheduled special cleaning assignments.

Monitor, inventory, and order nourishments and nutritional supplements for patients between meals or for placement on future meal trays, as assigned.

Remove and properly discard expired or outdated nourishments and supplements.

Inventory and order supplies for nursing nourishment areas as needed.

Pick up supplies from the department Service Center, stock and organize supplies, and rotate perishable items to maintain freshness and proper inventory control.

Communicate with clinical dietitians regarding patient information that may affect a patient's ability or willingness to eat.

Maintain positive and effective working relationships with coworkers, clinical staff, and members of the patient care team.

Build strong rapport with nursing unit staff and collaborate effectively to support patient needs.

May assist with orienting and training new employees within the department.

Demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide appropriate service and support based on the age and developmental needs of the patients served.

Apply knowledge of growth and development across the lifespan to recognize and respond appropriately to age-specific patient needs.

Follow all department policies, procedures, food safety standards, infection prevention practices, and patient care guidelines.

Provide support and service in accordance with established department policies and procedures.


Qualifications

Education - High School Diploma or equivalent


Additional Job Details (if applicable)

Why Join Our Team?

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the patient experience every day. Your work helps ensure patients receive the meals they need while providing an important point of connection, compassion, and support during their hospital stay. You will collaborate closely with clinical and food service teams while developing valuable experience in patient service, healthcare food operations, and hospitality.

title: Apulaisosastonhoitaja Nuorisopsykiatrian avohoitoon
description:
Apulaisosastonhoitaja nuorisopsykiatriaan – tule rakentamaan vaikuttavaa hoitotyötä Keski-Uudellemaalle!
Haluatko yhdistää nuorisopsykiatrisen osaamisesi, esihenkilötyön ja kehittämisen mielekkääksi kokonaisuudeksi? Etsimme nyt apulaisosastonhoitajaa Keski-Uudenmaan nuorisopsykiatrian palveluihin vakituiseen tehtävään.Työalueeseen kuuluvat Järvenpään nuorisopsykiatrian päiväyksikkö sekä Hyvinkään ja Nurmijärven nuorisopsykiatrian vastaanotot.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?
Keski-Uudenmaan nuorisopsykiatrian palveluissa tutkitaan ja hoidetaan 13–17-vuotiaita nuoria, jotka tarvitsevat erikoissairaanhoitotasoista tutkimusta ja hoitoa. Työ perustuu tiiviiseen yhteistyöhön nuoren, perheen ja eri verkostojen kanssa.
Apulaisosastonhoitajana toimit osastonhoitajan läheisenä työparina ja osallistut aktiivisesti alueen nuorisopsykiatristen yksiköiden toiminnan johtamiseen ja kehittämiseen. Vastaat osaltasi työ- ja potilasturvallisuudesta, hoitotyön laadusta sekä henkilöstön hyvinvoinnin tukemisesta.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:
hoito- ja tutkimusprosessien ohjaaminen ja kehittäminen
työhyvinvointiin liittyvät tehtävät
hoitotyön osaamisen vahvistaminen
Työvuorosuunnitteluosaaminen tarvittaessa
resurssien päivittäinen organisointi
lähetteiden koordinointi
uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttäminen
toiminnan kehittämiseen ja muutostilanteiden arviointiin osallistuminen
yhteistyön varmistaminen nuorisopsykiatrian muiden yksiköiden kanssa.
Työskentely eri sidosryhmien kanssa

Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan sekä henkilöstön arkeen että nuorten saaman hoidon laatuun. Saat tueksesi osastonhoitajan sekä laajan verkoston muita apulaisosastonhoitajia ja osastonhoitajia.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on:
kokemusta nuorisopsykiatrisesta hoitotyöstä
kiinnostusta ja valmiuksia esihenkilötehtäviin
kyky hallita ja organisoida laajoja kokonaisuuksia myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa
erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot
kehittämismyönteinen työote ja positiivinen asenne.

Arvostamme erityisesti:
esihenkilötyötä tukevaa koulutusta
aiempaa kokemusta esihenkilö- tai tiimivastuutehtävistä
halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä moniammatillisen työyhteisön kanssa.
Edellytämme LOVE-lääkehoitolupia, jotka voidaan tarvittaessa suorittaa myös työsuhteen alkaessa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä nuorten mielenterveyden tukemiseksi osana osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä.

Saat käyttöösi:
kattavat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet
vahvan esihenkilö- ja kollegatuen
modernin erikoissairaanhoidon toimintaympäristön
työhyvinvointia tukevat henkilöstöedut
työsuhdematkaedun sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun
mahdollisuuden hyödyntää työaikapankkia.


Työ on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä arkipäivisin klo 8 - 16. Työaika on 38 h 15 min / viikko. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3 661,60–3 810,46 €/kk, minkä lisäksi maksetaan mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.Työt voisit aloittaa 1.9. 2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Tule mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa nuorisopsykiatrista hoitotyötä!

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja soveltuva kokemus tai alempi korkeakoulututkinto täydennettynä soveltuvilla johtamisen tai hallinnon opinnoilla tai sisältyen tutkintoon ja soveltuva kokemus tai aikaisempi hyväksytty osastonhoitajan pätevyys ja soveltuva kokemus tai alan opistoasteen tutkinto täydennettyinä johtamisen tai hallinnon opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus ja lisäksi laillistettu terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilö.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Yhteystiedot

Osastonhoitaja Minna Mankinen 050 453 2832
Ylihoitaja Heli Hirvonen 040 185 6896

Tietoja meistä

HUS Helsingin yliopistollinen sairaala on Suomen suurin erikoissairaanhoidon toimija. Osaamisemme on kansainvälisesti tunnettua ja tunnustettua. Yliopistollisena sairaalana tutkimme ja kehitämme jatkuvasti hoitomenetelmiämme sekä toimintaamme.
HUSissa saa vuosittain hoitoa lähes 700 000 potilasta. Meillä työskentelee yli 27 000 ammattilaista potilaiden parhaaksi. Vastaamme erikoissairaanhoidon järjestämisestä Uudellamaalla. Lisäksi meille on keskitetty koko Suomen ja Etelä-Suomen yhteistyöalueen monien harvinaisten ja vaikeiden sairauksien hoito.

HUS – Vaikuttavinta hoitoa

Yhdenvertaisuus on yksi arvoistamme. Edistämme aktiivisesti monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Haluamme, että meillä HUSissa työskentelee eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuoliin sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- ja vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia ammattilaisia. Meille olet tervetullut omana ainutlaatuisena itsenäsi.

We are passionate about ensuring healthcare professionals are deeply grounded in the science behind our technologies and are properly trained to use them safely and effectively - ultimately improving outcomes for patients around the world. This role offers the opportunity to influence strategy across the enterprise, translate science into meaningful value propositions, and collaborate with a highly engaged, energetic, and purpose driven team that thrives on learning, innovation, and shared impact.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Maintains a deep understanding of the science behind our products.
  • Develops competitive intelligence in our product space.
  • Drives education and outreach for safe and effective use of our products.
  • Develops, implements and oversees integrated evidence-based medical affairs strategic plans for relevant Medtronic organizations.
  • Utilizes advanced subject matter expertise to provide medical input to various functions (General Management, Global Strategy & Portfolio Management, Business Development & Licensing, Research & Development, & Marketing) and organizational units to facilitate insightful decision-making and enable achievement of business objectives.
  • Ensures effective objective value propositions are developed and articulated for Medtronic technologies to stakeholders (patients, health care providers, payers, government agencies, health technology assessment organizations, public) through appropriate channels.

  • Develops competitive intelligence in our product space.

Must Have: Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • Minimum of 7 years of clinical or commercial experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience.


Nice to Have

  • Clinical or commercial experience working with surgeons, nurses, multidisciplinary care teams at hospitals, surgery centers, ambulatory surgery centers, etc.

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Education, or a related scientific field

  • Experience partnering with KOLs, professional societies, or external faculty in procedure‑based or medical device education

  • Ability to translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, compelling educational and value narratives

  • Experience collaborating cross‑functionally within a matrixed, global organization (e.g., R&D, Strategy, Marketing, Market Access)

  • Passion for education innovation, evidence generation, and continuous improvement in how healthcare professionals are trained.

description:

Chez JLL, nos équipes façonnent l'avenir de l'immobilier afin de créer un monde meilleur en combinant des services de classe mondiale, du conseil stratégique et des solutions technologiques pour nos clients. Nous nous engageons à recruter les meilleurs talents et à leur offrir les moyens de s'épanouir, de développer des carrières significatives et de trouver leur place au sein de notre organisation. Que vous possédiez une solide expérience en immobilier commercial, dans les métiers spécialisés ou en technologie, ou que vous souhaitiez transposer votre expertise vers une nouvelle industrie, rejoignez notre équipe pour contribuer ensemble à façonner un avenir prometteur.

Administrateur(trice) de comptes – JLL

En quoi consiste ce poste :

JLL recherche un(e) Administrateur(trice) de comptes dévoué(e) pour gérer les opérations financières complètes de nos propriétés de Montréal (Centre Eaton de Montréal, Place Montréal Trust et Le 1500). Ce rôle joue un rôle essentiel dans le maintien de relations solides avec les locataires tout en assurant une gestion financière précise des comptes fournisseurs, des comptes clients et des recouvrements. Le candidat retenu interprétera des clauses de bail complexes et fournira un soutien financier essentiel qui contribue directement à l'excellence opérationnelle et à la satisfaction client de JLL sur le marché montréalais.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien :

  • Traiter les dépôts quotidiens en personne et maintenir des dossiers financiers précis

  • Effectuer un suivi rigoureux des comptes en souffrance depuis plus de 60 jours pour les locataires qui ne sont pas dans des situations particulières (Litiges, C-36, etc.)

  • Réconcilier les comptes clients suite aux avenants de bail affectant les calculs de loyer

  • Envoyer les états de compte et factures aux locataires dans les délais prescrits

  • Compléter mensuellement les refacturations opérationnelles (Chargebacks et Service Calls) pour tous les détaillants et bureaux

  • Ajouter systématiquement des commentaires de suivi de recouvrement aux documents de suivi des locataires et fournir des analyses détaillées pour accélérer le paiement des factures

  • Fournir un soutien de relève à l'administrateur de comptes pour les comptes fournisseurs pendant les périodes de pointe et les vacances

Qualifications requises :

  • Diplôme post-secondaire en administration avec minimum deux ans d'expérience pertinente

  • Solides compétences en planification, organisation, analyse numérique et communication

  • Excellente maîtrise des logiciels Microsoft Word et Excel

  • Connaissances de base de l'interprétation de baux et de l'analyse de clauses financières

  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement au rythme rapide avec des échéances serrées

  • Bilinguisme requis (français et anglais) pour la communication écrite et orale avec les locataires et partenaires externes

  • Expérience en comptabilité ou tenue de livres, de préférence dans l'industrie de l'immobilier commercial

Qualifications préférées :

  • Connaissance du logiciel de gestion immobilière Yardi

  • Expérience avec le logiciel Basware

  • Expérience antérieure en immobilier commercial ou gestion immobilière

  • Compréhension des réglementations de location commerciale du Québec

  • Expérience en relations avec les locataires et service à la clientèle

*Interactions orales et/ou écrites avec des locataires ou partenaires externes basés à l’extérieur du Québec (par exemple, fournisseurs de services, cabinets d’avocats, pairs, banquiers, firmes de courtage, firmes d’analyse de crédit, agences de crédits, clientèle non-francophone, etc.)

----

Account Administrator – JLL

What this job involves:

JLL is seeking a dedicated Account Administrator to manage comprehensive on-site financial operations for our premium Montreal properties (Centre Eaton of Montreal, Place Montreal Trust and Le 1500). This role plays a critical part in maintaining strong tenant relationships while ensuring accurate financial management of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and collections. The successful candidate will interpret complex lease clauses and provide essential financial support that directly contributes to JLL's operational excellence and client satisfaction in the Montreal market.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Process daily deposits in person and maintain accurate financial records

  • Conduct rigorous follow-up on accounts over 60 days past due for tenants not in special situations (Disputes, C-36, etc.)

  • Reconcile accounts receivable following lease amendments affecting rent calculations

  • Send statements of account and invoices to tenants within prescribed timeframes

  • Complete monthly operational recharges (Chargebacks and Service Calls) for all Retailers and Offices

  • Systematically add collection follow-up comments to tenant tracking documents and provide detailed analyses to accelerate invoice payment

  • Provide backup support to Account Administrator for accounts payable during peak periods and vacations

Required Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary degree in administration with minimum two years of relevant experience

  • Strong skills in planning, organization, numerical analysis, and communication

  • Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel software

  • Basic knowledge of lease interpretation and financial clause analysis

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

  • Bilingualism required (French and English) for written and spoken communication with tenants and external partners

  • Experience in accounting or bookkeeping, preferably within commercial real estate industry

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Yardi property management software

  • Experience with Basware software

  • Previous experience in commercial real estate or property management

  • Understanding of Quebec commercial leasing regulations

  • Experience with tenant relations and customer service

*Oral and/or written interactions with tenants or external partners based outside Quebec (for example, service providers, law firms, peers, bankers, brokerage firms, credit analysis firms, credit agencies, non-French-speaking clients, etc.)

title: Coding Quality Specialist - Inpatient
description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

Responsible for monitoring, assessing, and improving the quality of coding processes, documentation, and adherence to coding guidelines and regulations by enhancing coding accuracy, minimizing errors, and promoting coding compliance.

Essential Functions:

-Develop and implement coding quality assurance programs to evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of medical coding practices.

-Ensure coding practices align with official coding conventions, guidelines, and regulatory requirements set forth by organizations such as the American Medical Association (AMA), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and other relevant bodies.

-Analyze medical records, physician notes, and other relevant documentation to assess the adequacy and specificity of documentation supporting the assigned codes.

-Develop and deliver coding education and training programs to coders, physicians, and other healthcare professionals to enhance coding knowledge, documentation practices, and coding accuracy.

-Identify opportunities to streamline coding workflows, enhance efficiency, and improve coding accuracy.

-Establish key quality metrics and reporting mechanisms to monitor and track coding accuracy, productivity, and compliance.

-Foster effective communication and collaboration with healthcare providers, coders, billing staff, and other stakeholders to address coding-related inquiries, clarify documentation requirements, and resolve coding issues.


Qualifications

Education

  • Associate's Degree Medical Billing and Coding required


Experience

  • 5+ years of medical coding experience required

  • 1+ years of quality assurance experience preferred

  • Strong inpatient coding experience, academic facility preferred.

  • Must have ICD-10 PCS coding experience


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of medical coding systems, including ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS, and their application in hospital billing.

  • Knowledgeable of coding guidelines and regulations, including those set by the AMA, CMS, and other relevant organizations.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to accurately interpret medical documentation and assign appropriate codes.

  • Excellent understanding of anatomy, physiology, medical terminology, and disease processes to support accurate coding.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to interact effectively with healthcare providers and billing staff.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

40

title: Speech Pathologist
description:
When you join Early Start Australia, you’ll be part of an allied heath team that’s in it together. A local team that’s right beside you, supported by leaders who know the work. From small shifts to life-changing breakthroughs, you’ll make a positive impact for children, young people, and their families across Australia. With flexibility and support to thrive, you’ll continue to grow and build a meaningful career, your way.

What you’ll do at our Durack clinic:

Therapy Service Delivery
• Identify and complete assessments appropriate for each client
• Manage a discipline-specific caseload, including complex clients, using a case management approach
• Contribute to the selection and maintenance of assessment and therapy resources
• Develop, implement, evaluate, and adjust tailored therapy programs aligned to client goals
• Deliver services across clinic, home, school, and community settings as required
• Collaborate with allied health team members to achieve optimal client outcomes
• Develop and deliver specialised programs such as group therapy and parent workshops
• Maintain strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality requirements
• Ensure practice remains aligned with current best practice and contribute to continuous service improvement

Therapy Programs
• Develop and implement tailored therapy programs for each client, including:

  • Completing initial appointments
  • Developing goal plans based on identified support needs
  • Creating measurable, targeted intervention strategies
  • Collaborating with other health professionals where required (e.g. Speech, Psychology)
  • Preparing home and session-based resources and activities
  • Developing session plans as needed
  • Conducting school and home visits when appropriate
  • Monitoring progress and adjusting goals and programs accordingly
  • Completing reviews and reports as required
  • Identifying suitability for additional services or group programs and incorporating into plans where appropriate

Reporting and Documentation
• Record all treatment notes and activities in PMS within 24 hours of sessions
• Provide timely, high-quality reports to stakeholders (e.g. clients, families, health professionals, NDIA)
• Ensure reports and correspondence meet ESA standards
• Report and document client incidents or complaints in the appropriate systems

Funding and Payments
• Align therapy plans with available funding and funding types
• Obtain and review NDIS plans where relevant to inform therapy planning
• Provide accurate information to support correct invoicing of client-related services

Professional Development
• Participate in team meetings, peer reviews, and case discussions at an appropriate cadence
• Maintain accurate records in line with organisational processes and manager direction
• Utilise professional development opportunities to build role-relevant skills

Organisational Requirements
• Comply with and promote policies relating to WHS, emergency procedures, child safety, and cultural competence
• Participate in risk identification, assessment, and prevention activities
• Engage in networking and maintain collaborative relationships with professionals and agencies
• Maintain discipline-specific registration/membership and adhere to relevant codes of conduct
• Uphold privacy and confidentiality in line with organisational policy and legislation

What you’ll bring:

Experience/ Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience in solution-focused therapy and early intervention
  • Understanding and supporting the principles of individualised services including the ability to adapt services to meet individual needs
  • Demonstrated ability to engage with a range of children and families and external stakeholders
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Exceptional observational and report writing skills
  • Ability to work within a multidisciplinary team and the ability to work autonomously in the community

Qualifications / Compliance:

  • Relevant qualification in Speech Pathology
  • Registration with AHPRA and Registration with SPA
  • NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • Current Drivers’ Licence and vehicle
  • Current Working with Children Check or Working with Vulnerable People Registration (state specific)
  • National Police Check
  • Accredited First Aid Certificate

What you’ll get:

Flexibility and Wellbeing

  • Flexible hours and compressed work options
  • Up to 12 weeks annual leave.
  • Up to 16 weeks paid primary carer leave
  • Wellbeing support program for you and your family

Reward and support

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Registration and professional membership contribution
  • Relocation reimbursement up to $5,000, if applicable
  • Dedicated admin support so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Work in an environment that focuses on multidisciplinary collaboration, improving outcomes together

Growth, your way

  • CPD allowance + paid professional development leave
  • Structured mentoring and leadership programs
  • Ongoing opportunities to build your experience, including Fly In Fly Out (FIFO) work supporting children in remote areas
  • National and global career pathways through the APM Group

Who we are:

We’re a dedicated and passionate team of allied health professionals helping children and young people aged 0-16 to reach their full potential. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, we offer the scale and stability of a global organisation, with the feel of a local team.

Apply today or reach out to Ayesha on 0461 101 104 or Ayesha.din@apm.net.au for a confidential chat to learn more.

title: Operator 3, Warehousing
description:

title: Animal Care Specialist
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Companion Animal Specialist, you are the primary expert and advocate for the health, welfare, and proper care of companion animals and aquatic life within the Pet Care Center (PCC).

You ensure exceptional animal care and habitat maintenance while supporting sales, merchandising, and inventory execution. In close partnership with the sales team, you help deliver outstanding customer experience by combining deep animal-care knowledge with strong operational discipline. This role is ideal for someone passionate about animal welfare who enjoys teaching others and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Ensure the health, safety, and proper care of all companion animals and aquatic life in accordance with Petco standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Complete and verify required animal care tasks, including hourly animal health checks, wellness documentation, maintenance logs, and incident reports.
  • Ensure proper handling, documentation, and care of relinquished and adoption animals.
  • Serve as the primary resource for animal care education for customers and PCC partners.
  • Adhere to and promote all safety, animal welfare, and loss prevention procedures.

Foster the Fun

  • Deliver knowledgeable, compassionate, and solution-focused service to customers.
  • Actively support customer interactions using Petco’s selling model.
  • Promote a culture of teamwork, inclusion, and collaboration across the PCC.
  • Mentor and educate partners on animal care standards, maintenance routines, and best practices.
  • Maintain professional, clean, and well-presented animal habitats and aquatic areas.

Let’s Go!

  • Support the achievement of department sales, margin, and shrink goals.
  • Ensure merchandise is stocked, priced, and displayed to Petco standards, with a primary focus on companion animals and aquatics.
  • Efficiently order live animals, supplies, and related merchandise in partnership with the sales team to support inventory integrity and business goals.
  • Analyze inventory data and identify opportunities to improve in-stock levels, shrink, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in animal and aquatic-related physical inventory counts.
  • Assist with opening and closing procedures as assigned.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as needed to support Pet Care Center operations.

Key Responsibilities

Animal Care & Maintenance

  • Verify all animal care and maintenance tasks are completed according to established schedules.
  • Perform routine housekeeping duties, including cleaning habitats and tanks, sweeping and mopping floors, dusting, and facing merchandise.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, operational, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Sales Support

  • Process register transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Evaluate customer needs and escalate concerns to the Leader on Duty when appropriate.
  • Support Omni-channel and in-store initiatives through consistent execution and customer engagement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Animals are healthy, safe, and cared for to Petco’s highest standards.
  • Customers trust the team’s expertise and return for guidance and solutions.
  • Animal habitats and aquatic areas are clean, compliant, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory and merchandising support sales while minimizing shrink.
  • Partners feel supported and informed through shared animal-care knowledge.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with or caring for companion animals and aquatic life.
  • Strong knowledge of animal care, husbandry, and maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to educate others and communicate effectively.
  • Strong customer service mindset with an aptitude for selling behaviors.
  • Basic business, math, and inventory management skills.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Completion and ongoing maintenance of the Petco Animal Care Certification Program required.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment and requires active engagement on the sales floor.

  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • A welcoming, inclusive team environment.
  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and explore career paths.
  • A fun, fast-paced role where no two days are the same.

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification.

title: Supervisor, Welding (Starship) - Night Shift
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPERVISOR, WELDING (STARSHIP) - NIGHT SHIFT

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and evaluate welding procedures
  • Assist with the tooling and fixturing designs required for weld operation
  • Select base material and welding material
  • Control production weld quality
  • Utilize welding codes and standards
  • Provide personnel management and supervision, including mentorship of junior welders
  • Enforce site and personnel safety
  • Review and edit documentation, including work reports and record keeping
  • Supervise and provide daily support to the launch projects welding team
  • Assess candidates and provide recommendations in the hiring process
  • Responsible for planning and scheduling work, assigning work, and assessing completed work
  • Monitor and approve employee time keeping records
  • Communicate how successful performance will be measured and provide collaborative direction to team members; recommend performance standards and ratings

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 5+ years of professional experience with one or more of the following: gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW), flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), TIG, or gas metal arc welding (GMAW)
  • 2+ years of experience in leading a team or a project

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience managing more than 10 employees
  • Ability to interpret drawings and weld symbols per AWS A2.4
  • Knowledge of AWS D1.1, D1.6, and D1.2
  • Aluminum gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW) and gas metal arc welding (GMAW) experience
  • Technical trade school certificate
  • Capable of cutting, polishing, and etching weld test samples
  • Experience with Inconel welding and fabrication

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to pass Space Force background check for Cape Canaveral
  • Ability to support on a dedicated night shift (anticipated hours are 3:00pm - 1:30am)
  • Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted
  • Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position
  • Ability to work at elevated heights (up to 300 feet), including the use of ladders
  • Willing to operate heavy machinery
  • Ability to work in confined spaces
  • Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain, ice
  • Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Spa Director
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Beachfront relaxation on north Africa’s Mediterranean coast. In the heart of Tunisia’s vibrant and exotic capital city, our modern Mediterranean oasis offers a calm, laid-back beachfront escape alongside this bustling business hub. Relax at our Spa and pools, stay connected with state-of-the-art business services, or take a step back in time – more than 3,000 years of ancient civilization are at your fingertips.

About the Role

The Spa & Wellness Director is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the spa and wellness facilities, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, and driving revenue growth. This leadership role demands a strategic thinker with a passion for wellness, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to inspire and manage a diverse team.

What you will do

  • Lead all spa and wellness operations, ensure exceptional service standards, operational excellence, and guest satisfaction.

  • Drive revenue growth and profitability through strategic pricing, promotions, retail performance, and wellness programming.

  • Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing spa team through recruitment, coaching, training, and performance management.

  • Deliver personalized luxury wellness experiences that enhance guest loyalty and brand reputation.

  • Manage departmental budgets, forecasts, financial reporting, inventory, and cost-control initiatives.

  • Maintain compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and luxury hospitality standards across all spa facilities.

  • Partner with Marketing and Public Relations to promote spa offerings, increase brand visibility, and attract new business.

  • Identify and implement industry trends, innovative treatments, and wellness concepts to keep the spa at the forefront of the market.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional hotel teams to ensure a seamless and elevated guest experience.

  • Drive a culture of excellence, wellness, and continuous improvement throughout the department.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of leadership experience in a luxury spa, wellness, or hospitality environment.

  • Strong expertise in spa operations, wellness services, and luxury guest experiences.

  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, driving performance, engagement, and service excellence.

  • Commercial mindset with experience managing budgets, revenue, retail performance, and financial targets.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong command of English.

  • Passion for wellness and hospitality, with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

  • Hands-on spa or therapy experience (Massage Therapist, Aesthetician, Acupuncturist, or similar) preferred.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Opportunities for professional growth within a globally recognized luxury brand.

  • Access to world-class training and development programs.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that values innovation and excellence.

  • Exclusive complimentary and discounted hotel stays across Four Seasons properties worldwide.

  • The chance to work in a diverse and inclusive culture, contributing to creating memorable guest experiences.

Schedule & Hours

  • Full Time

title: Landscape Executive
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

The Landscape Executive(LE) is responsible for managing and overseeing all aspects of landscape and horticultural operations within a commercial real estate portfolio. This role requires ensuring the aesthetic appeal, functionality, and health of the outdoor spaces are maintained to the highest standards. The Landscape Executive will work in collaboration with external vendors, internal stakeholders, and tenants to deliver exceptional landscapes that enhance the overall tenant experience and add value to the property.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Landscape Maintenance:
-Develop and implement landscape maintenance programs, schedules, and standard operating procedures.
-Supervise, coordinate, and manage the daily activities of the landscape maintenance team, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and safely.
-Conduct regular inspections of landscapes to identify maintenance requirements, prioritize tasks, and ensure compliance with established standards.
Horticultural Practices:
-Plan, select, and cultivate appropriate plant species based on local climate, soil conditions, and aesthetic requirements.
-Assess and recommend appropriate fertilization, pest and disease control, irrigation, and pruning practices to maintain plant health and appearance.
-Implement sustainable and environmentally friendly landscape management practices to minimize waste, conserve water, and promote biodiversity.
Project Management:
-Coordinate and oversee landscape enhancement projects, renovations, and seasonal plantings to improve the aesthetics and functionality of outdoor spaces.
-Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to develop project timelines, budgets, and specifications.
-Monitor project progress, ensure compliance with design guidelines, and resolve any issues or challenges that arise.
Vendor Management:
-Identify, evaluate, and select qualified landscape and horticultural vendors for different properties.
-Supervise and manage vendor contracts, ensuring adherence to agreed-upon terms, service levels, and budgets.
-Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
Budgeting and Reporting:
-Assist in the development of annual landscape budgets, ensuring alignment with property objectives and financial targets.
-Monitor and track expenses, review invoices, and provide accurate cost reports to support financial planning and forecasting.
-Prepare regular reports and updates on landscape activities, maintenance activities, project progress, and key performance indicators.

Required Qualifications:

  • Diploma or ITC or market equivalent certifications in landscaping disciplines with minimum of 3 years’ experience in supervision and management of landscape contractors and works in local context.
  • The LE shall have hands on experience and knowledge in identifying early signs of poor plant and tree health, pest infestation and bring to the attention of the Certified Arborist for further investigation. He or she should be capable of taking samples for lab test or perform measurements with handheld instruments/sensors such moisture, PH etc. Where necessary, the LE shall perform minor or localized landscape improvement or cleaning works by supervising the handyman or cleaners where it’s not practical for the Corporation to issue work orders to the FMC to call the landscape contractors in.
  • The LE shall perform the checks, supervise and validate the landscape maintenance and enhancement works.

title: Warehouse Part Time Overnight
description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.
