Position: Medical Science Liaison, Rheumatology
Location: Field - Georgia


The MSL role embodies our medical mission to be recognized as the trusted partner for internal stakeholders and the healthcare community, driving scientific exchange to enhance medical education, data generation, insight generation and patients’ access to medicine.


The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is responsible for identifying disease and product related medical needs in a defined geography. The primary role of the MSL is to develop and maintain relationships with Thought Leaders (TL) and Healthcare Providers (HCP) within their healthcare system. The purpose of their interactions is to engage in meaningful scientific exchange that will ensure patients have access to BMS medicines, to ensure their safe and appropriate use through peer to peer discussions aligned with medical strategies and needs expressed by external stakeholders, and to facilitate research. The MSL also serves as the medical resource for external stakeholders in the community.

Key Responsibilities:

External Environment and Customer Focus

  • Develop and maintain relationships with academic and community research thought leaders, appropriate HCPs, and access stakeholders, within a given geography to answer scientific, unsolicited product, and HEOR related questions.

  • The MSL will use various channels for interactions (1:1, group presentations, remote, etc.)

  • Demonstrate proficiency in using available scientific resources and presentations.

  • Effectively present information to TL/HCPs and be able to respond to questions, ensuring medical accuracy and compliance with local procedures, ethical and legal guidelines and directives.

  • Actively assess the medical landscape by meeting with TL/HCPs/Access Stakeholders to understand their needs and expertise.

  • Continuously update own knowledge in treatment strategies, products, unmet medical needs, clinical trials, health economics outcomes research and scientific activities.

  • Understand the competitive landscape and evolving healthcare models and actively prepare to address informational needs of customers

  • Identify opportunities to partner with HCPs on disease state initiatives, collaborative research projects, and investigator sponsored research (ISR) of interest and in alignment with BMS strategic objectives

  • Attend medical congresses and local/regional meetings.

  • Collect and provide meaningful medical insights and/or impact by communicating these back to the medical and commercial organizations to support strategy development and business decisions

Contribute to the Medical Plan

  • Develop geography-specific Field Medical and TL Interaction plans based on therapeutic area objectives and TLs needs

  • Adopt institution/account planning approach and contribute to cross-functional institution/account plans

  • Contribute to development and delivery of scientifically meaningful medical programs/projects in line with the local Medical and Field Medical plan

Provide Medical Support

  • Establish a customer-centric, compliant collaboration with cross-matrix field teams within assigned geography

  • As necessary and appropriate, support the initial and ongoing medical /scientific area and product specific training and provide key scientific updates to internal stakeholders (e.g. Commercial, Regulatory, Pharmacovigilance, Legal, HEOR, Value Access & Payment)

  • Provide scientific support at promotional meetings by presenting scientific and clinical data, by evaluating speakers and by giving support to BMS-contracted speakers (if applicable)

  • Participate in assigned Congress activities

Support Clinical Trial Activities

  • Support Interventional and Non Interventional Research (NIR) studies (e.g. identification and assessment of potential study sites) to facilitate patient recruitment and/or discussions around the safe and effective use of BMS investigational products, as agreed with home office medical and Global Development Operations (GDO) and as defined by the study scope document

  • Provide recommendations and insights to clinical development team on study and site feasibilities within the therapeutic area based on knowledge of the field and through direct contacts with potential investigators, as agreed with home office medical and GDO

  • Support HCPs in the ISR submission and execution process and study follow-up as agreed upon with home office medical and GDO

  • Ensure that BMS Pharmacovigilance procedural documents are understood and applied by investigators of local studies, and alert appropriate BMS personnel to any identified Adverse Events

  • Actively support CRO sponsored studies as agreed with home office medical and GDO and as defined by the study scope document

Position Requirements:

  • MD, PharmD, PhD, APP, PA, NP with experience in a specific Disease Area or with a broad medical background and relevant pharmaceutical experience

  • Disease area knowledge and an understanding of scientific publications

  • Knowledge of a scientific or clinical area, competitive landscape and patient treatment trends

  • Knowledge of clinical trial design and process

  • Knowledge of the national healthcare and access environment

  • Knowledge of HEOR core concepts

  • Excellent English language skills, spoken and written

Experience Desired

  • A minimum of 2 years working in a clinical and/or pharmaceutical environment

  • Prior MSL experience

  • Ability to work independently and act as a team player

  • Translating scientific or clinical data into an understandable and valuable form to help physicians best serve their patients

  • Good communication and presentation skills to present scientific and/or clinical data to research or healthcare professionals

  • Developing peer-to-peer relationships with TLs, scientists and other healthcare professionals

  • Ability to quickly and comprehensively learn about new subject areas and environments

  • Demonstration of the BMS Values

Essential Qualification

  • Ability to drive a company-provided car is an essential qualification of this position.

  • Candidates must be able to drive a BMS-provided vehicle between locations (often great distances apart) and arrive at each location ready and able to enthusiastically and efficiently demonstrate an applied knowledge of pertinent health care industry trends.

  • Candidates must possess a high level of ethics, integrity, and a responsible and safe driving history

Travel Requirement

  • Travel required.

  • Position is field based, MSL will be required to live in the territory which they manage or within 50 miles of the territory borders

  • The MSL will spend the majority of their time in the field with their external customers.

  • Further requirements based on territory assignment and team needs

#LI-Remote

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. title: Integrated Lighting Systems Engineer
description:
Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.

What we offer:

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary:

The Magna Exteriors portfolio of products includes access systems such as liftgates, exterior trim, modular systems, front-end modules including fascia, active aerodynamic systems and other lightweight structural components for automotive, commercial truck and other industrial markets.
Recognized globally as an innovator in all aspects of vehicle exteriors, Magna provides everything needed, from materials development and design through manufacturing and assembly, to help automakers create sleek, state-of-the-art vehicles across the world.

Job Responsibilities:

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Integrated Lighting Systems Engineer develops integrated lighting solutions for exterior automotive systems, with a primary focus on accent lighting, illuminated exterior features, and new customer-facing lighting concepts. This role combines lighting engineering expertise with a systems-engineering mindset to integrate optical, electrical, mechanical, software, and manufacturing requirements into robust exterior system solutions. The position is focused on customer-visible exterior lighting features and innovation rather than traditional regulatory lamp development, supporting next-generation illuminated exterior systems that strengthen technology, design intent, customer experience, brand differentiation, and manufacturability.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead the system definition, development, and integration of exterior lighting features, with emphasis on accent lighting, illuminated exterior components, and brand-differentiating lighting functions.

• Translate customer expectations, styling intent, product requirements, and technical constraints into clear system requirements and functional specifications.

• Define and execute the Statement of Work / Statement of Requirements for integrated lighting systems and related sub-systems.

• Cascade requirements to optical, electrical, electronic, software, mechanical, trim, and manufacturing teams to ensure a complete and feasible system solution.

• Support concept development for new lighting solutions including illuminated grilles, exterior accent lighting, welcome/goodbye animations, light guides, light pipes, projection features, and smart surfaces.

• Ensure customer requirements, applicable regulations, product specifications, cost, timing, safety, reliability, quality, and manufacturing feasibility are considered in the system design.

• Collaborate with styling, product engineering, electronics, software, optics, suppliers, manufacturing, purchasing, and program teams to develop innovative and robust integrated lighting solutions.

• Prepare and maintain engineering deliverables including system specifications, sub-system specifications, interface control documents, system architecture, compliance matrix, system bill of materials, DFMEA, DVP&R, prototype plans, engineering changes, and technical reviews.

• Participate in creation and analysis of system models, simulations, prototypes, and validation plans for lighting performance, integration, thermal behavior, durability, and perceived quality.

• Identify and promote new lighting technologies, materials, suppliers, and integration approaches that can improve the value, appearance, performance, or manufacturability of exterior systems.

• Manage assigned work packages in Trax or equivalent requirements-management tools, ensuring traceability, timely completion, and alignment with project deliverables.

• Apply ISO 26262, ASPICE, or equivalent automotive system-development practices when applicable to program scope, while maintaining primary focus on integrated accent lighting innovation and robust system execution.

• Support customer discussions, innovation reviews, technical workshops, and system-level trade-off decisions related to exterior lighting integration.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct engineering testing of electromechanical systems from proof-of-concept mockups through customer validation testing.

• Use system analysis tools, such as LabVIEW, programmers, oscilloscopes, meters, and analyzers, to evaluate system performance and troubleshoot system functions when issues arise.

• Review, approve, complete, and submit required change notices to ensure the system meets design inputs.

• Participate in code reviews and component design reviews with peers and customers to ensure system requirements are fulfilled.

• Develop new project documentation and optimize existing project documentation to add value and improve communication efficiency.

• Support system analysis activities. Demonstrate fundamental understanding of, and ability to apply, basic mathematical models for mechatronic systems and software simulations using tools such as MATLAB, Simulink, and software development environments for embedded applications.

• Independently prioritize task completion and issue resolution to ensure compliance with customer requirements and program deliverables. Contribute to the development of project timing.

• Communicate effectively within the project team and with customers, suppliers, manufacturing teams, and quality teams with minimal guidance from engineering management and engineering personnel.

• Works with senior engineering personnel to support and drive best practices in design specifications, manufacturing processes, customer requirements, and safety requirements.

• Understand and execute internal change management processes and adapt to customer change management systems to ensure accuracy and proper protocol when processing engineering change requests.

• Analyzes products and formulates engineering conclusions by the application of engineering and/or mathematical principles and tools. Applies QFD, FEA, FMEA, DOE, VA/VE and DFM/DFA, as required in the development of the product.

• Support the Global Systems team as required.

• Understand and follow existing policies, procedures, work instructions, and standards, and make recommendations for continuous improvement.

• Follow Magna’s Code of Conduct & Ethics and related compliance policies.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and the requirements for the performance of this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering, or Control Systems from an accredited university, or a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with more than five years of experience with systems or embedded software product applications.

• 5-10 years of engineering experience

• Demonstrated ability to apply systems methodologies to design and develop cascading requirements.

• Demonstrated excellence in communication, presentation, influencing, and customer-facing technical engagement skills.

• Fluent English communication skills required; German language skills are considered a plus.

• Completion of Mechatronics 1 and Mechatronics 2 courses preferred.

• Completion of ISO 26262 and ASPICE courses preferred.

• Possess working knowledge of EDA tools, electronic circuit board design, and manufacturing, with familiarity with the fabrication and testing of electronic products.

• Possess detailed documentation practices.

• Vehicle-level bus communication protocol development experience, such as CAN or LIN.

• System and subsystem architecture development experience for safety-critical components.

• Working knowledge of electrical hardware, including wire harnesses, software, and electrical circuit theory as they relate to embedded controls for electromechanical systems.

• Automotive production launch experience with an embedded software product required.

• Working knowledge of C/C++, assembly language, Arduino code, MATLAB, Simulink, LabVIEW, LabWindows/CVI, or other software design and test tools.

• Understanding of standard software processes and industry requirements, including IEEE, CMMI, MISRA, AUTOSAR, and USCAR.

HEALTH & SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Ensure all safety and non-safety rules and regulations are followed.

• Ensure adherence to established quality and housekeeping standards.

• Review and adhere to local health, safety, environmental, and quality standards, operating procedures, and policies.

• Immediately report accidents, hazards, defects, or non-compliance issues to management.

• Work and act in a manner that will not harm oneself or any other worker.

• Understand and uphold policies that prohibit workplace violence and harassment.

• Participate in all mandatory training.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

• Conditions may cause minor stress or physical discomfort due to limited exposure to elements or frequent exposure to moderately disagreeable internal or external conditions. Typical conditions may create a minor risk of injury or harmful effects to self or others

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment:

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.


AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

BUILDING OPERATIONS, LAB SERVICES – JLL

What this job involves:

As a Lab Services (GXP) Glass Wash Technician, you'll play a critical role in supporting laboratory operations by ensuring the proper cleaning, processing, and distribution of laboratory equipment and glassware. Working within regulated GXP environments, you'll maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance while operating specialized cleaning equipment and managing the flow of materials throughout laboratory facilities. This hands-on position combines technical expertise with attention to detail, directly enabling scientific research and laboratory excellence for our pharmaceutical and life sciences clients.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Transport laboratory equipment, glassware, and apparatus to and from designated wash areas and pickup locations throughout laboratory facilities, maintaining organized workflows and timely service delivery.

Operate and maintain various specialized cleaning equipment including tunnel washers, batch washers, sonicators, dryers, autoclaves, ovens, and tube washers according to established operating procedures and equipment manuals.

Perform customized cleaning and processing of laboratory glassware and equipment to meet specific client requirements and regulatory standards, ensuring all items are properly decontaminated and prepared for reuse.

Complete accurate GXP documentation for all cleaning, sterilization, and material handling activities, maintaining strict compliance with federal, state, and local regulations governing laboratory operations.

Assist in the preparation, delivery, and processing of media and autoclaving materials, managing both clean and sterile glassware inventory to support ongoing laboratory operations.

Collaborate with laboratory staff and Lab Services team members to respond to changing priorities, special requests, and operational needs while maintaining safety and quality standards.

Provide support across other Lab Services operations as directed by management, demonstrating flexibility and teamwork to achieve departmental and company objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Valid New Jersey driver's license with the ability to complete appropriate vehicle operation training for transporting materials and equipment between laboratory locations.
  • High school diploma or equivalent with demonstrated ability to follow detailed written procedures and verbal instructions with precision and accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of safety protocols and the ability to work in laboratory environments while adhering to established safety procedures and regulations.
  • Physical capability to lift, move, and transport laboratory equipment and materials regularly throughout the workday.
  • Ability to operate mechanical equipment following written manuals and standard operating procedures with attention to detail and quality outcomes.
  • Demonstrated reliability in executing time-sensitive tasks and maintaining consistent work schedules that may vary based on operational requirements.
  • Strong commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards in all assigned activities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working in laboratory environments or with laboratory equipment cleaning and processing.
  • Familiarity with GXP (Good Laboratory Practice, Good Manufacturing Practice) documentation requirements and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Basic knowledge of laboratory glassware types, cleaning methods, and contamination control principles.
  • Experience operating industrial washers, autoclaves, or similar specialized cleaning and sterilization equipment.
  • Understanding of media preparation and sterile technique principles used in laboratory settings.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical equipment manuals and standard operating procedures effectively.
  • Experience working collaboratively in team-oriented environments with changing priorities and diverse stakeholders.

description:

Analog Devices, Inc. Advanced Cores Group

ADI’s Advanced Cores Group (ACG) is a world leader in developing high-speed data converters and related technology. ACG has an excellent track record of producing breakthrough, innovative technologies including RF DACs and ADCs, and SerDes PHYs, in cutting-edge FinFET processes for integration into highly sophisticated system-on-chip (SoC) products. The converter cores have won industry and academic recognition in publications and at conferences. Our cores are integrated into products for a variety of end applications, including Automotive, Aerospace and Defense, Communications, and Instrumentation. Be part of the excitement, bringing your ideas into reality in an environment where you’re encouraged and challenged to reach your full potential.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with a highly capable team developing our most advanced converters. You should exhibit a strong, intuitive capability in solving complex challenges. Self-motivation and the ability to work effectively within a geographically diverse team will also be important. Your work will include:

  • Collaborating with a team of other designers to implement key circuit blocks within a defined architecture

  • Comprehending system level impacts of block level parameters and making trade-offs as needed

  • Designing challenging transistor-level circuits

  • Preparing effective design documents and conducting engaging design reviews

  • Guiding layout, evaluation, and test engineering teams

Qualifications

  • M.S. or beyond in Electrical Engineering

  • 7+ years’ experience in CMOS design

  • Strong understanding of a wide range of circuits such as wide bandwidth amplifiers and comparators, switched capacitor circuits, precision voltage and current references, LDOs.

  • While not a must, experience in high-speed data converter or SerDes PHY design is a strong plus.

  • Experience in Cadence schematic capture and SPICE simulation tools.

  • Signal processing knowledge is a strong plus, particularly as it relates to calibration algorithms.

  • Experience with MATLAB, for example used as a behavioral modeling tool.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, and ability to work in a large team.

What’s in it for you

At Analog Devices (ADI), you’ll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry to tackle complex real-world challenges that matter—from autonomous vehicles and drones to smart factories, augmented reality, and remote healthcare solutions. We foster a culture built on shared goals, continuous learning, and a healthy work-life balance. Here, your growth is our priority. We invest in your development and celebrate our collective success because we believe that empowered, intellectually curious individuals are the key to our innovation and leadership. Come be part of a team where your ideas make an impact, your well-being is valued, and your career can thrive.

title: Warehouse Part Time Overnight
description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. How We Support You

  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.

  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

  • Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
  • Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
  • Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
  • Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
  • Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks

Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
  • Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
  • Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
  • Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
  • Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
  • Execute Delivery Readiness best practices

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment

Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

title: Customer Engineer - PDC (SEM Inspection and Metrology)
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Salary:

$31.00 - $42.40

Location:

Malta,NY

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Install, maintain, and upgrade Applied Materials PDC SEM-based inspection systems

  • Troubleshoot equipment using standard diagnostics, with support from senior engineers as needed

  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electron beam, vacuum, electrical, and mechanical systems

  • Support customers in improving defect inspection performance and yield

  • Work with customers and internal teams to understand process flows and inspection requirements

  • Communicate directly with customers to ensure tool uptime and performance


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate degree, technical training, or equivalent experience (Bachelor’s preferred)

  • 4–7 years of experience in semiconductor equipment support or related field

  • Experience with SEM tools or e-beam inspection systems

  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills

  • Experience with vacuum systems, electron beam fundamentals, and precision motion systems

  • Basic understanding of semiconductor processes and defect/yield concepts

  • Solid communication skills and basic Microsoft Office knowledge

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges

  • Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics

  • Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters

  • Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.

  • Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field


Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 20% of the Time

Yes

케어랩스는 ​환자 ​중심의 ​디지털 헬스케어 ​플랫폼을 만들어 가고 있으며, ​장기적 ​비전과 신념을 ​갖고 모두에게 편리한 ​의료를 제공하고자 ​합니다. ​
이를 위해 ​헬스케어 ​플랫폼(힐오, ​요보사랑, 메디잡)을 직접 ​운영하고 ​있으며 미래사업으로 시니어케어에 ​투자하고 ​있습니다. ​또한 자회사를 통해 ​비대면진료(굿닥)와 글로벌 ​메디컬 ​플랫폼(바비톡) 영역에서도 ​빠르게 성장 ​중입니다.
케어랩스는 ​예방과 케어에 이르는 ​헬스케어 전 ​여정을 디지털로 연결하는 헬스케어 플랫폼 기업입니다.

Responsibilities

• 헬스케어 규제산업 법률자문 및 신규 사업 개발 지원
• 비즈니스 조직과 협업하여 법적 리스크 관리 방안 제시
• 비대면진료, 시니어케어 등 헬스케어 사업 관련 법률자문 및 규제 리스크 검토 (의료법, 노인복지법, 개인정보보호법 등)
• 신규 서비스·상품 출시 관련 법률 검토, 약관·개인정보처리방침 등 문서 작성

• Compliance & Risk Management
• 헬스케어·시니어 관련 법령 및 감독규정 모니터링
• 내부통제 체계 구축 및 고도화 지원
• 개인정보보호(의료정보 포함) 및 준법 관련 업무 지원
• 준법 검토 및 가이드 구성 관리

Requirements

• 국내 또는 해외 변호사 자격증 보유자 중 하나에 해당하는 분
• 로펌 경력 5년 이상 또는
• 기업 인하우스 법무팀 근무 경험 보유자
• 변호사 자격증 미보유자의 경우
• 법학 전공자로서 법무 관련 경력 10년 이상
• 헬스케어 산업 또는 고규제 산업(금융, 바이오, 제약 등) 분야에서 법무 경험이 있으신 분

Preferred

• 혁신 산업에 대한 관심과 경험
• 외국계 회사 법무팀 경험
• 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 수준의 영어가 가능하신 분 (Writing/Speaking)

Benefits

• 1층 사내 카페 (전문 바리스타) 무제한 무료
• 2층 라운지 스낵바(간식, 음료, 맥주 상시 비치)
• 급여와 별도로 점심 식대 지원
• 근속 연수에 따른 리프레시 휴가 및 포상금 지급
• 생일 축하 반차휴가 및 축하금 지원
• 2년에 한 번 본인 포함 직계가족 2인 정밀 건강검진 지원
• 시간 단위로 쪼개서 사용 가능한 시간차
• 월 1회 패밀리데이(금요일 오전 근무 후 퇴근)
• 교육비 및 도서비 지원

title: Pathology Laboratory Assistant II
description:
Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

Performs a variety of clerical and technical duties under general supervision. Reports to a Laboratory Supervisor. Responsibilities include receipt, accessioning, centrifugation and decanting of patient specimens, and communicating with clinicians at the Front Window and over the phone.

Does this position require Patient Care? No

Essential Functions:
Assist with labeling, preservation and fixation of specimens.
-Work closely with technologists to ensure specimens are processed timely and accurately.
-Monitor reagent and supply inventory.
-Organize patient specimen and assay worksheets/printouts for testing and technologist review.
-Use LIMS to upload documents and input critical data or comments.
-Clean and maintain lab equipment.


Qualifications

High School Diploma or Equivalent required

No

Experience
Previous laboratory, healthcare and/or customer service experience 1-2 years required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Good interpersonal and communication skills so as to be able to interact effectively with individuals in the lab and the hospital.
- Ability to multitask and work accurately under stress of time constraints and heavy workload demands.
- Demonstrates excellent dependability, reliability, accuracy, prioritization ability, problem solving skills, customer service and teamwork.

title: Growth Intern
description:
Growth Intern

We're hiring a Growth Intern.

As an early growth intern, you'll work alongside our founding team to help Soren grow, from building customer relationships to supporting marketing, events, partnerships, and go-to-market initiatives.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You'll collaborate directly with founders, prospective customers, and clients across sales, marketing, partnerships, and customer success. You'll gain hands-on experience identifying growth opportunities, executing quickly, and helping build the systems that support a fast-growing startup.

We're a small, fast-moving team. We learn quickly, ship quickly, and continuously adapt based on customer feedback. If you're excited to learn, enjoy working with people, and want to help grow an AI startup from the ground up, you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

You'll work closely with our founding team to help build relationships with prospective and existing customers, communicate how AI can create value, and support initiatives that drive Soren's growth.

Throughout your internship, you'll contribute across sales, marketing, partnerships, customer success, and events while learning how an early-stage startup develops and executes its go-to-market strategy. You'll receive mentorship, work on meaningful projects, and see the direct impact of your contributions.

Responsibilities

  • Support outbound sales and business development initiatives.
  • Research prospective customers and conduct thoughtful outreach.
  • Assist with customer meetings, product demos, and follow-up communications.
  • Help plan and coordinate events, conferences, workshops, and customer engagements.
  • Create marketing content, presentations, case studies, and sales collateral.
  • Conduct market research and identify potential partnership opportunities.
  • Help improve CRM organization, sales operations, and internal growth processes.
  • Analyze customer feedback, pipeline activity, and growth metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with the founding team on new growth experiments and go-to-market initiatives.

You Should Join If You

  • Are pursuing a degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or a related field (or have equivalent experience).
  • Have experience through internships, student organizations, research, entrepreneurial projects, or extracurricular leadership.
  • Are an exceptional communicator who enjoys building relationships with others.
  • Are curious about startups, AI, sales, marketing, or business development.
  • Learn quickly and enjoy solving open-ended problems.
  • Are highly organized and enjoy balancing multiple projects.
  • Care about understanding customers and creating real business value.
  • Want hands-on experience helping grow an early-stage AI startup where your work has immediate impact.

About Soren

Soren is the AI transformation partner for regulated industries.

We work with organizations that operate in highly regulated environments to deploy secure, production-grade AI systems.

Rather than forcing organizations to change how they work, we build AI around their existing workflows, institutional knowledge, and security requirements. We develop custom AI agents, intelligent automations, and enterprise AI infrastructure that integrate seamlessly into how teams already operate.

Our goal is simple: make AI genuinely useful by solving economically meaningful problems.

Why Join Us

We're entering a once-in-a-generation shift in how knowledge work gets done.

For years, organizations have invested heavily in AI with relatively modest returns. In many cases, the technology wasn't the problem. The implementation was. Existing AI tools often require people to change established workflows or adapt years of expertise to generic software.

We believe the opposite approach is the future.

Instead of asking people to work like AI, we build AI that works like people.

By deeply understanding how organizations operate, we create systems that augment existing expertise rather than replace it. The result is software that people actually adopt, trust, and rely on every day.

As a Growth Intern, you'll work directly with the founding team, gain exposure to every aspect of building an early-stage company, and contribute to initiatives that influence how Soren finds customers, builds relationships, and grows. You'll develop practical experience across sales, marketing, partnerships, customer success, and startup operations while helping shape the future of enterprise AI.

If you're excited about learning quickly, working directly with customers, and helping define how AI transforms critical industries, we'd love to work with you.

title: Maintenance Planner
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Maintenance Planner JLL

What this job involves:

The Maintenance Planner position is your opportunity to become the operational backbone of facility maintenance excellence at JLL. In this role, you'll orchestrate all maintenance activities across our facilities, transforming reactive approaches into strategic, data-driven operations. You'll be the critical link connecting maintenance teams, facility occupants, and leadership while leveraging technology to maximize asset reliability and operational efficiency. This position offers significant impact—your planning directly influences facility uptime, cost control, and occupant satisfaction. If you're passionate about systems, data, and operational optimization, this role provides the platform to demonstrate how strategic planning elevates facility performance and contributes to JLL's mission of delivering exceptional client service.

What your day to day will look like:

  • You'll start each morning reviewing and prioritizing incoming work orders, assessing urgency, safety implications, and operational impact to determine assignments.
  • Throughout the day, you'll coordinate with maintenance technicians, assigning work based on skillsets and workload while tracking progress from initiation through completion.
  • You'll spend significant time in the CMMS, entering asset data, updating equipment records, maintaining preventive maintenance schedules, and generating performance reports.
  • Regular communication with facility occupants and stakeholders keeps everyone informed about maintenance activities, outage schedules, and work order status.
  • You'll continuously refine preventive maintenance programs, developing task lists and procedures that align with manufacturer recommendations and best practices.
  • Administrative responsibilities include maintaining equipment documentation, warranties, and service contracts while supporting budget tracking through parts usage and labor hour monitoring.
  • You'll also analyze maintenance data to identify trends, generate KPI dashboards, and provide insights that drive continuous improvement in facility operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), demonstrating proficiency in work order management, asset tracking, and preventive maintenance scheduling
  • Previous experience in Facilities Management Administration, Facilities Coordinator, or similar facility operations role with demonstrated customer service capabilities
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to facility access and security clearance requirements
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel for data analysis, report generation, and dashboard creation
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent with excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to work independently and interface effectively with diverse stakeholders
  • Database management capabilities and commitment to data accuracy and integrity

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering Technology, Business Administration, or related field
  • Professional certifications such as Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), Certified Facility Manager (CFM), or CMMS-specific certifications (IBM Maximo, SAP Plant Maintenance)
  • 4+ years of comprehensive CMMS administration experience with platforms such as IBM Maximo, SAP PM, Corrigo, FacilityDude, or Infor EAM
  • Background in commercial real estate, healthcare facilities, manufacturing, or government facility management environments
  • Experience developing and implementing preventive maintenance programs from inception with knowledge of reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) principles
  • Familiarity with building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire/life safety systems
  • Technical skills including AutoCAD, SQL database queries, or business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau)

Compensation:

$25-$30 per hour

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Location:

On-site –Gulfport, MS

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!


Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care

  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary

  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

  • Early access to earned wages through Daily Pay
